# CowsIA

App de registro ganadero creada con una arquitectura similar a BancosIA:

- `backend`: FastAPI, SQLAlchemy y SQLite.
- `frontend`: React, Vite, Recharts y lucide-react.
- Fuente local: `LibroRegistroAnimaleGanaderoAFechas_10-07-2023_10-07-2026.xml`.

## Arranque

### Docker Compose

La configuracion Docker publica CowsIA en el puerto 8081, por lo que puede
ejecutarse al mismo tiempo que BancosIA_2 (puerto 8080):

```bash
docker compose up --build -d
```

Abre http://localhost:8081 e inicia sesion con las credenciales guardadas en
`.env`. Para cambiarlas, edita `COWSIA_USERNAME` y `COWSIA_PASSWORD` antes
de arrancar los contenedores. El backend no publica ningun puerto en el host:
solo Nginx puede acceder a el dentro de la red privada de Compose.

Para detener CowsIA:

```bash
docker compose down
```

La base SQLite, las imagenes subidas y el XML local se montan desde el
directorio del proyecto, por lo que no se pierden al recrear los contenedores.

### Usuarios y explotaciones

Cada usuario pertenece a una explotacion y solo puede consultar o modificar
los animales, imagenes, ubicaciones, sucesos, importaciones y estadisticas de
esa explotacion. Varios usuarios pueden compartir datos indicando exactamente
el mismo nombre de explotacion al crear sus cuentas.

La cuenta `pepe` administra usuarios desde la pestaña **Usuarios**. El resto de
la aplicacion ofrece las mismas funciones a todas las cuentas. La cuenta `demo`
pertenece a `explotacion_demo`; `pepe` pertenece a `explotacion_pepe`. Ambas
explotaciones se inicializaron con una copia independiente de los 328 animales
y su informacion relacionada.

Las contrasenas iniciales se consultan localmente, sin copiarlas a registros:

```bash
grep -E '^COWSIA_(USERNAME|PASSWORD|DEMO_USERNAME|DEMO_PASSWORD)=' .env
```

Las contrasenas se guardan en la base mediante hashes `scrypt`; los valores de
`.env` solo se usan para crear las cuentas iniciales y no sustituyen las cuentas
ya existentes.

### Desarrollo local

Backend:

```powershell
cd C:\ProyectosCodex\Campo\CowsIA\backend
python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
python -m uvicorn app.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8001
```

Frontend:

```powershell
cd C:\ProyectosCodex\Campo\CowsIA\frontend
npm install
$env:VITE_API_BASE='http://127.0.0.1:8001'
npm run dev -- --port 5174 --strictPort
```

URL local: http://127.0.0.1:5174/

## Verificacion

```powershell
cd C:\ProyectosCodex\Campo\CowsIA\backend
python -m pytest

cd C:\ProyectosCodex\Campo\CowsIA\frontend
npm run build
```

La API importa automaticamente el XML local al arrancar si la base `backend/cows.db` esta vacia.

## Modelo extendido por animal

Cada animal se identifica por `crotal` en la tabla principal `animals`. Los datos multiples se guardan en tablas relacionadas:

- `animal_images`: fotografias del animal, con ruta del fichero y metadatos.
- `animal_locations`: coordenadas del animal, con fecha/hora de registro y origen opcional.
- `animal_events`: sucesos del animal, con texto, fecha, usuario informante e imagen opcional.

La ficha completa se consulta con:

```text
GET /api/animals/{crotal}/details
```

## Carga masiva de imagenes

Las fotos colocadas en `imagenes_animales` se pueden asignar aleatoriamente sin reutilizar imagenes ya marcadas:

```powershell
cd C:\ProyectosCodex\Campo\CowsIA\backend
python -m app.bulk_assign_images ..\imagenes_animales
```

Para simular antes de escribir:

```powershell
python -m app.bulk_assign_images ..\imagenes_animales --dry-run
```

El script guarda una marca por `sha256` en `animal_image_assignments`. Si se suben mas imagenes a la carpeta y se vuelve a ejecutar, solo se asignan las imagenes nuevas; las ya usadas o duplicadas por contenido se omiten.

## Galeria

La pestaña `Galeria` muestra una tarjeta por animal con su imagen principal, crotal, sexo y edad. La API usa:

```text
GET /api/gallery
POST /api/animal-images/{image_id}/primary
```

Cada animal tiene una unica imagen principal. Al migrar datos existentes, queda marcada como principal la primera imagen asignada inicialmente. En la ficha de un animal se puede cambiar manualmente pulsando el boton de imagen sobre cualquiera de sus fotos.

## Carga masiva de ubicaciones

Las coordenadas de `ubicaciones_animales.csv` se asignan aleatoriamente solo a animales activos:

```powershell
cd C:\ProyectosCodex\Campo\CowsIA\backend
python -m app.bulk_assign_locations ..\ubicaciones_animales.csv
```

Para simular antes de escribir:

```powershell
python -m app.bulk_assign_locations ..\ubicaciones_animales.csv --dry-run
```

El script guarda una marca por fila y coordenada en `animal_location_assignments`. Si se vuelve a ejecutar con el mismo CSV, no reasigna las filas ya usadas. Si se añaden nuevas filas al CSV, solo se asignan las nuevas.

## Mapa

La pestaña `Mapa` muestra las ultimas ubicaciones de los animales activos sobre OpenStreetMap. La API usa:

```text
GET /api/map/locations
```

Cada marcador abre un popup con crotal, sexo y edad. Desde el popup se puede abrir la ficha completa del animal.

from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
from sqlalchemy.pool import StaticPool

from app.database import Base
from app.main import _animal_by_crotal, _owned_child, list_animals, list_farm_events
from app.models import Animal, AnimalImage, Farm, FarmEvent, User


def database() -> Session:
    engine = create_engine(
        "sqlite://",
        connect_args={"check_same_thread": False},
        poolclass=StaticPool,
    )
    Base.metadata.create_all(engine)
    return Session(engine)


def test_animals_are_filtered_by_farm() -> None:
    db = database()
    first = Farm(name="primera")
    second = Farm(name="segunda")
    db.add_all([first, second])
    db.flush()
    db.add_all(
        [
            Animal(farm_id=first.id, crotal="ES001"),
            Animal(farm_id=second.id, crotal="ES001"),
        ]
    )
    db.commit()

    first_rows = list_animals(
        q=None,
        status=None,
        sexo=[],
        raza=None,
        causa_baja=None,
        explotacion=None,
        born_from=None,
        born_to=None,
        farm_id=first.id,
        db=db,
    )

    assert len(first_rows) == 1
    assert first_rows[0].farm_id == first.id
    assert _animal_by_crotal(db, "ES001", second.id).farm_id == second.id


def test_child_ids_cannot_cross_farms() -> None:
    db = database()
    first = Farm(name="primera")
    second = Farm(name="segunda")
    db.add_all([first, second])
    db.flush()
    animal = Animal(farm_id=first.id, crotal="ES001")
    db.add(animal)
    db.flush()
    image = AnimalImage(animal_id=animal.id, file_path="backend/uploads/animal_images/test.jpg")
    db.add(image)
    db.commit()

    assert _owned_child(db, AnimalImage, image.id, first.id).id == image.id
    try:
        _owned_child(db, AnimalImage, image.id, second.id)
    except Exception as exc:
        assert getattr(exc, "status_code", None) == 404
    else:
        raise AssertionError("Una explotacion accedio a la imagen de otra")


def test_general_incidents_are_filtered_by_farm() -> None:
    db = database()
    first = Farm(name="primera")
    second = Farm(name="segunda")
    db.add_all([first, second])
    db.flush()
    first_user = User(username="usuario-primero", password_hash="test", farm_id=first.id)
    second_user = User(username="usuario-segundo", password_hash="test", farm_id=second.id)
    db.add_all([first_user, second_user])
    db.flush()
    db.add_all(
        [
            FarmEvent(farm_id=first.id, category="Alambrada", text="Rota", reporter_user_id=first_user.id, reporter=first_user.username),
            FarmEvent(farm_id=second.id, category="Bebedero", text="Fuga", reporter_user_id=second_user.id, reporter=second_user.username),
        ]
    )
    db.commit()

    first_rows = list_farm_events(farm_id=first.id, db=db)

    assert len(first_rows) == 1
    assert first_rows[0]["text"] == "Rota"
    assert first_rows[0]["reporter"] == "usuario-primero"

class AnimalEventOut(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(from_attributes=True)

    id: int
    animal_id: int
    text: str
    event_date: date | None
    reporter: str | None
    image_name: str | None
    created_at: datetime
    image_url: str | None = None


class AnimalDetailOut(BaseModel):
    animal: AnimalOut
    images: list[AnimalImageOut]
    locations: list[AnimalLocationOut]
    events: list[AnimalEventOut]
        "image_url": f"/api/farm-events/{row.id}/image" if row.image_path else None,
    }


def _age_years(born: date | None) -> float | None:
    if not born:
        return None
    return round((date.today() - born).days / 365.25, 1)


@app.get("/api/animals/{crotal}/details", response_model=AnimalDetailOut)
def animal_details(crotal: str, farm_id: int = Depends(current_farm_id), db: Session = Depends(get_db)) -> dict:
    animal = _animal_by_crotal(db, crotal, farm_id)
    images = db.query(AnimalImage).filter(AnimalImage.animal_id == animal.id).order_by(AnimalImage.is_primary.desc(), AnimalImage.created_at.asc(), AnimalImage.id.asc()).all()
    locations = db.query(AnimalLocation).filter(AnimalLocation.animal_id == animal.id).order_by(AnimalLocation.recorded_at.desc()).all()
    events = db.query(AnimalEvent).filter(AnimalEvent.animal_id == animal.id).order_by(AnimalEvent.event_date.desc().nullslast(), AnimalEvent.created_at.desc()).all()
    return {
        "animal": animal,
        "images": [_image_out(row) for row in images],
        "locations": locations,
        "events": [_event_out(row) for row in events],
    }


@app.post("/api/animals/{crotal}/images", response_model=AnimalImageOut)
async def create_animal_image(crotal: str, file: UploadFile = File(...), farm_id: int = Depends(current_farm_id), db: Session = Depends(get_db)) -> dict:
    animal = _animal_by_crotal(db, crotal, farm_id)
    suffix = _image_suffix(file)
    content = await file.read()
    target = _store_upload("animal_images", file, content, suffix)
    row = AnimalImage(
        animal_id=animal.id,
        file_path=_portable_upload_path(target),
        file_name=file.filename or target.name,
        content_type=file.content_type,
        is_primary=db.query(AnimalImage).filter(AnimalImage.animal_id == animal.id, AnimalImage.is_primary.is_(True)).first() is None,
    )
    db.add(row)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(row)
    return _image_out(row)

function AnimalDetail({ animal, onClose, onChanged }) {
  const [detail, setDetail] = useState(null);
  const [imageFile, setImageFile] = useState(null);
  const [eventFile, setEventFile] = useState(null);
  const [locationForm, setLocationForm] = useState({ latitude: "", longitude: "", recorded_at: "", source: "" });
  const [eventForm, setEventForm] = useState({ text: "", event_date: new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10), reporter: "" });
  const [error, setError] = useState("");

  async function load() {
    setDetail(await api.get(`/api/animals/${encodeURIComponent(animal.crotal)}/details`));
  }

  useEffect(() => {
    load().catch((exc) => setError(exc.message));
  }, [animal.crotal]);

  async function uploadAnimalImage(event) {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (!imageFile) return;
    setError("");
    try {
      await api.upload(`/api/animals/${encodeURIComponent(animal.crotal)}/images`, imageFile);
      setImageFile(null);
      await load();
      onChanged?.();
    } catch (exc) {
      setError(exc.message);
    }
  }

  async function saveLocation(event) {
    event.preventDefault();
    setError("");
    try {
      await api.post(`/api/animals/${encodeURIComponent(animal.crotal)}/locations`, {
        latitude: Number(locationForm.latitude),
        longitude: Number(locationForm.longitude),
        recorded_at: locationForm.recorded_at ? new Date(locationForm.recorded_at).toISOString() : null,
        source: locationForm.source || null,
      });
      setLocationForm({ latitude: "", longitude: "", recorded_at: "", source: "" });
      await load();
      onChanged?.();
    } catch (exc) {
      setError(exc.message);
    }
  }

  async function saveEvent(event) {
    event.preventDefault();
    setError("");
    try {
      const form = new FormData();
      form.append("text", eventForm.text);
      if (eventForm.event_date) form.append("event_date", eventForm.event_date);
      if (eventForm.reporter) form.append("reporter", eventForm.reporter);
      if (eventFile) form.append("file", eventFile);
      await api.uploadForm(`/api/animals/${encodeURIComponent(animal.crotal)}/events-with-image`, form);
      setEventForm({ text: "", event_date: new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10), reporter: "" });
      setEventFile(null);
      await load();
      onChanged?.();
    } catch (exc) {
      setError(exc.message);
    }
  }

  async function remove(path) {
    setError("");
    try {
      await api.delete(path);
      await load();
      onChanged?.();
    } catch (exc) {
      setError(exc.message);
    }
  }

  async function setPrimary(imageId) {
    setError("");
    try {
      await api.post(`/api/animal-images/${imageId}/primary`, {});
      await load();
      onChanged?.();
    } catch (exc) {
      setError(exc.message);
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="detail-backdrop">
      <aside className="detail-panel">
        <header className="detail-header">
          <div>
            <span className="muted">Ficha del animal</span>
            <h2>{animal.crotal}</h2>
          </div>
          <button className="icon" onClick={onClose} title="Cerrar"><X size={18} /></button>
        </header>
        <div className="animal-summary">
          <span>{animal.sexo || "Sin sexo"}</span>
          <span>{animal.raza || "Sin raza"}</span>
          <span>{formatDate(animal.fecha_nacimiento) || "Sin nacimiento"}</span>
        </div>
        {error && <p className="error">{error}</p>}
        {!detail && <p className="muted">Cargando...</p>}
        {detail && (
          <div className="detail-content">
            <section className="detail-section">
              <h3><Image size={16} /> Imagenes</h3>
              <form className="compact-form" onSubmit={uploadAnimalImage}>
                <input type="file" accept="image/png,image/jpeg,image/webp,image/gif" onChange={(event) => setImageFile(event.target.files?.[0] || null)} />
                <button disabled={!imageFile}><Plus size={16} />Anadir</button>
              </form>
              <div className="image-grid">
                {detail.images.map((row) => (
                  <div className={`image-item ${row.is_primary ? "primary" : ""}`} key={row.id}>
                    <img src={api.url(row.image_url)} alt={row.file_name || "Imagen del animal"} />
                    <div>
                      <span>{row.file_name || "Imagen"}</span>
                      <div className="image-actions">
                        <button className="icon" onClick={() => setPrimary(row.id)} disabled={row.is_primary} title="Imagen principal">
                          <Image size={15} />
                        </button>
                        <button className="icon" onClick={() => remove(`/api/animal-images/${row.id}`)} title="Eliminar"><Trash2 size={15} /></button>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    {row.is_primary && <b>Principal</b>}
                  </div>
                ))}
                {detail.images.length === 0 && <p className="muted">Sin imagenes</p>}
              </div>
            </section>
            <section className="detail-section">
              <h3><MapPin size={16} /> Ubicaciones</h3>
              {detail.locations.length > 0 && <AnimalLocationMiniMap locations={detail.locations} />}
              <form className="compact-form location-form" onSubmit={saveLocation}>
                <input required type="number" step="0.000001" placeholder="Latitud" value={locationForm.latitude} onChange={(event) => setLocationForm({ ...locationForm, latitude: event.target.value })} />
                <input required type="number" step="0.000001" placeholder="Longitud" value={locationForm.longitude} onChange={(event) => setLocationForm({ ...locationForm, longitude: event.target.value })} />
                <input type="datetime-local" value={locationForm.recorded_at} onChange={(event) => setLocationForm({ ...locationForm, recorded_at: event.target.value })} />
                <input placeholder="Origen" value={locationForm.source} onChange={(event) => setLocationForm({ ...locationForm, source: event.target.value })} />
                <button><Plus size={16} />Anadir</button>
              </form>
              <div className="stack-list">
                {detail.locations.map((row) => (
                  <div className="stack-row" key={row.id}>
                    <MapPin size={15} />
                    <span>{row.latitude}, {row.longitude}</span>
                    <a className="icon" href={`https://www.google.com/maps?q=${row.latitude},${row.longitude}`} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" title="Abrir mapa"><ExternalLink size={15} /></a>
                    <button className="icon" onClick={() => remove(`/api/animal-locations/${row.id}`)} title="Eliminar"><Trash2 size={15} /></button>
                  </div>
                ))}
                {detail.locations.length === 0 && <p className="muted">Sin ubicaciones</p>}
              </div>
            </section>
            <section className="detail-section">
              <h3><CalendarPlus size={16} /> Sucesos</h3>
              <form className="event-form" onSubmit={saveEvent}>
                <textarea required placeholder="Texto del suceso" value={eventForm.text} onChange={(event) => setEventForm({ ...eventForm, text: event.target.value })} />
                <div className="compact-form">
                  <input type="date" value={eventForm.event_date} onChange={(event) => setEventForm({ ...eventForm, event_date: event.target.value })} />
                  <input placeholder="Usuario informante" value={eventForm.reporter} onChange={(event) => setEventForm({ ...eventForm, reporter: event.target.value })} />
                  <input type="file" accept="image/png,image/jpeg,image/webp,image/gif" onChange={(event) => setEventFile(event.target.files?.[0] || null)} />
                  <button><Plus size={16} />Anadir</button>
                </div>
              </form>
              <div className="event-list">
                {detail.events.map((row) => (
                  <article className="event-row" key={row.id}>
                    <header>
                      <strong>{formatDate(row.event_date) || "Sin fecha"}</strong>
                      <span>{row.reporter || "Sin usuario"}</span>
                      <button className="icon" onClick={() => remove(`/api/animal-events/${row.id}`)} title="Eliminar"><Trash2 size={15} /></button>
                    </header>
                    <p>{row.text}</p>
                    {row.image_url && <img src={api.url(row.image_url)} alt={row.image_name || "Imagen del suceso"} />}
                  </article>
                ))}
                {detail.events.length === 0 && <p className="muted">Sin sucesos</p>}
              </div>
            </section>
          </div>
        )}
      </aside>
    </div>
  );
}

function AnimalLocationMiniMap({ locations }) {

    const first = locations[0];
    return [first.latitude, first.longitude];
  }, [locations]);

services:

    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: backend/Dockerfile
    container_name: cowsia-backend
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      COWSIA_USERNAME: ${COWSIA_USERNAME:?Define COWSIA_USERNAME en el archivo .env}
      COWSIA_PASSWORD: ${COWSIA_PASSWORD:?Define COWSIA_PASSWORD en el archivo .env}
      COWSIA_FARM_NAME: ${COWSIA_FARM_NAME:?Define COWSIA_FARM_NAME en el archivo .env}
      COWSIA_DEMO_USERNAME: ${COWSIA_DEMO_USERNAME:?Define COWSIA_DEMO_USERNAME en el archivo .env}
      COWSIA_DEMO_PASSWORD: ${COWSIA_DEMO_PASSWORD:?Define COWSIA_DEMO_PASSWORD en el archivo .env}
      COWSIA_DEMO_FARM_NAME: ${COWSIA_DEMO_FARM_NAME:?Define COWSIA_DEMO_FARM_NAME en el archivo .env}
      COWSIA_SESSION_SECRET: ${COWSIA_SESSION_SECRET:?Define COWSIA_SESSION_SECRET en el archivo .env}
      COWSIA_SESSION_HOURS: ${COWSIA_SESSION_HOURS:-12}
      COWSIA_COOKIE_SECURE: ${COWSIA_COOKIE_SECURE:-false}
    volumes:
      - ./backend/cows.db:/workspace/backend/cows.db
      - ./backend/uploads:/workspace/backend/uploads
      - ./LibroRegistroAnimaleGanaderoAFechas_10-07-2023_10-07-2026.xml:/workspace/LibroRegistroAnimaleGanaderoAFechas_10-07-2023_10-07-2026.xml:ro
    expose:
      - "8000"

  frontend:
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: frontend/Dockerfile
    container_name: cowsia-frontend
    restart: unless-stopped
    depends_on:
      - backend
    ports:
      - "8081:80"

const scriptDirectory = fileURLToPath(new URL(".", import.meta.url));
const projectRoot = resolve(scriptDirectory, "../..");
const outputDirectory = resolve(projectRoot, "capturas_cowsia");
const baseUrl = process.env.COWSIA_URL || "http://127.0.0.1:8081";
const username = process.env.COWSIA_DEMO_USERNAME || process.env.COWSIA_USERNAME;
const password = process.env.COWSIA_DEMO_PASSWORD || process.env.COWSIA_PASSWORD;

if (!username || !password) {
  throw new Error("Faltan COWSIA_DEMO_USERNAME/COWSIA_DEMO_PASSWORD o las credenciales principales.");
}

await mkdir(outputDirectory, { recursive: true });

const browser = await chromium.launch({ headless: true });
const context = await browser.newContext({
  viewport: { width: 1440, height: 960 },
  deviceScaleFactor: 1,
  colorScheme: "light",
  locale: "es-ES",
});
const page = await context.newPage();

async function settle() {
  await page.waitForTimeout(1200);
  await page.evaluate(() => {
    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
    document.querySelectorAll("*").forEach((element) => {
      element.style.animationDuration = "0s";
      element.style.transitionDuration = "0s";
    });
  });
}

async function capture(name) {
  await settle();
  await page.screenshot({
    path: resolve(outputDirectory, `${name}.png`),
    fullPage: false,
  });
}

try {
  await page.goto(baseUrl, { waitUntil: "domcontentloaded" });

  const loginHeading = page.getByRole("heading", { name: "Acceso a CowsIA" });
  await page.locator(".metrics, .login-card").first().waitFor({ state: "visible" });
  if (await loginHeading.isVisible()) {
    await page.getByLabel("Usuario").fill(username);
    await page.getByLabel("Contrasena").fill(password);
    await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Entrar" }).click();
  }

  await page.locator(".metrics").waitFor({ state: "visible" });
  await capture("dashboard");

  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Galeria" }).click();
  await page.locator(".gallery-card").first().waitFor({ state: "visible" });
  await capture("galeria");

  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Animales" }).click();

def _resolve_upload_path(stored_path: str, folder: str) -> Path:

    if not path.is_absolute():

    stored_name = PureWindowsPath(stored_path).name
    if stored_name:
        candidates.append(UPLOAD_ROOT / folder / stored_name)
    return next((candidate for candidate in candidates if candidate.is_file()), candidates[-1])


def _image_out(row: AnimalImage) -> dict:
    return {
        "id": row.id,
        "animal_id": row.animal_id,
        "file_name": row.file_name,
        "content_type": row.content_type,
        "is_primary": bool(row.is_primary),
        "created_at": row.created_at,
        "image_url": f"/api/animal-images/{row.id}/file",
    }


@app.get("/api/animals/{crotal}/details", response_model=AnimalDetailOut)
def animal_details(crotal: str, farm_id: int = Depends(current_farm_id), db: Session = Depends(get_db)) -> dict:
    animal = _animal_by_crotal(db, crotal, farm_id)
    offspring = []
    if (animal.sexo or "").strip().casefold() == "hembra":
        offspring = db.query(Animal).filter(
            Animal.farm_id == farm_id,
            Animal.crotal_madre == animal.crotal,
            Animal.id != animal.id,
        ).order_by(Animal.fecha_nacimiento.desc().nullslast(), Animal.crotal.asc()).all()
    images = db.query(AnimalImage).filter(AnimalImage.animal_id == animal.id).order_by(AnimalImage.is_primary.desc(), AnimalImage.created_at.asc(), AnimalImage.id.asc()).all()
    locations = db.query(AnimalLocation).filter(AnimalLocation.animal_id == animal.id).order_by(AnimalLocation.recorded_at.desc()).all()
    events = db.query(AnimalEvent).filter(AnimalEvent.animal_id == animal.id).order_by(AnimalEvent.event_date.desc().nullslast(), AnimalEvent.created_at.desc()).all()
    return {
        "animal": animal,
        "offspring": offspring,
        "images": [_image_out(row) for row in images],
        "locations": locations,
        "events": [_event_out(row) for row in events],
    }


@app.post("/api/animals/{crotal}/images", response_model=AnimalImageOut)
async def create_animal_image(crotal: str, file: UploadFile = File(...), farm_id: int = Depends(current_farm_id), db: Session = Depends(get_db)) -> dict:
    animal = _animal_by_crotal(db, crotal, farm_id)
    suffix = _image_suffix(file)
    content = await file.read()
    target = _store_upload("animal_images", file, content, suffix)
    row = AnimalImage(
        animal_id=animal.id,
        file_path=_portable_upload_path(target),

import { mkdir } from "node:fs/promises";
import { resolve } from "node:path";
import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";
import { chromium } from "playwright";

const scriptDirectory = fileURLToPath(new URL(".", import.meta.url));
const projectRoot = resolve(scriptDirectory, "../..");
const outputDirectory = resolve(projectRoot, "capturas_cowsia");
const baseUrl = process.env.COWSIA_URL || "http://127.0.0.1:8081";
const username = process.env.COWSIA_DEMO_USERNAME || process.env.COWSIA_USERNAME;
const password = process.env.COWSIA_DEMO_PASSWORD || process.env.COWSIA_PASSWORD;

if (!username || !password) {
  throw new Error("Faltan COWSIA_DEMO_USERNAME/COWSIA_DEMO_PASSWORD o las credenciales principales.");
}

await mkdir(outputDirectory, { recursive: true });

const browser = await chromium.launch({ headless: true });
const context = await browser.newContext({
  viewport: { width: 1440, height: 960 },
  deviceScaleFactor: 1,
  colorScheme: "light",
  locale: "es-ES",
});
const page = await context.newPage();

async function settle() {
  await page.waitForTimeout(1200);
  await page.evaluate(() => {
    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
    document.querySelectorAll("*").forEach((element) => {
      element.style.animationDuration = "0s";
      element.style.transitionDuration = "0s";
    });
  });
}

async function capture(name) {
  await settle();
  await page.screenshot({
    path: resolve(outputDirectory, `${name}.png`),
    fullPage: false,
  });
}

try {
  await page.goto(baseUrl, { waitUntil: "domcontentloaded" });

  const loginHeading = page.getByRole("heading", { name: "Acceso a CowsIA" });
  await page.locator(".metrics, .login-card").first().waitFor({ state: "visible" });
  if (await loginHeading.isVisible()) {
    await page.getByLabel("Usuario").fill(username);
    await page.getByLabel("Contrasena").fill(password);
    await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Entrar" }).click();

  console.log(`Capturas guardadas en ${outputDirectory}`);
} finally {

function App({ username, farmName, canManageUsers, onLogout }) {
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState("dashboard");
  const [refreshKey, setRefreshKey] = useState(0);
  const visibleTabs = canManageUsers ? [...tabs, { id: "users", label: "Usuarios", icon: UserPlus }] : tabs;

  function refresh() {
    setRefreshKey((value) => value + 1);
  }

  return (
    <div className="app-shell">
      <aside className="sidebar">
        <div className="brand">
          <Gauge size={24} />
          <div>
            <strong>CowsIA</strong>
            <span>Registro ganadero</span>
          </div>
        </div>
        <nav>
          {visibleTabs.map((tab) => {
            const Icon = tab.icon;
            return (
              <button key={tab.id} className={activeTab === tab.id ? "active" : ""} onClick={() => setActiveTab(tab.id)}>
                <Icon size={18} />
                {tab.label}
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </nav>
        <div className="session-panel">
          <span title={username}>{username}</span>
          <small title={farmName}>{farmName}</small>
          <button type="button" onClick={onLogout}><LogOut size={16} />Salir</button>
        </div>
      </aside>
      <main>
        {activeTab === "dashboard" && <Dashboard refreshKey={refreshKey} />}
        {activeTab === "gallery" && <Gallery refreshKey={refreshKey} />}
        {activeTab === "map" && <CowsMap refreshKey={refreshKey} />}
        {activeTab === "animals" && <Animals refreshKey={refreshKey} />}
        {activeTab === "incidents" && <FarmIncidents />}
        {activeTab === "import" && <ImportXml onRefresh={refresh} />}
        {activeTab === "users" && canManageUsers && <Users />}
      </main>
    </div>
  );
}

const incidentCategories = [
  "Alambrada o cerramiento roto",
  "Puerta abierta o danada",
  "Huellas o fauna silvestre",
  "Averia en bebedero o tuberia",
  "Fallo del pastor electrico",
  "Arbol caido o camino bloqueado",
  "Inundacion o erosion",
  "Humo o riesgo de incendio",
  "Residuos o vertidos",
  "Acceso no autorizado",
  "Danos en instalaciones",
  "Plaga o especie invasora",
  "Otra incidencia",
];

function FarmIncidents() {
  const [rows, setRows] = useState([]);
  const [form, setForm] = useState({
    category: incidentCategories[0],
    text: "",
    occurred_at: localDateTimeValue(),
    latitude: "",
    longitude: "",
  });
  const [imageFile, setImageFile] = useState(null);
  const [fileKey, setFileKey] = useState(0);
  const [locating, setLocating] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");

  async function load() {
    setRows(await api.get("/api/farm-events"));
  }

  useEffect(() => {
    load().catch((exc) => setError(exc.message));
  }, []);

  function captureLocation() {
    setError("");
    if (!navigator.geolocation) {
      setError("Este dispositivo no ofrece geolocalizacion.");
      return;
    }
    setLocating(true);
    navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition(
      (position) => {
        setForm((current) => ({
          ...current,
          latitude: position.coords.latitude.toFixed(6),
          longitude: position.coords.longitude.toFixed(6),
        }));
        setLocating(false);
      },
      (locationError) => {
        setError(`No se pudo obtener la ubicacion: ${locationError.message}`);
        setLocating(false);
      },
      { enableHighAccuracy: true, timeout: 12_000 },
    );
  }

  async function submit(event) {
    event.preventDefault();
    setError("");
    try {
      const payload = new FormData();
      payload.append("category", form.category);
      payload.append("text", form.text);
      if (form.occurred_at) payload.append("occurred_at", new Date(form.occurred_at).toISOString());
      if (form.latitude && form.longitude) {
        payload.append("latitude", form.latitude);
        payload.append("longitude", form.longitude);
      }
      if (imageFile) payload.append("file", imageFile);
      await api.uploadForm("/api/farm-events-with-image", payload);
      setForm({ category: incidentCategories[0], text: "", occurred_at: localDateTimeValue(), latitude: "", longitude: "" });
      setImageFile(null);
      setFileKey((value) => value + 1);
      await load();
    } catch (exc) {
      setError(exc.message);
    }
  }

  async function remove(row) {
    setError("");
    try {
      await api.delete(`/api/farm-events/${row.id}`);
      await load();
    } catch (exc) {
      setError(exc.message);
    }
  }

  return (
    <section className="page incidents-page">
      <PageTitle title="Incidencias de la explotacion" />
      <div className="grid two incidents-layout">
        <form className="panel incident-form" onSubmit={submit}>
          <h2>Nueva incidencia</h2>
          <p className="muted">El usuario que ha iniciado sesion se guarda automaticamente como informante.</p>
          <label>
            Tipo
            <select value={form.category} onChange={(event) => setForm({ ...form, category: event.target.value })}>
              {incidentCategories.map((category) => <option key={category}>{category}</option>)}
            </select>
          </label>
          <label>
            Descripcion
            <textarea required placeholder="Describe lo sucedido" value={form.text} onChange={(event) => setForm({ ...form, text: event.target.value })} />
          </label>
          <label>
            Fecha y hora
            <input required type="datetime-local" value={form.occurred_at} onChange={(event) => setForm({ ...form, occurred_at: event.target.value })} />
          </label>
          <div className="incident-location">
            <input aria-label="Latitud" type="number" step="0.000001" placeholder="Latitud" value={form.latitude} onChange={(event) => setForm({ ...form, latitude: event.target.value })} />
            <input aria-label="Longitud" type="number" step="0.000001" placeholder="Longitud" value={form.longitude} onChange={(event) => setForm({ ...form, longitude: event.target.value })} />
            <button type="button" onClick={captureLocation} disabled={locating}><MapPin size={16} />{locating ? "Localizando..." : "Usar mi ubicacion"}</button>
          </div>
          <label>
            Fotografia opcional
            <input key={fileKey} type="file" accept="image/png,image/jpeg,image/webp,image/gif" onChange={(event) => setImageFile(event.target.files?.[0] || null)} />
          </label>
          <button className="primary" type="submit"><Plus size={16} />Guardar incidencia</button>
          {error && <p className="error">{error}</p>}
        </form>
        <div className="incident-history">
          <div className="result-strip"><ClipboardList size={18} /><strong>{rows.length}</strong><span>incidencias registradas</span></div>
          {rows.length === 0 && <div className="panel"><p className="muted">Todavia no hay incidencias generales.</p></div>}
          {rows.map((row) => (
            <article className="panel incident-card" key={row.id}>
              <header><div><span className="pill warning">{row.category}</span><h3>{row.text}</h3></div><button className="icon" type="button" onClick={() => remove(row)} title="Eliminar"><Trash2 size={15} /></button></header>
              <div className="incident-meta"><span><CalendarPlus size={15} />{formatDateTime(row.occurred_at)}</span><span>{row.reporter}</span></div>
              {row.latitude !== null && row.longitude !== null && <a className="incident-map-link" href={`https://www.google.com/maps?q=${row.latitude},${row.longitude}`} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer"><MapPin size={15} />{row.latitude}, {row.longitude}<ExternalLink size={14} /></a>}
              {row.image_url && <img src={api.url(row.image_url)} alt={row.image_name || row.category} />}
            </article>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

function Users() {
  const [users, setUsers] = useState([]);
  const [form, setForm] = useState({ username: "", password: "", farm_name: "" });
  const [message, setMessage] = useState("");
  const [error, setError] = useState("");

  async function loadUsers() {
    setUsers(await api.get("/api/admin/users"));
  }

  useEffect(() => {
    loadUsers().catch((loadError) => setError(loadError.message));
  }, []);

  async function submit(event) {
    event.preventDefault();
    setMessage("");
    setError("");
    try {
      const created = await api.post("/api/admin/users", form);
      setMessage(`Usuario ${created.username} creado en ${created.farm_name}.`);
      setForm({ username: "", password: "", farm_name: "" });
      await loadUsers();
    } catch (createError) {
      setError(createError.message);
    }
  }

  return (
    <section className="page">
      <PageTitle title="Usuarios" />
      <div className="grid two users-grid">
        <form className="panel user-form" onSubmit={submit}>
          <h2>Crear usuario</h2>
          <label>
            Usuario
            <input value={form.username} onChange={(event) => setForm({ ...form, username: event.target.value })} required minLength={3} />
          </label>
          <label>
            Contrasena inicial
            <input type="password" value={form.password} onChange={(event) => setForm({ ...form, password: event.target.value })} required minLength={10} />
          </label>
          <label>
            Explotacion
            <input value={form.farm_name} onChange={(event) => setForm({ ...form, farm_name: event.target.value })} placeholder="Una existente o un nombre nuevo" required />
          </label>
          <p className="muted">Usa el mismo nombre de explotacion para que varios usuarios compartan sus animales.</p>
          <button className="primary" type="submit"><UserPlus size={16} />Crear usuario</button>
          {message && <p className="positive">{message}</p>}
          {error && <p className="error">{error}</p>}
        </form>
        <div className="panel">
          <h2>Usuarios existentes</h2>
          <div className="user-list">
            {users.map((user) => (
              <div className="user-row" key={user.id}>
                <strong>{user.username}</strong>
                <span>{user.farm_name}</span>
                <small>{user.active ? "Activo" : "Inactivo"}{user.can_manage_users ? " · Administrador" : ""}</small>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

const animalMarkerIcon = L.divIcon({
  className: "animal-map-marker",
  html: '<span></span>',
  iconSize: [22, 22],
  iconAnchor: [11, 11],
  popupAnchor: [0, -12],

function CowsMap({ refreshKey }) {
  const [rows, setRows] = useState([]);
  const [selectedAnimal, setSelectedAnimal] = useState(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    api.get("/api/map/locations").then(setRows);
  }, [refreshKey]);

  const center = useMemo(() => {
    if (rows.length === 0) return [39.96, -6.48];
    const lat = rows.reduce((sum, row) => sum + row.latitude, 0) / rows.length;
    const lng = rows.reduce((sum, row) => sum + row.longitude, 0) / rows.length;
    return [lat, lng];
  }, [rows]);

  return (
    <section className="page map-page">
      <PageTitle title="Mapa" />
      <div className="map-summary">
        <span>{rows.length} animales con ubicacion</span>
      </div>
      <div className="map-panel">
        <MapContainer key={`${center[0]}-${center[1]}-${rows.length}`} center={center} zoom={15} scrollWheelZoom className="animal-map">
          <TileLayer
            attribution='&copy; <a href="https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright">OpenStreetMap</a>'
            url="https://{s}.tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png"
          />
          {rows.map((row) => (
            <Marker key={`${row.animal_id}-${row.latitude}-${row.longitude}`} position={[row.latitude, row.longitude]} icon={animalMarkerIcon}>
              <Popup>
                <div className="map-popup">
                  {row.image_url && <img src={api.url(row.image_url)} alt={row.crotal} />}
                  <strong>{row.crotal}</strong>
                  <span>{row.sexo || "Sin sexo"} · {row.age_years === null ? "Sin edad" : `${row.age_years} anos`}</span>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() =>
                      setSelectedAnimal({
                        crotal: row.crotal,
                        sexo: row.sexo,
                        fecha_nacimiento: row.fecha_nacimiento,
                      })
                    }
                  >
                    Abrir ficha
                  </button>
                </div>
              </Popup>
            </Marker>
          ))}
        </MapContainer>
      </div>
      {selectedAnimal && <AnimalDetail animal={selectedAnimal} onClose={() => setSelectedAnimal(null)} onChanged={() => api.get("/api/map/locations").then(setRows)} />}
    </section>
  );
}

    api.get("/api/filter-options").then(setOptions);
  }, [refreshKey]);

  useEffect(() => {
    api.get(`/api/animals${query}`).then(setRows);
  }, [query, refreshKey]);

  function setFilter(name, value) {
    setFilters((current) => ({ ...current, [name]: value }));
  }

  return (
    <section className="page">
      <PageTitle title="Animales" action={<ExportButtons />} />
      <div className="toolbar">
        <label>
          <Search size={16} />
          <input placeholder="Crotal, madre, procedencia o destino" value={filters.q} onChange={(event) => setFilter("q", event.target.value)} />
        </label>
        <select value={filters.status} onChange={(event) => setFilter("status", event.target.value)}>
          <option value="">Todos los estados</option>
          <option value="Activo">Activos</option>
          <option value="Baja">Bajas</option>
        </select>
        <select value={filters.sexo} onChange={(event) => setFilter("sexo", event.target.value)}>
          <option value="">Todos los sexos</option>
          {options.sexos.map((item) => (
            <option key={item} value={item}>{item}</option>
          ))}
        </select>
        <select value={filters.raza} onChange={(event) => setFilter("raza", event.target.value)}>
          <option value="">Todas las razas</option>
          {options.razas.map((item) => (
            <option key={item} value={item}>{item}</option>
          ))}
        </select>
        <select value={filters.causa_baja} onChange={(event) => setFilter("causa_baja", event.target.value)}>
          <option value="">Todas las causas</option>
          {options.causas_baja.map((item) => (
            <option key={item} value={item}>{item}</option>
          ))}
        </select>
        <select value={filters.explotacion} onChange={(event) => setFilter("explotacion", event.target.value)}>
          <option value="">Todas las explotaciones</option>
          {options.explotaciones.map((item) => (
            <option key={item} value={item}>{item}</option>
          ))}
        </select>
        <input type="date" value={filters.born_from} onChange={(event) => setFilter("born_from", event.target.value)} />
        <input type="date" value={filters.born_to} onChange={(event) => setFilter("born_to", event.target.value)} />
      </div>
      <div className="result-strip">
        <ClipboardList size={18} />
        <strong>{rows.length}</strong>
        <span>registros</span>
      </div>
      <div className="table-wrap">
        <table>
          <thead>
            <tr>
              <th>Crotal</th>
              <th>Estado</th>
              <th>Nacimiento</th>
              <th>Edad</th>
              <th>Sexo</th>
              <th>Raza</th>
              <th>Madre</th>
              <th>Alta</th>
              <th>Entrada</th>
              <th>Baja</th>
              <th>Destino</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            {rows.map((row) => (
              <tr key={row.id}>
                <td>
                  <button className="link-button" onClick={() => setSelectedAnimal(row)}>
                    <strong>{row.crotal}</strong>
                  </button>
                </td>
                <td><span className={`pill ${row.fecha_baja || row.causa_baja ? "bad" : "good"}`}>{row.fecha_baja || row.causa_baja ? "Baja" : "Activo"}</span></td>
                <td>{formatDate(row.fecha_nacimiento)}</td>
                <td>{years(row.fecha_nacimiento)}</td>
                <td>{row.sexo || ""}</td>
                <td>{row.raza || ""}</td>
                <td>{row.crotal_madre || ""}</td>
                <td>{row.causa_alta || ""} {formatDate(row.fecha_alta)}</td>
                <td>{row.procedencia || row.codigo_local_entrada || ""}</td>
                <td>{row.causa_baja || ""} {formatDate(row.fecha_baja)}</td>
                <td>{row.destino || row.codigo_local_salida || ""}</td>
              </tr>
            ))}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
      {selectedAnimal && <AnimalDetail animal={selectedAnimal} onClose={() => setSelectedAnimal(null)} />}
    </section>
  );
}

function ImportXml({ onRefresh }) {
  const [file, setFile] = useState(null);
  const [status, setStatus] = useState(null);
  const [preview, setPreview] = useState(null);
  const [message, setMessage] = useState("");
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    api.get("/api/local-xml/status").then(setStatus).catch(() => setStatus(null));
  }, []);

  async function importLocal() {
    setLoading(true);
    setError("");
    setMessage("");
    try {
      const result = await api.post("/api/local-xml/import");
      setMessage(`Importados ${result.animals} animales nuevos y actualizados ${result.updated_animals}.`);
      onRefresh();
    } catch (exc) {
      setError(exc.message);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }

  async function analyze() {
    if (!file) return;
    setLoading(true);
    setError("");
    setMessage("");
    setPreview(null);
    try {
      setPreview(await api.upload("/api/import/preview", file));
    } catch (exc) {
      setError(exc.message);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }

  async function upload() {
    if (!file) return;
    setLoading(true);
    setError("");
    setMessage("");
    try {
      const result = await api.upload("/api/import", file);
      setMessage(`Importados ${result.animals} animales nuevos y actualizados ${result.updated_animals}.`);
      setPreview(null);
      onRefresh();
    } catch (exc) {
      setError(exc.message);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <section className="page">
      <PageTitle title="Importar XML" />
      <div className="import-panel">
        <div className="local-file">
          <strong>XML local fijo</strong>
          <span className="muted">{status?.path || "Comprobando ruta..."}</span>
          <span className={status?.exists ? "positive" : "negative"}>{status?.exists ? "Archivo encontrado" : "Archivo no encontrado"}</span>
          <button disabled={loading || !status?.exists} onClick={importLocal}>
            <RefreshCcw size={16} />
            Importar XML local
          </button>
        </div>
        <FileUp size={34} />
        <input type="file" accept=".xml" onChange={(event) => setFile(event.target.files?.[0] || null)} />
        <button disabled={!file || loading} onClick={analyze}>
          <FileUp size={16} />
          {loading ? "Analizando..." : "Analizar archivo"}
        </button>
        {file && <p className="muted">Seleccionado: {file.name}</p>}
        {preview && (
          <div className={`import-preview ${preview.already_uploaded ? "warning" : ""}`}>
            <strong>{preview.already_uploaded ? "Este fichero ya estaba cargado" : "Fichero listo"}</strong>
            <span>Animales en el XML: {preview.incoming_animals}</span>
            <span>Nuevos animales: {preview.new_animals}</span>
            <span>Ya existentes: {preview.unchanged_animals}</span>
            <button disabled={loading} onClick={upload}>Confirmar importacion</button>
          </div>
        )}
        {message && <p className="positive">{message}</p>}
        {error && <p className="error">{error}</p>}
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

function ExportButtons() {
  return (
    <div className="actions">
      <a className="button" href={api.url("/api/export/animals.csv")}>
        <Download size={16} />
        CSV
      </a>
    </div>
  );
}

function Dashboard({ refreshKey }) {
  const [data, setData] = useState({
    summary: {},
    status: [],
    sex: [],
    breeds: [],
    birthYears: [],
    exits: [],
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    Promise.all([
      api.get("/api/dashboard/summary"),
      api.get("/api/dashboard/status"),
      api.get("/api/dashboard/sex"),
      api.get("/api/dashboard/breeds"),
      api.get("/api/dashboard/birth-years"),
      api.get("/api/dashboard/exits"),
    ]).then(([summary, status, sex, breeds, birthYears, exits]) => {
      setData({ summary, status, sex, breeds, birthYears, exits });
    });
  }, [refreshKey]);

  return (
    <section className="page">
      <PageTitle title="Dashboard" action={<ExportButtons />} />
      <div className="metrics">
        <Metric label="Animales" value={data.summary.total || 0} />
        <Metric label="Activos" value={data.summary.active || 0} tone="good" />
        <Metric label="Bajas" value={data.summary.inactive || 0} tone="bad" />
        <Metric label="Edad media activos" value={`${data.summary.average_age || 0} anos`} />
      </div>
      <div className="grid two">
        <ChartPanel title="Nacimientos por ano">
          <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height={280}>
            <BarChart data={data.birthYears}>
              <CartesianGrid strokeDasharray="3 3" />
              <XAxis dataKey="year" />
              <YAxis allowDecimals={false} />
              <Tooltip />
              <Bar dataKey="animals" fill="#1677ff" name="Animales" />
            </BarChart>
          </ResponsiveContainer>
        </ChartPanel>
        <ChartPanel title="Bajas por causa">
          <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height={280}>
            <BarChart data={data.exits} layout="vertical" margin={{ left: 24, right: 10 }}>
              <CartesianGrid strokeDasharray="3 3" />
              <XAxis type="number" allowDecimals={false} />
              <YAxis type="category" dataKey="cause" width={120} />
              <Tooltip />
              <Bar dataKey="animals" fill="#d64550" name="Animales" />
            </BarChart>
          </ResponsiveContainer>
        </ChartPanel>
      </div>
      <div className="grid three">
        <PiePanel title="Estado" rows={data.status} />
        <PiePanel title="Sexo" rows={data.sex} />
        <ListPanel title="Razas" rows={data.breeds} />
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

def export_animals(farm_id: int = Depends(current_farm_id), db: Session = Depends(get_db)) -> PlainTextResponse:
    rows = list_animals(farm_id=farm_id, db=db)
    output = StringIO()
    headers = [
        "crotal",
        "fecha_nacimiento",
        "sexo",
        "raza",
        "crotal_madre",
        "causa_alta",
        "fecha_alta",
        "procedencia",
        "causa_baja",
        "fecha_baja",
        "destino",
    ]
    output.write(",".join(headers) + "\n")
    for animal in rows:
        values = [getattr(animal, header) for header in headers]
        output.write(",".join('"' + str(value or "").replace('"', '""') + '"' for value in values) + "\n")
    return PlainTextResponse(output.getvalue(), media_type="text/csv", headers={"Content-Disposition": "attachment; filename=animales.csv"})

from datetime import date, datetime
from pathlib import Path
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.models import Animal

XML_FIELDS = {
    "crotal": "crotal",
    "fechaInicio": "fecha_inicio",
    "fechaFin": "fecha_fin",
    "explotacionPertenencia": "explotacion_pertenencia",
    "explotacionUbicacion": "explotacion_ubicacion",
    "fechaNacimiento": "fecha_nacimiento",
    "explotacionNacimiento": "explotacion_nacimiento",
    "sexo": "sexo",
    "raza": "raza",
    "crotalMadre": "crotal_madre",
    "causaAlta": "causa_alta",
    "fechaAlta": "fecha_alta",
    "procedencia": "procedencia",
    "CodigoLocalEntrada": "codigo_local_entrada",
    "CodigoREMOEntrada": "codigo_remo_entrada",
    "causaBaja": "causa_baja",
    "fechaBaja": "fecha_baja",
    "destino": "destino",
    "CodigoLocalSalida": "codigo_local_salida",
    "CodigoREMOSalida": "codigo_remo_salida",
}

DATE_FIELDS = {"fecha_inicio", "fecha_fin", "fecha_nacimiento", "fecha_alta", "fecha_baja"}


def parse_date(value: str | None) -> date | None:
    if not value or not value.strip():
        return None
    return datetime.strptime(value.strip(), "%d/%m/%Y").date()


def _text(element: ET.Element, field: str) -> str | None:
    child = element.find(f"{{*}}{field}")
    if child is None or child.text is None:
        return None
    value = child.text.strip()
    return value or None


def parse_xml(content: bytes) -> list[dict]:
    root = ET.fromstring(content)
    rows: list[dict] = []
    for animal in root.findall(".//{*}Animal"):
        row: dict = {}
        for xml_name, model_name in XML_FIELDS.items():
            value = _text(animal, xml_name)
            row[model_name] = parse_date(value) if model_name in DATE_FIELDS else value
        if row.get("crotal"):
            rows.append(row)
    return rows


def preview_xml(db: Session, filename: str, content: bytes, farm_id: int) -> dict[str, int | bool]:
    rows = parse_xml(content)
    incoming = {row["crotal"] for row in rows}
    existing = {
        value
        for (value,) in db.query(Animal.crotal)
        .filter(Animal.farm_id == farm_id, Animal.source_file == filename)
        .all()
    }
    farm_existing = {
        value for (value,) in db.query(Animal.crotal).filter(Animal.farm_id == farm_id).all()
    }
    return {
        "already_uploaded": bool(existing),
        "incoming_animals": len(incoming),
        "existing_animals": len(existing),
        "new_animals": len(incoming - farm_existing),

def list_animals(
    q: str | None = None,
    status: str | None = None,
    sexo: list[str] = Query(default_factory=list),
    raza: str | None = None,
    causa_baja: str | None = None,
    explotacion: str | None = None,
    born_from: date | None = None,
    born_to: date | None = None,
    farm_id: int = Depends(current_farm_id),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
) -> list[Animal]:
    query = db.query(Animal).filter(Animal.farm_id == farm_id)
    if q:
        pattern = f"%{q}%"
        query = query.filter(or_(Animal.crotal.ilike(pattern), Animal.crotal_madre.ilike(pattern), Animal.procedencia.ilike(pattern), Animal.destino.ilike(pattern)))
    if status == "Activo":
        query = query.filter(Animal.fecha_baja.is_(None), or_(Animal.causa_baja.is_(None), Animal.causa_baja == ""))
    if status == "Baja":
        query = query.filter(or_(Animal.fecha_baja.is_not(None), Animal.causa_baja.is_not(None) & (Animal.causa_baja != "")))
    if sexo:
        query = query.filter(Animal.sexo.in_(sexo))
    if raza:
        query = query.filter(Animal.raza == raza)
    if causa_baja:
        query = query.filter(Animal.causa_baja == causa_baja)
    if explotacion:
        query = query.filter(or_(Animal.explotacion_pertenencia == explotacion, Animal.explotacion_ubicacion == explotacion, Animal.explotacion_nacimiento == explotacion))
    if born_from:
        query = query.filter(Animal.fecha_nacimiento >= born_from)
    if born_to:
        query = query.filter(Animal.fecha_nacimiento <= born_to)
    return query.order_by(Animal.fecha_nacimiento.desc().nullslast(), Animal.crotal.asc()).all()


def _animal_by_crotal(db: Session, crotal: str, farm_id: int) -> Animal:
    animal = db.query(Animal).filter(Animal.farm_id == farm_id, Animal.crotal == crotal).first()
    if not animal:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Animal no encontrado")
    return animal

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import csv
import hashlib
import random
from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path

from sqlalchemy import func, or_

from app.database import SessionLocal, init_db
from app.models import Animal, AnimalLocation, AnimalLocationAssignment, Farm

WORKSPACE_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
DEFAULT_SOURCE_PATH = WORKSPACE_ROOT / "ubicaciones_animales.csv"


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class SourceLocation:
    row_number: int
    latitude: float
    longitude: float
    sha256: str


def normalize_coordinate(value: str) -> str:
    return f"{float(value.strip()):.8f}"


def fingerprint(source_path: Path, row_number: int, latitude: float, longitude: float) -> str:
    value = f"{source_path.resolve()}:{row_number}:{latitude:.8f},{longitude:.8f}"
    return hashlib.sha256(value.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()


def parse_location_value(value: str) -> tuple[float, float]:
    parts = [part.strip() for part in value.replace(";", ",").split(",")]
    if len(parts) != 2:
        raise ValueError(f"Ubicacion invalida: {value!r}")
    return float(parts[0]), float(parts[1])


def read_locations(path: Path, used_hashes: set[str]) -> tuple[list[SourceLocation], int, int]:
    if not path.exists():
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"No existe el CSV de ubicaciones: {path}")

    locations: list[SourceLocation] = []
    skipped_used = 0
    invalid_rows = 0
    seen_hashes = set(used_hashes)

    with path.open("r", encoding="utf-8-sig", newline="") as handle:
        reader = csv.DictReader(handle)
        for row_number, row in enumerate(reader, start=2):
            try:
                if "Ubicaciones" in row and row["Ubicaciones"]:
                    latitude, longitude = parse_location_value(row["Ubicaciones"])
                else:
                    raw_latitude = row.get("latitud") or row.get("latitude") or row.get("Latitud")
                    raw_longitude = row.get("longitud") or row.get("longitude") or row.get("Longitud")
                    if raw_latitude is None or raw_longitude is None:
                        raise ValueError("Faltan columnas de coordenadas")
                    latitude = float(raw_latitude)
                    longitude = float(raw_longitude)
            except (TypeError, ValueError):
                invalid_rows += 1
                continue

            key = fingerprint(path, row_number, latitude, longitude)
            if key in seen_hashes:
                skipped_used += 1
                continue
            seen_hashes.add(key)
            locations.append(SourceLocation(row_number=row_number, latitude=latitude, longitude=longitude, sha256=key))

    return locations, skipped_used, invalid_rows


def choose_animal_id(counts: dict[int, int], rng: random.Random) -> int:
    min_count = min(counts.values())
    candidates = [animal_id for animal_id, count in counts.items() if count == min_count]
    return rng.choice(candidates)


def active_animals_query(db, farm_id: int):
    return (
        db.query(Animal)
        .filter(Animal.farm_id == farm_id)
        .filter(Animal.fecha_baja.is_(None))
        .filter(or_(Animal.causa_baja.is_(None), Animal.causa_baja == ""))
        .order_by(Animal.id.asc())
    )


def _farm_id(db, farm_name: str | None) -> int:
    farms = db.query(Farm).order_by(Farm.id.asc()).all()
    if farm_name:
        farm = next((row for row in farms if row.name == farm_name), None)
        if not farm:
            raise RuntimeError(f"No existe la explotacion: {farm_name}")
        return farm.id
    if len(farms) != 1:
        raise RuntimeError("Indica --farm cuando exista mas de una explotacion")
    return farms[0].id


def assign_locations(source_path: Path, dry_run: bool = False, seed: int | None = None, farm_name: str | None = None) -> dict:
    init_db()
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    db = SessionLocal()
    try:
        farm_id = _farm_id(db, farm_name)
        animals = active_animals_query(db, farm_id).all()
        if not animals:
            raise RuntimeError("No hay animales activos cargados en la base de datos")

        used_hashes = {
            row[0]
            for row in db.query(AnimalLocationAssignment.source_sha256).filter(AnimalLocationAssignment.farm_id == farm_id).all()
        }
        source_locations, skipped_used, invalid_rows = read_locations(source_path, used_hashes)
        rng.shuffle(source_locations)

        existing_counts = dict(
            db.query(AnimalLocation.animal_id, func.count(AnimalLocation.id))
            .filter(AnimalLocation.animal_id.in_([animal.id for animal in animals]))
            .group_by(AnimalLocation.animal_id)
            .all()
        )
        counts = {animal.id: int(existing_counts.get(animal.id, 0)) for animal in animals}
        animal_by_id = {animal.id: animal for animal in animals}

        assignments: list[tuple[SourceLocation, int]] = []
        for source in source_locations:
            animal_id = choose_animal_id(counts, rng)
            assignments.append((source, animal_id))
            counts[animal_id] += 1

        summary = {
            "dry_run": dry_run,
            "source_path": str(source_path),
            "available_locations": len(source_locations),
            "skipped_used_locations": skipped_used,
            "invalid_rows": invalid_rows,
            "active_animals": len(animals),
            "animals_without_location_after": sum(1 for count in counts.values() if count == 0),
            "min_locations_per_active_animal_after": min(counts.values()),
            "max_locations_per_active_animal_after": max(counts.values()),
        }
        if dry_run:
            return {"planned_assignments": len(assignments), **summary}

        inserted = 0
        now = datetime.utcnow()
        for source, animal_id in assignments:
            location = AnimalLocation(
                animal_id=animal_id,
                latitude=source.latitude,
                longitude=source.longitude,
                recorded_at=now,
                source=f"bulk:{source_path.name}:row:{source.row_number}",
            )
            db.add(location)
            db.flush()
            db.add(
                AnimalLocationAssignment(
                    farm_id=farm_id,
                    animal_location_id=location.id,
                    animal_id=animal_id,
                    source_path=str(source_path),
                    source_row=source.row_number,
                    source_sha256=source.sha256,
                    latitude=source.latitude,
                    longitude=source.longitude,
                    assigned_by_bulk=True,
                )
            )
            inserted += 1

        db.commit()
        return {
            "assigned_locations": inserted,
            "sample": [
                {
                    "row": source.row_number,
                    "latitude": source.latitude,
                    "longitude": source.longitude,
                    "crotal": animal_by_id[animal_id].crotal,
                }
                for source, animal_id in assignments[:10]
            ],
            **summary,
        }
    finally:
        db.close()


def parse_args() -> argparse.Namespace:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Asigna ubicaciones aleatoriamente a animales activos sin reutilizar filas ya marcadas.")
    parser.add_argument("source_path", nargs="?", default=str(DEFAULT_SOURCE_PATH), help="CSV con ubicaciones.")
    parser.add_argument("--dry-run", action="store_true", help="Simula la asignacion sin escribir en base de datos.")
    parser.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=None, help="Semilla opcional para reproducir el orden aleatorio.")
    parser.add_argument("--farm", help="Nombre de la explotacion a la que se asignan las ubicaciones.")
    return parser.parse_args()


def main() -> None:
    args = parse_args()
    result = assign_locations(Path(args.source_path).resolve(), dry_run=args.dry_run, seed=args.seed, farm_name=args.farm)
    for key, value in result.items():

    """Exporta ubicaciones actuales y ocho pasos simulados de 200 m, sin modificar SQLite."""
    import csv
    import math
    import random
    import sqlite3
    from pathlib import Path
    
    ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
    OUTPUT = ROOT / 'historico_ubicaciones_animales.csv'
    EARTH_RADIUS_M = 6371008.8
    SEED = 20260929
    
    
    def destination(latitude, longitude, bearing, meters=200):
        lat, lon, azimuth = map(math.radians, (latitude, longitude, bearing))
        angular = meters / EARTH_RADIUS_M
        new_lat = math.asin(math.sin(lat) * math.cos(angular) + math.cos(lat) * math.sin(angular) * math.cos(azimuth))
        new_lon = lon + math.atan2(math.sin(azimuth) * math.sin(angular) * math.cos(lat), math.cos(angular) - math.sin(lat) * math.sin(new_lat))
        return math.degrees(new_lat), (math.degrees(new_lon) + 180) % 360 - 180
    
    
    def distance(lat1, lon1, lat2, lon2):
        lat1, lon1, lat2, lon2 = map(math.radians, (lat1, lon1, lat2, lon2))
        a = math.sin((lat2-lat1)/2)**2 + math.cos(lat1)*math.cos(lat2)*math.sin((lon2-lon1)/2)**2
        return 2 * EARTH_RADIUS_M * math.asin(min(1, math.sqrt(a)))
    
    
    def main():
        rng = random.Random(SEED)
        with sqlite3.connect(f'{(ROOT / "backend/cows.db").as_uri()}?mode=ro', uri=True) as db:
            db.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
            # Si hay fechas iguales, se elige el registro de mayor id de forma determinista.
            animals = db.execute('''
                SELECT a.id AS animal_id, a.crotal, f.name AS explotacion,
                       l.id AS ubicacion_id, l.latitude, l.longitude, l.recorded_at, l.source
                FROM animals a JOIN farms f ON f.id=a.farm_id
                JOIN animal_locations l ON l.id=(
                    SELECT id FROM animal_locations WHERE animal_id=a.id
                    ORDER BY recorded_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
                ) ORDER BY f.id, a.crotal
            ''').fetchall()
            missing = db.execute('''SELECT count(*) FROM animals a WHERE NOT EXISTS
                (SELECT 1 FROM animal_locations l WHERE l.animal_id=a.id)''').fetchone()[0]
        fields = ['explotacion', 'animal_id', 'crotal', 'paso', 'tipo_ubicacion', 'latitud', 'longitud',
                  'distancia_anterior_m', 'rumbo_grados', 'ubicacion_base_id', 'fecha_ubicacion_base', 'origen_ubicacion_base']
        with OUTPUT.open('w', encoding='utf-8-sig', newline='') as handle:
            writer = csv.DictWriter(handle, fieldnames=fields)
            writer.writeheader()
            for animal in animals:
                lat, lon = animal['latitude'], animal['longitude']
                if not (-90 <= lat <= 90 and -180 <= lon <= 180):
                    raise ValueError(f'Coordenadas inválidas: {animal["animal_id"]}')
                for step in range(9):
                    bearing = rng.uniform(0, 360) if step else None
                    if step:
                        lat, lon = destination(lat, lon, bearing)
                    writer.writerow(dict(explotacion=animal['explotacion'], animal_id=animal['animal_id'],
                        crotal=animal['crotal'], paso=step, tipo_ubicacion='simulada' if step else 'actual',
                        latitud=f'{lat:.10f}', longitud=f'{lon:.10f}', distancia_anterior_m=200 if step else 0,
                        rumbo_grados=f'{bearing:.6f}' if step else '', ubicacion_base_id=animal['ubicacion_id'],
                        fecha_ubicacion_base=animal['recorded_at'], origen_ubicacion_base=animal['source'] or ''))
        # Verificación del archivo ya escrito, incluida la precisión tras redondear las coordenadas.
        with OUTPUT.open(encoding='utf-8-sig', newline='') as handle:
            rows = list(csv.DictReader(handle))
        assert len(rows) == len(animals) * 9
        errors = []
        for index, animal in enumerate(animals):
            group = rows[index*9:(index+1)*9]
            assert [int(r['paso']) for r in group] == list(range(9))
            assert all(int(r['animal_id']) == animal['animal_id'] for r in group)
            assert abs(float(group[0]['latitud']) - animal['latitude']) < 1e-9
            assert abs(float(group[0]['longitud']) - animal['longitude']) < 1e-9
            for previous, current in zip(group, group[1:]):
                measured = distance(float(previous['latitud']), float(previous['longitud']), float(current['latitud']), float(current['longitud']))
                errors.append(abs(measured - 200))
        assert max(errors, default=0) < 0.001
        print(f'{OUTPUT.name}: {len(animals)} animales, {len(rows)} filas; {missing} animales sin ubicación omitidos.')
        print(f'Pasos comprobados: {len(errors)}; error máximo de distancia: {max(errors, default=0):.6f} m (modelo esférico).')
    
    
    if __name__ == '__main__':
        main()

    # Histórico simulado de ubicaciones de CowsIA
    
    Archivo: `historico_ubicaciones_animales.csv`. Generado el 29/09/2026 desde la base de datos actual, sin modificarla.
    
    - Incluye las dos explotaciones: 125 animales con ubicación por explotación, 250 registros de animales y 2.250 filas de coordenadas en total. Un crotal puede aparecer en ambas explotaciones; identifica cada recorrido por `explotacion` y `animal_id`.
    - Cada recorrido contiene nueve filas: `paso=0` conserva la ubicación actual y los pasos 1 a 8 son posiciones simuladas. Los 406 registros de animales sin ubicación (203 por explotación) se omiten porque carecen de punto de partida.
    - La ubicación actual es el registro con fecha más reciente en `animal_locations`; en caso de empate se toma el mayor identificador. Se conserva su identificador, fecha y origen, incluida la referencia a la fila del CSV original cuando existe.
    - Cada paso simulado utiliza un rumbo aleatorio independiente y se encuentra a 200 metros del paso anterior, no necesariamente a 200 metros del punto inicial. El cálculo usa un modelo terrestre esférico de radio medio 6.371.008,8 metros. Las coordenadas se expresan en grados decimales con diez decimales.
    - Son posiciones sintéticas, sin restricciones de cercados o terreno. No representan desplazamientos observados ni se han importado en CowsIA.
    - `fecha_ubicacion_base` es la fecha del punto de partida para todo el recorrido. No se inventan fechas para los pasos simulados; su secuencia la determina `paso`.
    - `distancia_anterior_m` vale 0 en el punto inicial y 200 en los ocho siguientes. `rumbo_grados` se mide desde el norte en sentido horario y queda vacío en el punto inicial.
    - Formato CSV: UTF-8 con BOM, separador coma y punto decimal. En Excel puede abrirse mediante «Datos → Desde texto/CSV» si la configuración regional no separa las columnas automáticamente.
    
    Se han comprobado los 2.000 segmentos del archivo generado y la conservación de las posiciones iniciales. El error por redondeo es inferior a 0,001 metros dentro del modelo esférico empleado.
    
    Para regenerar el archivo con los datos disponibles en ese momento:
    
    ```bash
    python3 scripts/generar_historico_ubicaciones.py
    ```
    
    El generador utiliza una semilla fija para que el resultado sea reproducible si los datos de origen no cambian. Su ejecución reemplaza el CSV generado.
    EOF

def animal_details(crotal: str, farm_id: int = Depends(current_farm_id), db: Session = Depends(get_db)) -> dict:
    animal = _animal_by_crotal(db, crotal, farm_id)
    offspring = []
    if (animal.sexo or "").strip().casefold() == "hembra":
        offspring = db.query(Animal).filter(
            Animal.farm_id == farm_id,
            func.lower(func.trim(Animal.crotal_madre)) == animal.crotal.strip().lower(),
            Animal.id != animal.id,
        ).order_by(Animal.fecha_nacimiento.desc().nullslast(), Animal.crotal.asc()).all()
    offspring_images = {}
    if offspring:
        for image in db.query(AnimalImage).filter(
            AnimalImage.animal_id.in_([row.id for row in offspring]),
            AnimalImage.is_primary.is_(True),
        ).order_by(AnimalImage.id.asc()).all():
            offspring_images.setdefault(image.animal_id, f"/api/animal-images/{image.id}/file")
    images = db.query(AnimalImage).filter(AnimalImage.animal_id == animal.id).order_by(AnimalImage.is_primary.desc(), AnimalImage.created_at.asc(), AnimalImage.id.asc()).all()
    locations = db.query(AnimalLocation).filter(AnimalLocation.animal_id == animal.id).order_by(AnimalLocation.recorded_at.desc()).all()
    events = db.query(AnimalEvent).filter(AnimalEvent.animal_id == animal.id).order_by(AnimalEvent.event_date.desc().nullslast(), AnimalEvent.created_at.desc()).all()
    return {
        "animal": animal,
        "offspring": [{
            "crotal": row.crotal,
            "fecha_nacimiento": row.fecha_nacimiento,
            "sexo": row.sexo,
            "image_url": offspring_images.get(row.id),
        } for row in offspring],
        "images": [_image_out(row) for row in images],
        "locations": locations,
        "events": [_event_out(row) for row in events],
    }

    """Read simulated routes without changing recorded animal locations."""
    import csv
    import math
    from pathlib import Path
    
    HISTORY_PATH = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / 'historico_ubicaciones_animales.csv'
    
    
    def animal_location_history(animal, farm_name, locations, path=None):
        path = path or HISTORY_PATH
        points = []
        if path.is_file():
            with path.open(encoding='utf-8-sig', newline='') as source:
                for row in csv.DictReader(source):
                    if (row.get('explotacion') != farm_name
                            or row.get('animal_id') != str(animal.id)
                            or row.get('crotal', '').casefold() != animal.crotal.casefold()):
                        continue
                    try:
                        latitude, longitude = float(row['latitud']), float(row['longitud'])
                        step = int(row['paso'])
                        if not (math.isfinite(latitude) and math.isfinite(longitude)
                                and -90 <= latitude <= 90 and -180 <= longitude <= 180 and step >= 0):
                            continue
                        if row['tipo_ubicacion'] not in ('actual', 'simulada'):
                            continue
                        points.append(dict(step=step, latitude=latitude, longitude=longitude,
                            simulated=row['tipo_ubicacion'] == 'simulada',
                            recorded_at=row.get('fecha_ubicacion_base') if step == 0 else None))
                    except (KeyError, TypeError, ValueError):
                        continue
        if points:
            return sorted(points, key=lambda point: point['step'])
        return [dict(step=index, latitude=row.latitude, longitude=row.longitude,
                     simulated=False, recorded_at=row.recorded_at)
                for index, row in enumerate(sorted(locations, key=lambda row: (row.recorded_at, row.id)))]

function CowsMap({ refreshKey }) {
  const [rows, setRows] = useState([]);
  const [selectedAnimal, setSelectedAnimal] = useState(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    api.get("/api/map/locations").then(setRows);
  }, [refreshKey]);

  const center = useMemo(() => {
    if (rows.length === 0) return [39.96, -6.48];
    const lat = rows.reduce((sum, row) => sum + row.latitude, 0) / rows.length;
    const lng = rows.reduce((sum, row) => sum + row.longitude, 0) / rows.length;
    return [lat, lng];
  }, [rows]);

  return (
    <section className="page map-page">
      <PageTitle title="Mapa" />
      <div className="map-summary">
        <span>{rows.length} animales con ubicacion</span>
      </div>
      <div className="map-panel">
        <MapContainer key={`${center[0]}-${center[1]}-${rows.length}`} center={center} zoom={15} scrollWheelZoom className="animal-map">
          <TileLayer
            attribution='&copy; <a href="https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright">OpenStreetMap</a>'
            url="https://{s}.tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png"
          />
          {rows.map((row) => (
            <Marker key={`${row.animal_id}-${row.latitude}-${row.longitude}`} position={[row.latitude, row.longitude]} icon={animalMarkerIcon}>
              <Popup>
                <div className="map-popup">
                  {row.image_url && <img src={api.url(row.image_url)} alt={row.crotal} />}
                  <strong>{row.crotal}</strong>
                  <span>{row.sexo || "Sin sexo"} · {row.age_years === null ? "Sin edad" : `${row.age_years} anos`}</span>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() =>
                      setSelectedAnimal({
                        crotal: row.crotal,
                        sexo: row.sexo,
                        fecha_nacimiento: row.fecha_nacimiento,
                      })
                    }
                  >
                    Abrir ficha
                  </button>
                </div>
              </Popup>
            </Marker>
          ))}
        </MapContainer>
      </div>
      {selectedAnimal && <AnimalDetail animal={selectedAnimal} onClose={() => setSelectedAnimal(null)} onChanged={() => api.get("/api/map/locations").then(setRows)} />}
    </section>
  );
}

    import { chromium } from 'playwright';
    const browser = await chromium.launch({headless:true});
    try {
     const page = await browser.newPage({viewport:{width:1440,height:1000}});
     const errors=[];page.on('pageerror',e=>errors.push(e.message));
     await page.goto('http://127.0.0.1:8081');
     await page.getByLabel('Usuario').fill(process.env.COWSIA_USERNAME);
     await page.getByLabel('Contrasena',{exact:true}).fill(process.env.COWSIA_PASSWORD);
     await page.getByRole('button',{name:'Entrar',exact:true}).click();
     await page.locator('nav').getByRole('button',{name:'Mapa',exact:true}).click();
     await page.locator('.animal-map-marker').first().waitFor();
     const count=await page.locator('.animal-map-marker').count();
     await page.locator('.animal-map-marker').first().click({force:true});
     await page.waitForFunction(()=>document.querySelectorAll('.history-marker').length===9);
     await page.locator('.map-popup').waitFor();
     const first=await page.locator('.map-popup strong').innerText();
     if(!(await page.locator('.map-route-summary').innerText()).includes(first))throw Error('Wrong animal route');
     if(await page.locator('.animal-map-marker').count()!==count)throw Error('Animals disappeared');
     await page.waitForTimeout(1200);
     await page.screenshot({path:'../capturas_cowsia/mapa-principal-historico.png'});
     await page.locator('.leaflet-popup-close-button').click();
     await page.locator('.animal-map-marker').nth(1).click({force:true});
     await page.waitForTimeout(1000);
     const second=await page.locator('.map-popup strong').innerText();
     if(first===second || !(await page.locator('.map-route-summary').innerText()).includes(second))throw Error('Selection did not update');
     if(await page.locator('.history-marker').count()!==9)throw Error('Wrong route count');
     await page.getByRole('button',{name:'Ocultar recorrido'}).click();
     if(await page.locator('.history-marker').count()!==0)throw Error('Route not cleared');
     await page.getByRole('button',{name:'Abrir ficha',exact:true}).click();
     await page.locator('.detail-content').waitFor();
     if(errors.length)throw Error(errors.join('\n'));
     console.log('Verificado: recorrido de nueve puntos, cambio de animal, ocultar recorrido, popup y apertura de ficha. Marcadores conservados:',count);
    } finally {await browser.close();}
    JS
