$ cat scripts/download_incident_images.mjs
import { access, mkdir, readFile, writeFile } from "node:fs/promises";
import { basename, resolve } from "node:path";

const outputDirectory = resolve("imagenes_incidencias");
const apiUrl = "https://commons.wikimedia.org/w/api.php";
const allowedLicense = /(CC0|Public domain|CC BY(?:-SA)?)/i;
const topics = [
  ["herida_animal", "cattle wound veterinary"],
  ["cojera_revision_pata", "cattle hoof lameness"],
  ["celo_reproduccion", "cattle mounting cow mating"],
  ["vacunacion", "cattle vaccination veterinarian"],
  ["parto", "cow giving birth calf calving"],
  ["revision_veterinaria", "veterinarian examining cattle"],
  ["alimentacion", "cattle feeding trough"],
  ["ataque_dep_referencia", "wolf cattle livestock"],
  ["alambrada_danada", "broken livestock fence"],
  ["huellas_fauna", "wild animal tracks footprint"],
  ["averia_bebedero", "cattle water trough"],
  ["pastor_electrico", "electric fence livestock"],
  ["arbol_caido", "fallen tree rural road"],
  ["inundacion_erosion", "flooded farm field erosion"],
  ["riesgo_incendio", "grassland wildfire smoke"],
  ["residuos_vertido", "illegal dumping rural land"],
  ["puerta_acceso", "farm gate field"],
  ["plaga_invasora", "invasive plant agricultural field"],
];

// Seleccion manual para evitar resultados libres pero poco representativos.
// Si un titulo dejase de estar disponible, se usa la busqueda del tema como respaldo.
const curatedTitles = new Map([
  ["cojera_revision_pata", "Klauenpflege Kuh 9781.jpg"],
  ["celo_reproduccion", "Bull and cows in Amurrio 2018 02.jpg"],
  ["parto", "Cow with calf.jpg"],
  ["ataque_dep_referencia", "Gray Wolf Standing in Snowy Woods (24334459075).jpg"],
  ["alambrada_danada", "A broken fence^ - geograph.org.uk - 3587816.jpg"],
  ["huellas_fauna", "Wolf tracks (17292442642).jpg"],
  ["averia_bebedero", "Portabe water trough for livestock animal.jpg"],
  ["inundacion_erosion", "Flooded Cornfield (11066575366).jpg"],
  ["residuos_vertido", "Illegal dumping on public lands in the Medford District (18994171538).jpg"],
  ["puerta_acceso", "Field gate and fence at Monkton Kent England.jpg"],
  ["plaga_invasora", "Weeds on the field edge - geograph.org.uk - 8380102.jpg"],
]);

function plain(value = "") {
  return value.replace(/<[^>]*>/g, "").replace(/&amp;/g, "&").replace(/&quot;/g, '"').trim();
}

async function fetchWithRetry(url, options, attempts = 4) {
  for (let attempt = 1; attempt <= attempts; attempt += 1) {
    const response = await fetch(url, { ...options, signal: AbortSignal.timeout(30000) });
    if (response.status !== 429 || attempt === attempts) return response;
    const retryAfter = Number(response.headers.get("retry-after")) || attempt * 3;
    await new Promise((resolveDelay) => setTimeout(resolveDelay, retryAfter * 1000));
  }
  throw new Error("No se pudo completar la solicitud");
}

function imageFromPage(page) {
  const info = page?.imageinfo?.[0];
  const meta = info?.extmetadata || {};
  if (!info?.thumburl || !/^image\/(jpeg|png|webp)$/i.test(info.mime || "")) return null;
  if (!allowedLicense.test(meta.LicenseShortName?.value || "")) return null;
  return { page, info, meta };
}

async function findFreeImageByTitle(title) {
  const params = new URLSearchParams({
    action: "query",
    titles: `File:${title}`,
    prop: "imageinfo",
    iiprop: "url|mime|extmetadata",
    iiurlwidth: "1280",
    format: "json",
    origin: "*",
  });
  const response = await fetchWithRetry(`${apiUrl}?${params}`, { headers: { "User-Agent": "CowsIA/1.0 incident-image-library" } }, 6);
  if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`Commons respondio ${response.status} para ${title}`);
  const payload = await response.json();
  const page = Object.values(payload.query?.pages || {})[0];
  return imageFromPage(page);
}

async function findFreeImage(query) {
  const params = new URLSearchParams({
    action: "query",
    generator: "search",
    gsrsearch: `${query} filetype:bitmap`,
    gsrnamespace: "6",
    gsrlimit: "20",
    prop: "imageinfo",
    iiprop: "url|mime|extmetadata",
    iiurlwidth: "1280",
    format: "json",
    origin: "*",
  });
  const response = await fetchWithRetry(`${apiUrl}?${params}`, { headers: { "User-Agent": "CowsIA/1.0 incident-image-library" } });
  if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`Commons respondio ${response.status} para ${query}`);
  const payload = await response.json();
  const pages = Object.values(payload.query?.pages || {});
  return pages
    .map(imageFromPage)
    .filter(Boolean)
    .sort((a, b) => {
      const aJpeg = a.info.mime === "image/jpeg" ? 1 : 0;
      const bJpeg = b.info.mime === "image/jpeg" ? 1 : 0;
      return bJpeg - aJpeg;
    })[0];
}

await mkdir(outputDirectory, { recursive: true });
let previousRecords = [];
try {
  previousRecords = JSON.parse(await readFile(resolve(outputDirectory, "licencias.json"), "utf8"));
} catch {
  previousRecords = [];
}
const recordsByTopic = new Map(previousRecords.map((record) => [record.topic, record]));

async function persistRecords() {
  const records = topics.map(([slug]) => recordsByTopic.get(slug)).filter(Boolean);
  await writeFile(resolve(outputDirectory, "licencias.json"), `${JSON.stringify(records, null, 2)}\n`);
  const markdown = [
    "# Imágenes de incidencias",
    "",
    "Imágenes descargadas de Wikimedia Commons. Debe conservarse esta atribución al publicar o redistribuir los recursos.",
    "",
    ...records.flatMap((record) => [
      `## ${record.topic}`,
      "",
      `- Archivo local: \`${record.file}\``,
      `- Título: ${record.title}`,
      `- Autor: ${record.author}`,
      `- Licencia: [${record.license}](${record.license_url || record.source})`,
      `- Fuente: [Wikimedia Commons](${record.source})`,
      "",
    ]),
  ];
  await writeFile(resolve(outputDirectory, "LICENCIAS.md"), `${markdown.join("\n")}\n`);
  return records;
}

for (const [slug, query] of topics) {
  const previous = recordsByTopic.get(slug);
  const curatedTitle = curatedTitles.get(slug);
  const alreadyHasCuratedSelection = curatedTitle && previous?.title === curatedTitle;
  if (previous && (!curatedTitle || alreadyHasCuratedSelection)) {
    try {
      await access(resolve(outputDirectory, previous.file));
      console.log(`${slug}: ya descargada (${previous.license})`);
      continue;
    } catch {
      // El fichero desaparecio: se vuelve a descargar.
    }
  }
  try {
    let found = curatedTitle ? await findFreeImageByTitle(curatedTitle) : null;
    if (curatedTitle && !found) console.warn(`Seleccion no disponible o sin licencia compatible: ${curatedTitle}`);
    found ||= await findFreeImage(query);
    if (!found) {
      console.warn(`Sin resultado libre: ${slug}`);
      continue;
    }
    const extension = found.info.mime === "image/png" ? ".png" : found.info.mime === "image/webp" ? ".webp" : ".jpg";
    const fileName = `${slug}${extension}`;
    const cleanDownloadUrl = new URL(found.info.thumburl);
    cleanDownloadUrl.search = "";
    const imageResponse = await fetchWithRetry(cleanDownloadUrl, { headers: { "User-Agent": "CowsIA/1.0 incident-image-library" } });
    if (!imageResponse.ok) throw new Error(`descarga HTTP ${imageResponse.status}`);
    await writeFile(resolve(outputDirectory, fileName), Buffer.from(await imageResponse.arrayBuffer()));
    const record = {
      topic: slug,
      query,
      file: fileName,
      title: found.page.title.replace(/^File:/, ""),
      author: plain(found.meta.Artist?.value || found.meta.Credit?.value || "Autor indicado en Wikimedia Commons"),
      license: plain(found.meta.LicenseShortName?.value || ""),
      license_url: found.meta.LicenseUrl?.value || "",
      source: found.info.descriptionurl,
      downloaded_url: cleanDownloadUrl.toString(),
    };
    recordsByTopic.set(slug, record);
    await persistRecords();
    console.log(`${slug}: ${record.title} (${record.license})`);
  } catch (error) {
    console.warn(`No se pudo guardar ${slug}: ${error.message}`);
  }
  await new Promise((resolveDelay) => setTimeout(resolveDelay, 2500));
}

const records = await persistRecords();
console.log(`\n${records.length}/${topics.length} imagenes guardadas en ${basename(outputDirectory)}`);

    cat > scripts/buscar_incidencias_bovinos.py <<'PY'
    import json, time, urllib.request, urllib.parse
    from pathlib import Path
    ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
    OUT=ROOT/'imagenes_incidencias_animales'/'fuentes'
    OUT.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    API='https://commons.wikimedia.org/w/api.php'
    def query(params):
        url=API+'?'+urllib.parse.urlencode(dict(action='query',format='json',**params))
        for attempt in range(4):
            try:
                req=urllib.request.Request(url,headers={'User-Agent':'CowsIA/1.0 (educational veterinary image collection)'})
                with urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=35) as r:return json.load(r)
            except Exception:
                if attempt==3:raise
                time.sleep(3*(attempt+1))
        return {}
    roots=['Diseases and disorders of cattle','Wounded cattle','Diseases and disorders of the eyes in cattle','Digital diseases in cattle','Hoof care in cattle','Cattle with ear tags','Cattle without ear tags','Dehorning of cattle','Veterinary medicine in cattle','Calving']
    queue=[('Category:'+x,0) for x in roots];seen=set();files={};errors=[]
    while queue:
        cat,depth=queue.pop(0)
        if cat in seen:continue
        seen.add(cat)
        if any(x in cat.lower() for x in ['bulletin','book','egypt','histopathology','virus','bacteria','micrograph','the diseases and disorders of the ox']):continue
        cont={}
        try:
            while True:
                data=query(dict(list='categorymembers',cmtitle=cat,cmlimit=500,**cont))
                for row in data.get('query',{}).get('categorymembers',[]):
                    title=row['title']
                    if row['ns']==14 and depth<2:queue.append((title,depth+1))
                    if row['ns']==6 and title.lower().endswith(('.jpg','.jpeg','.png','.webp')):
                        files.setdefault(title,[]).append(cat)
                if 'continue' not in data:break
                cont=data['continue']
            print(cat,len(files),flush=True)
        except Exception as e:errors.append([cat,str(e)])
        time.sleep(.3)
    (OUT/'commons_categories.json').write_text(json.dumps(files,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
    records=[]
    for start in range(0,len(files),40):
        titles=list(files)[start:start+40]
        try:
            data=query(dict(titles='|'.join(titles),prop='imageinfo',iiprop='url|mime|sha1|extmetadata',iiurlwidth=640))
            for page in data.get('query',{}).get('pages',{}).values():
                info=page.get('imageinfo',[{}])[0]
                if not info.get('url'):continue
                records.append(dict(title=page['title'],categories=files.get(page['title'],[]),info=info))
            print('Metadatos',len(records),flush=True)
        except Exception as e:errors.append([titles,str(e)])
        (OUT/'commons_candidates.json').write_text(json.dumps(records,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
        time.sleep(.4)
    (OUT/'search_errors.json').write_text(json.dumps(errors,indent=2))
    print('TOTAL',len(records),flush=True)
    PY

    import urllib.request, urllib.parse, http.cookiejar, re, json, html, time
    from pathlib import Path
    from html.parser import HTMLParser
    ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]/'imagenes_incidencias_animales'/'fuentes'
    ROOT.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    opener=urllib.request.build_opener(urllib.request.HTTPCookieProcessor(http.cookiejar.CookieJar()))
    def get(url,data=None):
        req=urllib.request.Request(url,data=data,headers={'User-Agent':'CowsIA/1.0 veterinary-image-library'})
        for attempt in range(3):
            try:
                with opener.open(req,timeout=30) as r:return r.read().decode('utf-8')
            except Exception:
                if attempt==2:raise
                time.sleep(2)
    class Inputs(HTMLParser):
        def __init__(self):super().__init__();self.fields={}
        def handle_starttag(self,tag,attrs):
            a=dict(attrs)
            if tag=='input' and a.get('type')=='hidden' and a.get('name'):self.fields[a['name']]=a.get('value','')
    def plain(s):return html.unescape(re.sub('<[^>]+>',' ',s)).strip()
    def span(s,id):
        m=re.search(r'<span[^>]*id="'+id+r'"[^>]*>(.*?)</span>',s,re.S)
        return plain(m[1]) if m else ''
    url='https://wwwn.cdc.gov/phil/AdvancedSearchResults.aspx?Search=Cattle+Diseases&catid=5607&parentid=2965'
    s=get(url);ids=set()
    for page in range(1,8):
        ids.update(re.findall(r'pid=(\d+)',s))
        print('CDC página',page,'imágenes',len(ids),flush=True)
        if page==7:break
        parser=Inputs();parser.feed(s)
        target=re.search(r'href="javascript:__doPostBack\(&#39;([^&]+)&#39;,&#39;&#39;\)">'+str(page+1)+r'</a>',s)
        if not target:break
        fields=parser.fields;fields.update(__EVENTTARGET=html.unescape(target[1]),__EVENTARGUMENT='')
        s=get(url,urllib.parse.urlencode(fields).encode())
        time.sleep(.3)
    records=[]
    for id in sorted(ids,key=int):
        try:
            source=f'https://wwwn.cdc.gov/phil/Details.aspx?pid={id}'
            s=get(source)
            img=re.search(r'<img[^>]*id="imgURL1"[^>]*src="([^"]+)"',s)
            desc=span(s,'lblDesc')
            pd='This image is in the public domain' in s
            record=dict(id=id,source=source,image_url=html.unescape(img[1]) if img else '',description=desc,author=span(s,'lblContprov'),public_domain=pd)
            records.append(record)
            (ROOT/f'cdc_{id}.html').write_text(s)
            (ROOT/'cdc_candidates.json').write_text(json.dumps(records,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
            print(id,desc[:95],pd,flush=True)
        except Exception as e:print('ERROR',id,str(e),flush=True)
        time.sleep(.2)
    PY

            if re.search(pattern,t):return label
        return 'otras_incidencias'
    # Prefer external clinical signs; exclude microscopy, human disease, isolated insects,
    # internal necropsies and photographs showing no animal lesion.
    exclude_cdc=set(map(str,[5435,5436,5439,8527,8529,12885,12886,12887,12888,12892,12922,12923,12924,12925,
    16189,16190,16191,16192,16193,16194,16195,16480,16481,16482,22871,22872,22873,22886,22887,
    24046,24061,24062,24738,26535,26695,28063,28421,28422,28423,28424,30240,12847,12848,12849,12850,12851,12852]))
    curated_commons={
    'Sindrome vatche djus.jpg','Amniotic sac cow (01).jpg','Angus cattle 25.jpg',
    'Mastitis Affected Cow Receiving Treatment(GN04744).jpg','Mastitis Affected Cows(GN04746).jpg',
    'Rinderpest milk fever.jpg','Avnance del minêyolodjince.jpg','Dieles vea.jpg','Botnire rexhowe.jpg',
    'Ontginning, vee, turfsteekreportages, geboortes, kalveren, mannen, Bestanddeelnr 165-0834.jpg',
    'Ontginning, vee, turfsteekreportages, geboortes, kalveren, mannen, Bestanddeelnr 165-0835.jpg',
    'Ontginning, vee, turfsteekreportages, geboortes, kalveren, mannen, Bestanddeelnr 165-0836.jpg',
    }
    candidates=[]
    for x in json.loads((SOURCES/'cdc_candidates.json').read_text()):
        if x['id'] in exclude_cdc or not x['public_domain'] or not x['image_url']:continue
        d=x['description'];clinical=re.sub(r'^From the .*?this ','',d)
        if not re.search(r'bovin|cow|cattle|steer|calf|calves',d,re.I):continue
        if re.search('photomicrograph|micrograph|necropsy|dissection|human|patient[’\']s',clinical,re.I):continue
        candidates.append(dict(id='cdc_'+x['id'],source=x['source'],download_url=x['image_url'],title='CDC PHIL '+x['id'],
            description=d,author=x['author'],license='Dominio público (CDC PHIL; conservar atribución)',
            license_url='https://www.cdc.gov/other/agencymaterials.html',license_statement=x['license_statement'],category=category(clinical)))
    for x in json.loads((SOURCES/'commons_candidates.json').read_text()):
        name=x['title'].removeprefix('File:');info=x['info'];m=info.get('extmetadata',{})
        license=m.get('LicenseShortName',{}).get('value','')
        if license not in ('Public domain','CC0') or name not in curated_commons:continue
        desc=clean(m.get('ImageDescription',{}).get('value',''))
        candidates.append(dict(id='commons_'+hashlib.sha1(name.encode()).hexdigest()[:12],source=info['descriptionurl'],
            download_url=info.get('thumburl') or info['url'],title=name,description=desc,author=clean(m.get('Artist',{}).get('value','')),
            license=license,license_url=m.get('LicenseUrl',{}).get('value',''),license_statement=license,category=category(name+' '+desc)))
    (SOURCES/'selected_candidates.json').write_text(json.dumps(candidates,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
    records=[];errors=[];hashes=set();pixels=set()
    for x in candidates:
        path=ROOT/(x['category']+'_'+x['id']+'.jpg')
        try:
            if path.exists():img=Image.open(path);img.load()
            else:
                for attempt in range(4):
                    try:
                        req=urllib.request.Request(x['download_url'],headers={'User-Agent':'CowsIA/1.0 veterinary image library'})
                        with urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=35) as response:
                            content=response.read(12*1024*1024+1)
                        if len(content)>12*1024*1024:raise ValueError('Imagen demasiado grande')
                        img=Image.open(io.BytesIO(content));img.load();break
                    except Exception:
                        if attempt==3:raise
                        time.sleep((attempt+1)*3)
                img=ImageOps.exif_transpose(img).convert('RGB');img.thumbnail((640,640),Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)
            pixelhash=hashlib.sha256(img.convert('RGB').tobytes()).hexdigest()
            if pixelhash in pixels:
                errors.append(dict(id=x['id'],reason='Duplicado visual exacto'));continue
            pixels.add(pixelhash)
            for quality in [82,75,65,55]:
                buf=io.BytesIO();img.convert('RGB').save(buf,format='JPEG',quality=quality,optimize=True)
                data=buf.getvalue()
                if len(data)<=100_000:break
            digest=hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
            if digest in hashes:continue
            hashes.add(digest);path.write_bytes(data)
            records.append(dict(x,file=path.name,width=img.width,height=img.height,bytes=len(data),sha256=digest,downloaded_at='2026-09-29',changes='Reducción proporcional a máximo 640 px y compresión JPEG; sin recortes ni alteración del contenido.'))
            (ROOT/'catalogo.json').write_text(json.dumps(records,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
            print(len(records),path.name,len(data),flush=True)
        except Exception as e:errors.append(dict(id=x['id'],reason=str(e)));print('ERROR',x['id'],str(e),flush=True)
        time.sleep(.3)
    (SOURCES/'download_errors.json').write_text(json.dumps(errors,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
    # Contact sheets are kept outside the deliverable image directory, for visual review only.
    for start in range(0,len(records),30):
        sheet=Image.new('RGB',(1000,6*150),'white');draw=ImageDraw.Draw(sheet)
        for i,r in enumerate(records[start:start+30]):
            image=Image.open(ROOT/r['file']);image.thumbnail((190,120))
            x=(i%5)*200;y=(i//5)*150
            sheet.paste(image,(x,y));draw.text((x,y+121),r['id'],fill='black')
        sheet.save('/tmp/cowsia-incidencias-contacto-'+str(start//30)+'.jpg')
    print('TOTAL',len(records),flush=True)

18724 This 1970 photograph depicted a herd of cattle that were being farmed in a region near San Angelo, Texas, where a coccidioidomycosis study was being conducted.
18836 Captured somewhere in northern India, during a 1974 trip made by Centers for Disease Control (CDC) personnel to that region, this image depicts a very young calf lying on brown, grassy ground experiencing severe lethargy, due to a genetic disorder affecting bovine species known as anasarca, which involves pulmonary hypoplasia, i.e., poorly-developed lungs, and subcutaneous edema.
20427 Under a magnification of 200X, this image depicted an  Actinomyces bovis  bacterial microcolony, which had been cultivated for a 48-hour time period, on a growth medium of brain heart infusion (BHI) agar that had been inoculated with a bacterial specimen derived from a cow isolate.
20428 This image depicted  Actinomyces bovis  bacterial colonies of the intermediate-type, which had been cultivated for a time period of 5, to 8-days, on a growth medium of brain heart infusion (BHI) agar that had been inoculated with a bacterial specimen derived from a cow isolate.
20432 This image depicted a left lateral view of a cow’s head, on which you can see crusty, rough, cutaneous lesions, in a case of bovine actinomycosis, also referred to as lumpy jaw, caused by the bacterium,  Actinomyces bovis .
21833 This image depicted a member of a Mexican cattle herd, that exhibited a white, crusty exudate on its neck, emanating from a number of sites, where vampire bats had fed on the steer’s blood. The taxonomic identity of the bats was not available.
21839 Captured on a farm in Tucson, Arizona, this 1954 image depicted a positive results of an intradermal skin test, performed on the neck region of a bovine farm animal, which involved the injection of a formulation known as coccidioidin, created from broth in which  Coccidioides  spp. mycelia had been cultivated. See PHIL 15785, for another view of this reaction site.
12787 This photograph depicted the left side of a cow’s head, which was exhibiting symptoms of an illness diagnosed as Rinderpest virus, also known as cattle plague, or steppe murrain.  Note the lethargic appearance of this animal, as well as the ophthalmic discharge emanating from the cow’s left eye, which is one of the symptoms of this disease.  Other symptoms include fever, loss of appetite, nasal, oral, and urogenital erosions, constipation followed by diarrhea, and death 6 to 12-days after onset of this illness.
12864 From the “Illustrated Manual for the Recognition and Diagnosis of Certain Animal Diseases”, published in 1982, by the Mexico-United States Commission for the Prevention of Foot and Mouth Disease, this photograph depicts a bovine, showing signs of a Rinderpest infection. At this stage of the disease, bovine like the one depicted here, assume the classical milk fever position just before they succumb to the illness.

    import csv, hashlib, html, json, shutil
    from collections import Counter
    from pathlib import Path
    from PIL import Image
    ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]/'imagenes_incidencias_animales'
    records=json.loads((ROOT/'catalogo.json').read_text())
    overrides={
     'estado_general':['cdc_5437','cdc_5438','cdc_18836','cdc_28208','cdc_12864','commons_6c1ed4af264d'],
     'inflamacion':['cdc_12927','cdc_15785','cdc_16188','cdc_21839'],
     'piel':['cdc_25555','cdc_25556','cdc_26678','cdc_26679','cdc_26693'],
     'parto_reproduccion':['commons_a63dd12ea875'],
     'otras_incidencias':['commons_5d643db57bed'],
     'ojos':['cdc_12787','cdc_12881'],
    }
    for r in records:
     for category,ids in overrides.items():
      if r['id'] in ids:r['category']=category
     old=ROOT/r['file'];new=ROOT/(r['category']+'_'+r['id']+'.jpg')
     if old!=new:old.rename(new)
     r['file']=new.name
     r['review']='Revisión visual de pertinencia; clasificación descriptiva, no diagnóstico independiente.'
     im=Image.open(new);im.load()
     assert max(im.size)<=640 and new.stat().st_size<=100000
     r['bytes']=new.stat().st_size;r['sha256']=hashlib.sha256(new.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    assert len({r['sha256'] for r in records})==len(records)
    # Files generated during selection but rejected are kept outside the deliverable.
    keep={r['file'] for r in records};reject=Path('/tmp/cowsia-imagenes-descartadas');reject.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    for p in ROOT.glob('*.jpg'):
     if p.name not in keep:shutil.move(str(p),str(reject/p.name))
    records.sort(key=lambda r:(r['category'],r['id']))
    (ROOT/'catalogo.json').write_text(json.dumps(records,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
    fields=['file','category','title','author','license','license_url','source','download_url','width','height','bytes','sha256','description','changes','review']
    with (ROOT/'catalogo.csv').open('w',encoding='utf-8-sig',newline='') as f:
     w=csv.DictWriter(f,fieldnames=fields,extrasaction='ignore');w.writeheader();w.writerows(records)
    counts=Counter(r['category'] for r in records)
    labels={'boca_nariz':'Boca y nariz','estado_general':'Estado general','heridas':'Heridas y mordeduras','inflamacion':'Inflamación','inflamacion_ubre':'Ubres y mastitis','ojos':'Ojos','otras_incidencias':'Otras incidencias','parasitos':'Parásitos','parto_reproduccion':'Parto y reproducción','pezunas':'Pezuñas','piel':'Piel'}
    cdc_notice='Fuente: CDC/PHIL y los autores indicados. Las imágenes originales están disponibles gratuitamente en las fichas enlazadas. Su inclusión no implica respaldo del CDC, ATSDR, HHS ni del Gobierno de Estados Unidos a CowsIA o a sus productos o servicios.'
    readme=f'''# Imágenes de incidencias en bovinos
    
    Selección descargada el 29/09/2026: **{len(records)} fotografías**, no 500. Se buscaron fuentes de dominio público y CC0; la cifra solicitada no se ha alcanzado con fotografías pertinentes y licencia verificable. No se han añadido duplicados artificiales, imágenes generadas o fotos de animales sanos para completar el número.
    
    ## Contenido
    
    - JPG con lado mayor de hasta 640 píxeles y tamaño inferior a 100 KB por imagen.
    - Total de fotografías: {sum(r['bytes'] for r in records)/1024/1024:.2f} MiB. Los documentos de procedencia tienen tamaño adicional.
    - `galeria.html`: catálogo visual local, con filtro por categoría y fuente de cada imagen.
    - `catalogo.csv` y `catalogo.json`: archivo, tema, autor, licencia, fuente, descripción original, tamaño y hash SHA-256.
    - `LICENCIAS.md`: créditos y condiciones de cada archivo.
    - `fuentes/`: metadatos de búsqueda y fichas originales de licencia consultadas. Contienen también candidatos descartados; solo los JPG de la carpeta principal y las entradas de `catalogo.json` constituyen la selección entregada.
    
    ## Distribución
    
    '''+''.join(f'- {labels.get(k,k)}: {v}\n' for k,v in sorted(counts.items()))+f'''
    ## Licencias y procedencia
    
    Las fuentes identifican las imágenes seleccionadas como dominio público o CC0. «Dominio público» no se presenta aquí como una garantía de ausencia de toda condición en cualquier jurisdicción. En particular, las condiciones de CDC/PHIL requieren conservar atribución, enlace a la fuente gratuita y ausencia de respaldo institucional. Los archivos del CDC **no deben redistribuirse sin esos créditos**. Se documentan sus condiciones en `LICENCIAS.md` y en cada ficha.
    
    {cdc_notice}
    
    Política de CDC/PHIL: https://www.cdc.gov/other/agencymaterials.html
    
    Las modificaciones se limitan a orientación, reducción proporcional y compresión JPEG. No se han eliminado marcas ni se ha cambiado el contenido de las lesiones.
    
    ## Alcance y revisión
    
    Se revisaron visualmente las imágenes en hojas de contacto. Se descartaron ilustraciones, páginas de libros, gráficos, cultivos, fotografías humanas y escenas generales sin una incidencia pertinente. Algunas fotografías clínicas son históricas y varias documentan distintas vistas de un mismo caso. Los nombres de las enfermedades proceden de la descripción publicada por la fuente; no constituyen un diagnóstico propio ni datos sobre animales de CowsIA.
    
    No se ha incluido una categoría de «crotal perdido»: no se encontró una fotografía de licencia admitida con ese hecho verificado. Una oreja donde no se ve un crotal no demuestra por sí sola su pérdida.
    
    No se han importado ni asignado estas fotografías a animales o incidencias de CowsIA.
    '''
    (ROOT/'README.md').write_text(readme)
    license_lines=['# Licencias y créditos','',cdc_notice,'','Conserva los créditos junto a las imágenes al reutilizarlas. Revisa la ficha enlazada de cada archivo.','']
    for r in records:
     license_lines += [f"## {r['file']}",'',f"- Título: {r['title']}",f"- Autor/proveedor: {r['author']}",f"- Licencia declarada: {r['license']}",f"- Fuente gratuita: {r['source']}",f"- Condiciones: {r['license_url'] or r['source']}",f"- Transformación: {r['changes']}",'']
    (ROOT/'LICENCIAS.md').write_text('\n'.join(license_lines))
    esc=lambda x:html.escape(str(x))
    page=['<!doctype html><html lang="es"><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1"><title>Incidencias bovinas · Catálogo</title><style>body{margin:24px;background:#f3f6f8;color:#183143;font:16px/1.5 system-ui}header{max-width:1050px}select{padding:10px;margin:12px 0}main{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(275px,1fr));gap:18px}article{background:white;border-radius:10px;padding:14px}img{width:100%;height:220px;object-fit:contain;background:#e8edf0}h2{font-size:17px}p{overflow-wrap:anywhere}small{color:#415c6f}a{color:#087095}summary{cursor:pointer}[hidden]{display:none}</style><header><h1>Incidencias en bovinos</h1>',f'<p>{len(records)} imágenes · JPG de hasta 640 px · Fuentes y créditos verificados el 29/09/2026.</p>',f'<p>{esc(cdc_notice)}</p>','<p>Incluye lesiones y procedimientos veterinarios. <a href="README.md">Alcance de la selección</a> · <a href="catalogo.csv">Catálogo CSV</a> · <a href="LICENCIAS.md">Licencias</a></p><label>Filtrar por tema <select id="filter"><option value="">Todos</option>']
    page += [f'<option value="{k}">{labels.get(k,k)} ({v})</option>' for k,v in sorted(counts.items())]

from collections.abc import Generator
import os

from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy import inspect, text
from sqlalchemy.orm import DeclarativeBase, Session, sessionmaker

DATABASE_URL = "sqlite:///./cows.db"

engine = create_engine(DATABASE_URL, connect_args={"check_same_thread": False})
SessionLocal = sessionmaker(bind=engine, autoflush=False, autocommit=False)


class Base(DeclarativeBase):
    pass


def get_db() -> Generator[Session, None, None]:
    db = SessionLocal()
    try:
        yield db
    finally:
        db.close()


def init_db() -> None:
    from app import models  # noqa: F401

    Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)
    ensure_bootstrap_users()
    ensure_sqlite_columns()
    ensure_primary_animal_images()


def ensure_bootstrap_users() -> None:
    from app.auth import hash_password
    from app.models import Farm, User

    with SessionLocal() as db:
        if db.query(User).count():
            return
        username = os.getenv("COWSIA_USERNAME", "").strip()
        password = os.getenv("COWSIA_PASSWORD", "")
        farm_name = os.getenv("COWSIA_FARM_NAME", "explotacion_pepe").strip()
        if not username or not password or not farm_name:
            return
        farm = Farm(name=farm_name)
        db.add(farm)
        db.flush()
        db.add(
            User(
                username=username,
                password_hash=hash_password(password),
                farm_id=farm.id,
                can_manage_users=True,
                active=True,
            )
        )
        db.commit()


def ensure_sqlite_columns() -> None:
    inspector = inspect(engine)
    tables = inspector.get_table_names()
    with engine.begin() as connection:
        if "animal_images" in tables:
            columns = {column["name"] for column in inspector.get_columns("animal_images")}
            if "is_primary" not in columns:
                connection.execute(text("ALTER TABLE animal_images ADD COLUMN is_primary BOOLEAN DEFAULT 0"))


def ensure_primary_animal_images() -> None:
    with engine.begin() as connection:
        tables = inspect(engine).get_table_names()
        if "animal_images" not in tables:
            return
        animal_ids = [
            row[0]
            for row in connection.execute(text("SELECT DISTINCT animal_id FROM animal_images")).fetchall()
        ]
        for animal_id in animal_ids:
            primary_count = connection.execute(
                text("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM animal_images WHERE animal_id = :animal_id AND is_primary = 1"),
                {"animal_id": animal_id},
            ).scalar_one()
            if primary_count:
                continue
            first_image_id = connection.execute(
                text("SELECT id FROM animal_images WHERE animal_id = :animal_id ORDER BY created_at ASC, id ASC LIMIT 1"),
                {"animal_id": animal_id},
            ).scalar_one_or_none()
            if first_image_id is not None:
                connection.execute(
                    text("UPDATE animal_images SET is_primary = 1 WHERE id = :image_id"),
                    {"image_id": first_image_id},
                )

@app.post("/api/animals/{crotal}/events", response_model=AnimalEventOut)
def create_animal_event(crotal: str, payload: AnimalEventIn, farm_id: int = Depends(current_farm_id), db: Session = Depends(get_db)) -> dict:
    animal = _animal_by_crotal(db, crotal, farm_id)
    text = payload.text.strip()
    if not text:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="El texto del suceso no puede estar vacio")
    row = AnimalEvent(animal_id=animal.id, text=text, event_date=payload.event_date, reporter=payload.reporter)
    db.add(row)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(row)
    return _event_out(row)


@app.post("/api/animals/{crotal}/events-with-image", response_model=AnimalEventOut)
async def create_animal_event_with_image(
    crotal: str,
    text: str = Form(...),
    event_date: date | None = Form(None),
    reporter: str | None = Form(None),
    file: UploadFile | None = File(None),
    farm_id: int = Depends(current_farm_id),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
) -> dict:
    animal = _animal_by_crotal(db, crotal, farm_id)
    clean_text = text.strip()
    if not clean_text:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="El texto del suceso no puede estar vacio")
    image_path = None
    image_name = None
    image_content_type = None
    if file and file.filename:
        suffix = _image_suffix(file)
        content = await file.read()
        target = _store_upload("event_images", file, content, suffix)
        image_path = _portable_upload_path(target)
        image_name = file.filename or target.name
        image_content_type = file.content_type
    row = AnimalEvent(
        animal_id=animal.id,
        text=clean_text,
        event_date=event_date,
        reporter=reporter,
        image_path=image_path,
        image_name=image_name,
        image_content_type=image_content_type,
    )
    db.add(row)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(row)
    return _event_out(row)


@app.get("/api/animal-events/{event_id}/image")
def get_animal_event_image(event_id: int, farm_id: int = Depends(current_farm_id), db: Session = Depends(get_db)) -> FileResponse:
    row = _owned_child(db, AnimalEvent, event_id, farm_id)
    if not row.image_path:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Imagen no encontrada")
    path = _resolve_upload_path(row.image_path, "event_images")
    if not path.exists():
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Imagen no encontrada en disco")
    return FileResponse(path, filename=row.image_name or path.name, media_type=row.image_content_type)


@app.delete("/api/animal-events/{event_id}")
def delete_animal_event(event_id: int, farm_id: int = Depends(current_farm_id), db: Session = Depends(get_db)) -> dict[str, bool]:
    row = _owned_child(db, AnimalEvent, event_id, farm_id)
    if row.image_path:
        path = _resolve_upload_path(row.image_path, "event_images")
        shared_file = db.query(AnimalEvent).filter(AnimalEvent.id != row.id, AnimalEvent.image_path == row.image_path).first()
        if path.exists() and not shared_file:
            path.unlink()
    db.delete(row)
    db.commit()
    return {"ok": True}

    def build_plan(db):
        catalog=json.loads((ROOT/'imagenes_incidencias_animales/catalogo.json').read_text())
        assert all(r['id'] in DESCRIPTIONS for r in catalog)
        for r in catalog:
            p=ROOT/'imagenes_incidencias_animales'/r['file']
            assert hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==r['sha256'],p
        histories={}
        with (ROOT/'historico_ubicaciones_animales.csv').open(encoding='utf-8-sig',newline='') as f:
            for r in csv.DictReader(f):
                histories.setdefault((int(r['animal_id']),r['explotacion'],r['crotal']),[]).append((float(r['latitud']),float(r['longitud'])))
        animals=db.execute('''SELECT a.id,a.crotal,f.name AS farm FROM animals a JOIN farms f ON f.id=a.farm_id
            WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM animal_locations l WHERE l.animal_id=a.id) ORDER BY a.id''').fetchall()
        start,end=date(2026,6,29),date(2026,9,29)
        plan=[]
        for a in animals:
            rng=random.Random(f'{BATCH}:{a["id"]}')
            bases=[(r[0],r[1]) for r in db.execute('SELECT latitude,longitude FROM animal_locations WHERE animal_id=? ORDER BY id',(a['id'],))]
            bases+=histories.get((a['id'],a['farm'],a['crotal']),[])
            for slot,img in enumerate(rng.sample(catalog,8),start=1):
                base_lat,base_lon=rng.choice(bases)
                lat,lon=destination(base_lat,base_lon,rng.uniform(0,360))
                assert abs(distance(base_lat,base_lon,lat,lon)-200)<0.001
                day=start+timedelta(days=rng.randint(0,(end-start).days))
                credit=f"Fuente: {img['author']}. {img['license']}. Imagen reducida."
                if img['id'].startswith('cdc_'):
                    credit+=' Original gratuito en CDC/PHIL. Su uso no implica respaldo del CDC, ATSDR, HHS ni del Gobierno de EE. UU. a CowsIA.'
                plan.append(dict(simulation_key=f'{BATCH}:{a["id"]}:{slot}',animal_id=a['id'],explotacion=a['farm'],crotal=a['crotal'],
                    text='[Suceso simulado] '+DESCRIPTIONS[img['id']],event_date=day.isoformat(),reporter=rng.choice(['Pedro','Lorenzo','Andres']),
                    latitude=lat,longitude=lon,base_latitude=base_lat,base_longitude=base_lon,image_name=img['file'],
                    image_path='backend/uploads/event_images/'+BATCH+'_'+img['id']+'.jpg',
                    image_credit=credit,image_source=img['source']))
        return plan
    
    
    def main():
        parser=argparse.ArgumentParser();parser.add_argument('--apply',action='store_true');args=parser.parse_args()
        with sqlite3.connect(ROOT/'backend/cows.db',timeout=30) as db:
            db.row_factory=sqlite3.Row
            plan=build_plan(db)
            output=ROOT/'docs'/BATCH;output.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
            with (output/'plan.csv').open('w',encoding='utf-8-sig',newline='') as f:
                writer=csv.DictWriter(f,fieldnames=list(plan[0]));writer.writeheader();writer.writerows(plan)
            if not args.apply:
                print(f'Plan validado: {len(plan)} sucesos para {len(plan)//8} animales. Sin cambios en la base de datos.');return
            timestamp=datetime.now().strftime('%Y%m%d_%H%M%S')
            backup=ROOT/'backend'/f'cows_pre_sucesos_{timestamp}.bak'
            with sqlite3.connect(backup) as dest:db.backup(dest)
            created=[]
            try:
                db.execute('BEGIN IMMEDIATE')
                for r in plan:
                    if db.execute('SELECT id FROM animal_events WHERE simulation_key=?',(r['simulation_key'],)).fetchone():continue
                    source=ROOT/'imagenes_incidencias_animales'/r['image_name'];target=ROOT/r['image_path']
                    if not target.exists():shutil.copyfile(source,target)
                    fields=['animal_id','text','event_date','reporter','latitude','longitude','image_name','image_path','image_credit','image_source','simulation_key']
                    cur=db.execute('INSERT INTO animal_events ('+','.join(fields)+',image_content_type,created_at) VALUES ('+','.join('?' for _ in fields)+",'image/jpeg',?)",[r[k] for k in fields]+[datetime.now().isoformat(' ')])
                    created.append(cur.lastrowid)
                rows=db.execute('SELECT animal_id,count(*) n FROM animal_events WHERE simulation_key LIKE ? GROUP BY animal_id',(BATCH+':%',)).fetchall()
                assert len(rows)==len(plan)//8 and all(r['n']==8 for r in rows)
                db.commit()
            except Exception:
                db.rollback();raise
            result=dict(created=len(created),animals=len(plan)//8,total_batch=len(plan),backup=str(backup),event_ids=created)
            (output/f'resultado_{timestamp}.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2))
            print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in result.items() if k!='event_ids'},ensure_ascii=False))
    
    if __name__=='__main__':main()

    def test_event_location_and_image_credit_are_exposed_without_changing_animal_location():

            farm=Farm(name='events-test');db.add(farm);db.flush()

    import {chromium} from 'playwright';
    const browser=await chromium.launch({headless:true});
    try{
     const page=await browser.newPage({viewport:{width:1440,height:1050}});
     const errors=[];page.on('pageerror',e=>errors.push(e.message));
     await page.goto('http://127.0.0.1:8081');
     await page.getByLabel('Usuario').fill(process.env.COWSIA_USERNAME);
     await page.getByLabel('Contrasena',{exact:true}).fill(process.env.COWSIA_PASSWORD);
     await page.getByRole('button',{name:'Entrar',exact:true}).click();
     await page.locator('nav').getByRole('button',{name:'Animales',exact:true}).click();
     await page.getByPlaceholder('Crotal, madre, procedencia o destino').fill('ES051010111741');
     await page.getByRole('button',{name:'ES051010111741',exact:true}).click();
     const section=page.locator('.detail-section').filter({has:page.getByRole('heading',{name:'Sucesos',exact:true})});
     await section.scrollIntoViewIfNeeded();
     const cards=section.locator('.event-row').filter({hasText:'[Suceso simulado]'});
     if(await cards.count()!==8)throw Error('No hay ocho sucesos');
     for(let i=0;i<8;i++){
      const card=cards.nth(i);await card.scrollIntoViewIfNeeded();
      await card.locator('img').waitFor();
      await card.locator('img').evaluate(img=>img.decode());
      if(await card.getByRole('link',{name:/Ver ubicación/}).count()!==1)throw Error('Faltan coordenadas');
      if(await card.getByRole('link',{name:'Fuente original gratuita de la imagen'}).count()!==1)throw Error('Falta fuente');
     }
     await cards.first().scrollIntoViewIfNeeded();
     await page.screenshot({path:'../capturas_cowsia/sucesos-simulados.png'});
     if(errors.length)throw Error(errors.join('\n'));
     console.log('Verificado en navegador: ocho sucesos con fotografía, ubicación y fuente de imagen.');
    }finally{await browser.close();}

$ cat > docs/sucesos_simulados_20260929/README.md <<'EOF'
    # Carga de sucesos simulados
    
    Se crearon 2.000 sucesos: ocho para cada uno de los 250 animales con ubicación (125 por explotación). Los siete sucesos anteriores se conservan.
    
    Cada suceso contiene:
    
    - Una de las 75 imágenes de `imagenes_incidencias_animales`, elegida aleatoriamente sin repetir fotografía dentro de los ocho sucesos del mismo animal.
    - Una descripción breve en español del contenido visible, precedida por `[Suceso simulado]`.
    - Informante aleatorio: Pedro, Lorenzo o Andres.
    - Fecha aleatoria entre 29/06/2026 y 29/09/2026, ambos inclusive.
    - Coordenadas a 200 m de un punto del mismo animal, seleccionado entre sus ubicaciones registradas y las del histórico CSV. Cálculo sobre el modelo esférico usado al generar el histórico.
    - Créditos y enlace a la fuente gratuita de la imagen.
    
    Las coordenadas pertenecen al suceso y no alteran la posición actual ni el recorrido del animal. Se ven en la ficha con un enlace a Google Maps. Son datos de ejemplo: ni las fotografías ni sus fechas acreditan incidencias reales de esos animales.
    
    `plan.csv` contiene los 2.000 registros y, además, el punto de partida utilizado para comprobar cada distancia. `resultado_*.json` identifica los sucesos creados y la copia de seguridad previa. La columna interna `simulation_key`, con índice único, evita duplicar esta carga si se repite el generador.
    
    Comprobaciones: 15 pruebas del backend correctas; compilación de interfaz completada; verificados los 2.000 registros, los rangos de fecha, los tres informantes, la existencia de los archivos, las distancias y las ocho fotografías distintas por animal.
    
    Generador: `python3 scripts/crear_sucesos_simulados.py` prepara el plan sin escribir en la base. `--apply` aplica la carga con copia SQLite previa.
    EOF

function FitHistoryRoute({ points, origin }) {
  const map = useMap();
  useEffect(() => {
    map.fitBounds([origin, ...points.map((point) => [point.latitude, point.longitude])], { paddingTopLeft: [60, 280], paddingBottomRight: [60, 60], maxZoom: 16, animate: false });
  }, [map, points, origin[0], origin[1]]);
  return null;
}

function HistoryRoute({ points }) {
  const positions = points.map((point) => [point.latitude, point.longitude]);
  return <>
        {positions.length > 1 && <Polyline positions={positions} pathOptions={{ color: "#1677ff", weight: 4, dashArray: points.some((point) => point.simulated) ? "8 6" : undefined }} />}
        {points.map((point, index) => (
          <Marker key={`${point.step}-${index}`} position={positions[index]} icon={L.divIcon({
            className: "history-marker",
            html: `<span style="background:${index === 0 ? "#07856d" : index === points.length - 1 ? "#c63b49" : "#1677ff"}">${index + 1}</span>`,
        ))}
  </>;
}

function AnimalHistoryMap({ points }) {
  const positions = points.map((point) => [point.latitude, point.longitude]);
  return (
    <div className="animal-history-map-wrap">
      <MapContainer key={JSON.stringify(positions)} bounds={positions} boundsOptions={{ padding: [30, 30], maxZoom: 17 }} scrollWheelZoom={false} className="animal-history-map">
        <TileLayer attribution='&copy; <a href="https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright">OpenStreetMap</a>' url="https://{s}.tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png" />
        <HistoryRoute points={points} />
      </MapContainer>
    </div>
  );
}

function AnimalLocationMiniMap({ locations }) {
  const center = useMemo(() => {
    const first = locations[0];
    return [first.latitude, first.longitude];
  }, [locations]);

  return (
    <div className="animal-mini-map-wrap">
      <MapContainer
        key={`${center[0]}-${center[1]}-${locations.length}`}
        center={center}
        zoom={16}
        scrollWheelZoom={false}
        className="animal-mini-map"
      >
        <TileLayer
          attribution='&copy; <a href="https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright">OpenStreetMap</a>'
          url="https://{s}.tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png"
        />
        {locations.map((location) => (
          <Marker key={location.id} position={[location.latitude, location.longitude]} icon={animalMarkerIcon}>
            <Popup>
              <div className="map-popup">
                <strong>{location.latitude}, {location.longitude}</strong>
                <span>{formatDate(location.recorded_at?.slice(0, 10)) || "Sin fecha"}</span>
              </div>
            </Popup>
          </Marker>
        ))}
      </MapContainer>

    const browser=await chromium.launch({headless:true});
    try{
     const page=await browser.newPage({viewport:{width:1440,height:1050}});
     const errors=[];page.on('pageerror',e=>errors.push(e.message));
     await page.goto('http://127.0.0.1:8081');
     await page.getByLabel('Usuario').fill(process.env.COWSIA_USERNAME);
     await page.getByLabel('Contrasena',{exact:true}).fill(process.env.COWSIA_PASSWORD);
     await page.getByRole('button',{name:'Entrar',exact:true}).click();
     await page.locator('nav').getByRole('button',{name:'Animales',exact:true}).click();
     await page.getByPlaceholder('Crotal, madre, procedencia o destino').fill('ES051010111741');
     const responsePromise=page.waitForResponse(r=>r.url().endsWith('/api/animals/ES051010111741/details'));
     await page.getByRole('button',{name:'ES051010111741',exact:true}).click();
     const detail=await (await responsePromise).json();
     const section=page.locator('.detail-section').filter({has:page.getByRole('heading',{name:'Mapa de sucesos',exact:true})});
     await section.scrollIntoViewIfNeeded();
     const events=detail.events.filter(e=>e.latitude!=null&&e.longitude!=null);
     const markers=section.locator('.event-map-marker');
     if(await markers.count()!==events.length||events.length!==8)throw Error('Número de marcadores incorrecto');
     for(let i=0;i<events.length;i++){
      await markers.nth(i).focus();await markers.nth(i).press('Enter');
      const popup=section.locator('.event-map-popup');await popup.waitFor();
      const e=events[i],text=await popup.innerText();
      if(!text.includes(e.text)||!text.includes(e.reporter)||!text.includes(new Date(e.event_date).toLocaleDateString('es-ES')))throw Error('Datos incorrectos');
      await popup.locator('img').evaluate(img=>img.decode());
      if(!(await popup.locator('img').getAttribute('src')).endsWith(e.image_url))throw Error('Imagen incorrecta');
      if(i===3){await page.waitForTimeout(500);await page.screenshot({path:'../capturas_cowsia/mapa-sucesos-animal.png'});}
     }
     await page.getByRole('button',{name:'Cerrar',exact:true}).click();
     await page.route('**/api/animals/ES051010111741/details',route=>route.fulfill({json:{...detail,events:detail.events.map(e=>({...e,latitude:null,longitude:null}))}}));
     await page.getByRole('button',{name:'ES051010111741',exact:true}).click();
     await page.getByText('No hay sucesos con ubicación para este animal.',{exact:true}).waitFor();
     if(errors.length)throw Error(errors.join('\n'));
     console.log('Verificado: ocho marcadores, miniaturas, fechas, descripciones e informantes correctos; estado sin coordenadas; sin errores JavaScript.');
    }finally{await browser.close();}

    cat > frontend/scripts/audit-all-event-maps.mjs <<'JS'
    import {chromium} from 'playwright';
    import {readFile,writeFile,mkdir} from 'node:fs/promises';
    const animals=JSON.parse(await readFile('/tmp/cowsia-event-map-audit.json','utf8'));
    const browser=await chromium.launch({headless:true});
    const results=[],errors=[];
    await mkdir('../docs/verificacion-mapas-sucesos',{recursive:true});
    async function audit(farm,username,password){
     const context=await browser.newContext({viewport:{width:1440,height:1050}});
     const page=await context.newPage();page.on('pageerror',e=>errors.push({farm,error:e.message}));
     try{
      await page.goto('http://127.0.0.1:8081');
      await page.getByLabel('Usuario').fill(username);await page.getByLabel('Contrasena',{exact:true}).fill(password);
      await page.getByRole('button',{name:'Entrar',exact:true}).click();
      await page.locator('nav').getByRole('button',{name:'Animales',exact:true}).click();
      const list=animals.filter(a=>a.farm_id===farm);
      for(const [index,animal] of list.entries()){
       try{
        const listResponse=page.waitForResponse(r=>r.url().includes('/api/animals?')&&new URL(r.url()).searchParams.get('q')===animal.crotal);
        await page.getByPlaceholder('Crotal, madre, procedencia o destino').fill(animal.crotal);await listResponse;
        const response=page.waitForResponse(r=>r.url().endsWith(`/api/animals/${animal.crotal}/details`));
        await page.getByRole('button',{name:animal.crotal,exact:true}).click();
        const detail=await (await response).json();
        const section=page.locator('.detail-section').filter({has:page.getByRole('heading',{name:'Mapa de sucesos',exact:true})});
        await section.scrollIntoViewIfNeeded();
        const markers=section.locator('.event-map-marker');
        const actual=await markers.count();
        if(actual!==animal.located)throw Error(`Marcadores ${actual}, esperados ${animal.located}`);
        if(detail.events.length!==animal.events)throw Error('Número de sucesos incorrecto');
        if(actual){
         await markers.first().focus();await markers.first().press('Enter');
         const popup=section.locator('.event-map-popup');await popup.waitFor();
         const event=detail.events.find(e=>e.latitude!=null&&e.longitude!=null);
         const text=await popup.innerText();
         if(!text.includes(event.text)||!text.includes(event.reporter)||!text.includes(new Date(event.event_date).toLocaleDateString('es-ES')))throw Error('Popup incorrecto');
         if(event.image_url)await popup.locator('img').evaluate(img=>img.decode());
        }
        if(index===0){await page.waitForTimeout(400);await page.screenshot({path:`../docs/verificacion-mapas-sucesos/explotacion-${farm}.png`});}
        results.push({...animal,markers:actual,status:'correcto'});
        await page.getByRole('button',{name:'Cerrar',exact:true}).click();
       }catch(e){results.push({...animal,status:'error',error:e.message});throw e;}
       if((index+1)%25===0)console.log(`Explotación ${farm}: ${index+1}/${list.length} fichas verificadas`);
      }
     }finally{await context.close();}
    }
    try{
     const runs=await Promise.allSettled([
      audit(1,process.env.COWSIA_USERNAME,process.env.COWSIA_PASSWORD),
      audit(2,process.env.COWSIA_DEMO_USERNAME,process.env.COWSIA_DEMO_PASSWORD),
     ]);
     for(const run of runs)if(run.status==='rejected')errors.push({error:run.reason.message});
    }finally{
     await writeFile('../docs/verificacion-mapas-sucesos/resultado.json',JSON.stringify({date:new Date().toISOString(),expected:animals.length,results,errors},null,2));
     await browser.close();
    }
    console.log(JSON.stringify({expected:animals.length,checked:results.length,passed:results.filter(r=>r.status==='correcto').length,errors}));
    if(errors.length||results.length!==animals.length)process.exitCode=1;
    JS

import json, time, urllib.request, urllib.parse
from pathlib import Path
ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
OUT=ROOT/'imagenes_incidencias_animales'/'fuentes'
OUT.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
API='https://commons.wikimedia.org/w/api.php'
def query(params):
    url=API+'?'+urllib.parse.urlencode(dict(action='query',format='json',**params))
    for attempt in range(4):
        try:
            req=urllib.request.Request(url,headers={'User-Agent':'CowsIA/1.0 (educational veterinary image collection)'})
            with urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=35) as r:return json.load(r)
        except Exception:
            if attempt==3:raise
            time.sleep(3*(attempt+1))
    return {}
roots=['Diseases and disorders of cattle','Wounded cattle','Diseases and disorders of the eyes in cattle','Digital diseases in cattle','Hoof care in cattle','Cattle with ear tags','Cattle without ear tags','Dehorning of cattle','Veterinary medicine in cattle','Calving']
queue=[('Category:'+x,0) for x in roots];seen=set();files={};errors=[]
while queue:
    cat,depth=queue.pop(0)
    if cat in seen:continue
    seen.add(cat)
    if any(x in cat.lower() for x in ['bulletin','book','egypt','histopathology','virus','bacteria','micrograph','the diseases and disorders of the ox']):continue
    cont={}
    try:
        while True:
            data=query(dict(list='categorymembers',cmtitle=cat,cmlimit=500,**cont))
            for row in data.get('query',{}).get('categorymembers',[]):
                title=row['title']
                if row['ns']==14 and depth<2:queue.append((title,depth+1))
                if row['ns']==6 and title.lower().endswith(('.jpg','.jpeg','.png','.webp')):
                    files.setdefault(title,[]).append(cat)
            if 'continue' not in data:break
            cont=data['continue']
        print(cat,len(files),flush=True)
    except Exception as e:errors.append([cat,str(e)])
    time.sleep(.3)
(OUT/'commons_categories.json').write_text(json.dumps(files,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
records=[]
for start in range(0,len(files),40):
    titles=list(files)[start:start+40]
    try:
        data=query(dict(titles='|'.join(titles),prop='imageinfo',iiprop='url|mime|sha1|extmetadata',iiurlwidth=640))
        for page in data.get('query',{}).get('pages',{}).values():
            info=page.get('imageinfo',[{}])[0]
            if not info.get('url'):continue
            records.append(dict(title=page['title'],categories=files.get(page['title'],[]),info=info))
        print('Metadatos',len(records),flush=True)
    except Exception as e:errors.append([titles,str(e)])
    (OUT/'commons_candidates.json').write_text(json.dumps(records,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
    time.sleep(.4)
(OUT/'search_errors.json').write_text(json.dumps(errors,indent=2))
print('TOTAL',len(records),flush=True)
import csv, hashlib, html, io, json, re, time, urllib.request
from pathlib import Path
from PIL import Image, ImageOps, ImageDraw
ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]/'imagenes_incidencias_animales'
SOURCES=ROOT/'fuentes'
def clean(s):return html.unescape(re.sub('<[^>]+>',' ',s or '')).strip()
def category(text):
    t=text.lower()
    for label,pattern in [
        ('ojos','ocular|eye |eye,|eye\\.|kerato|conjunctiv'),
        ('pezunas','hoof|hooves|interdigital|lameness'),
        ('heridas','bite|wound|ulcerative lesion|sitfast'),
        ('inflamacion_ubre','mastitis|udder|teats'),
        ('piel','skin|cutaneous|ringworm|dermatoph|nodul|alopecia'),
        ('boca_nariz','tongue|muzzle|nasal|mouth|lip|oral|mandib'),
        ('inflamacion','swollen|swelling|edema|synovitis|wheal'),
        ('parto_reproduccion','aborted|fetus|vaginal|penis|calving|birth|amniotic|geboorte'),
        ('parasitos','flies|ticks|parasite|warble'),
        ('estado_general','postur|emaciat|rabies|letharg|encephalopathy|downer')]:
        if re.search(pattern,t):return label
    return 'otras_incidencias'
# Prefer external clinical signs; exclude microscopy, human disease, isolated insects,
# internal necropsies and photographs showing no animal lesion.
exclude_cdc=set(map(str,[18724,20427,20428,5435,5436,5439,8527,8529,12885,12886,12887,12888,12892,12922,12923,12924,12925,
16189,16190,16191,16192,16193,16194,16195,16480,16481,16482,22871,22872,22873,22886,22887,
24046,24061,24062,24738,26535,26695,28063,28421,28422,28423,28424,30240,12847,12848,12849,12850,12851,12852]))
curated_commons={
'Sindrome vatche djus.jpg','Amniotic sac cow (01).jpg','Angus cattle 25.jpg',

'Dieles vea.jpg','Botnire rexhowe.jpg',
'Ontginning, vee, turfsteekreportages, geboortes, kalveren, mannen, Bestanddeelnr 165-0834.jpg',
'Ontginning, vee, turfsteekreportages, geboortes, kalveren, mannen, Bestanddeelnr 165-0835.jpg',
'Ontginning, vee, turfsteekreportages, geboortes, kalveren, mannen, Bestanddeelnr 165-0836.jpg',
}
candidates=[]
for x in json.loads((SOURCES/'cdc_candidates.json').read_text()):
    if x['id'] in exclude_cdc or not x['public_domain'] or not x['image_url']:continue
    d=x['description'];clinical=re.sub(r'^From the .*?this ','',d)
    if not re.search(r'bovin|cow|cattle|steer|calf|calves',d,re.I):continue
    if re.search('photomicrograph|micrograph|necropsy|dissection|human|patient[’\']s',clinical,re.I):continue
    candidates.append(dict(id='cdc_'+x['id'],source=x['source'],download_url=x['image_url'],title='CDC PHIL '+x['id'],
        description=d,author=x['author'],license='Dominio público (CDC PHIL; conservar atribución)',
        license_url='https://www.cdc.gov/other/agencymaterials.html',license_statement=x['license_statement'],category=category(clinical)))
for x in json.loads((SOURCES/'commons_candidates.json').read_text()):
    name=x['title'].removeprefix('File:');info=x['info'];m=info.get('extmetadata',{})
    license=m.get('LicenseShortName',{}).get('value','')
    if license not in ('Public domain','CC0') or name not in curated_commons:continue
    desc=clean(m.get('ImageDescription',{}).get('value',''))
    candidates.append(dict(id='commons_'+hashlib.sha1(name.encode()).hexdigest()[:12],source=info['descriptionurl'],
        download_url=info.get('thumburl') or info['url'],title=name,description=desc,author=clean(m.get('Artist',{}).get('value','')),
        license=license,license_url=m.get('LicenseUrl',{}).get('value',''),license_statement=license,category=category(name+' '+desc)))
(SOURCES/'selected_candidates.json').write_text(json.dumps(candidates,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
previous={r['id']:r for r in json.loads((ROOT/'catalogo.json').read_text())} if (ROOT/'catalogo.json').exists() else {}
records=[];errors=[];hashes=set();pixels=set()
for x in candidates:
    path=ROOT/(x['category']+'_'+x['id']+'.jpg')
    try:
        if x['id'] in previous and (ROOT/previous[x['id']]['file']).exists():
            records.append(previous[x['id']]);continue
        if path.exists():img=Image.open(path);img.load()
        else:
            for attempt in range(4):
                try:
                    req=urllib.request.Request(x['download_url'],headers={'User-Agent':'CowsIA/1.0 veterinary image library'})
                    with urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=35) as response:
                        content=response.read(12*1024*1024+1)
                    if len(content)>12*1024*1024:raise ValueError('Imagen demasiado grande')
                    img=Image.open(io.BytesIO(content));img.load();break
                except Exception:
                    if attempt==3:raise
                    time.sleep((attempt+1)*3)
            img=ImageOps.exif_transpose(img).convert('RGB');img.thumbnail((640,640),Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)
        pixelhash=hashlib.sha256(img.convert('RGB').tobytes()).hexdigest()
        if pixelhash in pixels:
            errors.append(dict(id=x['id'],reason='Duplicado visual exacto'));continue
        pixels.add(pixelhash)
        for quality in [82,75,65,55]:
            buf=io.BytesIO();img.convert('RGB').save(buf,format='JPEG',quality=quality,optimize=True)
            data=buf.getvalue()
            if len(data)<=100_000:break
        digest=hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
        if digest in hashes:continue
        hashes.add(digest);path.write_bytes(data)
        records.append(dict(x,file=path.name,width=img.width,height=img.height,bytes=len(data),sha256=digest,downloaded_at='2026-09-29',changes='Reducción proporcional a máximo 640 px y compresión JPEG; sin recortes ni alteración del contenido.'))
        (ROOT/'catalogo.json').write_text(json.dumps(records,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
        print(len(records),path.name,len(data),flush=True)
    except Exception as e:errors.append(dict(id=x['id'],reason=str(e)));print('ERROR',x['id'],str(e),flush=True)
    time.sleep(.3)
(ROOT/'catalogo.json').write_text(json.dumps(records,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
(SOURCES/'download_errors.json').write_text(json.dumps(errors,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))

for start in range(0,len(records),30):

function FarmIncidents() {
  const [rows, setRows] = useState([]);
  const [form, setForm] = useState({
    category: incidentCategories[0],
    text: "",
    occurred_at: localDateTimeValue(),
    latitude: "",
    longitude: "",
  });
  const [imageFile, setImageFile] = useState(null);
  const [fileKey, setFileKey] = useState(0);
  const [locating, setLocating] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");

  async function load() {
    setRows(await api.get("/api/farm-events"));
  }

  useEffect(() => {
    load().catch((exc) => setError(exc.message));
  }, []);

  function captureLocation() {
    setError("");
    if (!navigator.geolocation) {
      setError("Este dispositivo no ofrece geolocalizacion.");
      return;
    }
    setLocating(true);
    navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition(
      (position) => {
        setForm((current) => ({
          ...current,
          latitude: position.coords.latitude.toFixed(6),
          longitude: position.coords.longitude.toFixed(6),
        }));
        setLocating(false);
      },
      (locationError) => {
        setError(`No se pudo obtener la ubicacion: ${locationError.message}`);
        setLocating(false);
      },
      { enableHighAccuracy: true, timeout: 12_000 },
    );
  }

  async function submit(event) {
    event.preventDefault();
    setError("");
    try {
      const payload = new FormData();
      payload.append("category", form.category);
      payload.append("text", form.text);
      if (form.occurred_at) payload.append("occurred_at", new Date(form.occurred_at).toISOString());
      if (form.latitude && form.longitude) {
        payload.append("latitude", form.latitude);
        payload.append("longitude", form.longitude);
      }
      if (imageFile) payload.append("file", imageFile);
      await api.uploadForm("/api/farm-events-with-image", payload);
      setForm({ category: incidentCategories[0], text: "", occurred_at: localDateTimeValue(), latitude: "", longitude: "" });
      setImageFile(null);
      setFileKey((value) => value + 1);
      await load();
    } catch (exc) {
      setError(exc.message);
    }
  }

  async function remove(row) {
    setError("");
    try {
      await api.delete(`/api/farm-events/${row.id}`);
      await load();
    } catch (exc) {
      setError(exc.message);
    }
  }

  return (
    <section className="page incidents-page">
      <PageTitle title="Incidencias de la explotacion" />
      <div className="grid two incidents-layout">
        <form className="panel incident-form" onSubmit={submit}>
          <h2>Nueva incidencia</h2>
          <p className="muted">El usuario que ha iniciado sesion se guarda automaticamente como informante.</p>
          <label>
            Tipo
            <select value={form.category} onChange={(event) => setForm({ ...form, category: event.target.value })}>
              {incidentCategories.map((category) => <option key={category}>{category}</option>)}
            </select>
          </label>
          <label>
            Descripcion
            <textarea required placeholder="Describe lo sucedido" value={form.text} onChange={(event) => setForm({ ...form, text: event.target.value })} />
          </label>
          <label>
            Fecha y hora
            <input required type="datetime-local" value={form.occurred_at} onChange={(event) => setForm({ ...form, occurred_at: event.target.value })} />
          </label>
          <div className="incident-location">
            <input aria-label="Latitud" type="number" step="0.000001" placeholder="Latitud" value={form.latitude} onChange={(event) => setForm({ ...form, latitude: event.target.value })} />
            <input aria-label="Longitud" type="number" step="0.000001" placeholder="Longitud" value={form.longitude} onChange={(event) => setForm({ ...form, longitude: event.target.value })} />
            <button type="button" onClick={captureLocation} disabled={locating}><MapPin size={16} />{locating ? "Localizando..." : "Usar mi ubicacion"}</button>
          </div>
          <label>
            Fotografia opcional
            <input key={fileKey} type="file" accept="image/png,image/jpeg,image/webp,image/gif" onChange={(event) => setImageFile(event.target.files?.[0] || null)} />
          </label>
          <button className="primary" type="submit"><Plus size={16} />Guardar incidencia</button>
          {error && <p className="error">{error}</p>}
        </form>
        <div className="incident-history">
          <div className="result-strip"><ClipboardList size={18} /><strong>{rows.length}</strong><span>incidencias registradas</span></div>
          {rows.length === 0 && <div className="panel"><p className="muted">Todavia no hay incidencias generales.</p></div>}
          {rows.map((row) => (
            <article className="panel incident-card" key={row.id}>
              <header><div><span className="pill warning">{row.category}</span><h3>{row.text}</h3></div><button className="icon" type="button" onClick={() => remove(row)} title="Eliminar"><Trash2 size={15} /></button></header>
              <div className="incident-meta"><span><CalendarPlus size={15} />{formatDateTime(row.occurred_at)}</span><span>{row.reporter}</span></div>
              {row.latitude !== null && row.longitude !== null && <a className="incident-map-link" href={`https://www.google.com/maps?q=${row.latitude},${row.longitude}`} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer"><MapPin size={15} />{row.latitude}, {row.longitude}<ExternalLink size={14} /></a>}
              {row.image_url && <img src={api.url(row.image_url)} alt={row.image_name || row.category} />}
            </article>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

@app.get("/api/animal-events/{event_id}/image")
def get_animal_event_image(event_id: int, farm_id: int = Depends(current_farm_id), db: Session = Depends(get_db)) -> FileResponse:
    row = _owned_child(db, AnimalEvent, event_id, farm_id)
    if not row.image_path:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Imagen no encontrada")
    path = _resolve_upload_path(row.image_path, "event_images")
    if not path.exists():
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Imagen no encontrada en disco")
    return FileResponse(path, filename=row.image_name or path.name, media_type=row.image_content_type)


@app.delete("/api/animal-events/{event_id}")
def delete_animal_event(event_id: int, farm_id: int = Depends(current_farm_id), db: Session = Depends(get_db)) -> dict[str, bool]:
    row = _owned_child(db, AnimalEvent, event_id, farm_id)
    if row.image_path:
        path = _resolve_upload_path(row.image_path, "event_images")
        shared_file = db.query(AnimalEvent).filter(AnimalEvent.id != row.id, AnimalEvent.image_path == row.image_path).first()
        if path.exists() and not shared_file:
            path.unlink()
    db.delete(row)
    db.commit()
    return {"ok": True}


@app.get("/api/farm-events")
def list_farm_events(farm_id: int = Depends(current_farm_id), db: Session = Depends(get_db)) -> list[dict]:
    rows = (
        db.query(FarmEvent)
        .filter(FarmEvent.farm_id == farm_id)
        .order_by(FarmEvent.occurred_at.desc(), FarmEvent.created_at.desc())
        .all()
    )
    return [_farm_event_out(row) for row in rows]


@app.post("/api/farm-events-with-image")
async def create_farm_event(
    request: Request,
    text: str = Form(...),
    category: str = Form("Otra incidencia"),
    occurred_at: datetime | None = Form(None),
    latitude: float | None = Form(None),
    longitude: float | None = Form(None),
    file: UploadFile | None = File(None),
    farm_id: int = Depends(current_farm_id),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
) -> dict:
    clean_text = text.strip()
    clean_category = category.strip() or "Otra incidencia"
    if not clean_text:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="La descripcion de la incidencia no puede estar vacia")
    if (latitude is None) != (longitude is None):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="La ubicacion debe incluir latitud y longitud")
    if latitude is not None and not -90 <= latitude <= 90:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="Latitud no valida")
    if longitude is not None and not -180 <= longitude <= 180:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="Longitud no valida")
    user = db.get(User, int(request.state.user_id))
    if not user or user.farm_id != farm_id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="Usuario no encontrado")

    image_path = None
    image_name = None
    image_content_type = None
    if file and file.filename:
        suffix = _image_suffix(file)
        content = await file.read()
        target = _store_upload("event_images", file, content, suffix)
        image_path = _portable_upload_path(target)
        image_name = file.filename or target.name
        image_content_type = file.content_type

    row = FarmEvent(
        farm_id=farm_id,
        category=clean_category,
        text=clean_text,
        occurred_at=occurred_at or datetime.utcnow(),
        reporter_user_id=user.id,
        reporter=user.username,
        latitude=latitude,
        longitude=longitude,
        image_path=image_path,
        image_name=image_name,
        image_content_type=image_content_type,
    )
    db.add(row)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(row)
    return _farm_event_out(row)

def build_plan(db):
    catalog=json.loads((ROOT/'imagenes_incidencias_animales/catalogo.json').read_text())
    assert all(r['id'] in DESCRIPTIONS for r in catalog)
    for r in catalog:
        p=ROOT/'imagenes_incidencias_animales'/r['file']
        assert hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==r['sha256'],p
    histories={}
    with (ROOT/'historico_ubicaciones_animales.csv').open(encoding='utf-8-sig',newline='') as f:
        for r in csv.DictReader(f):
            histories.setdefault((int(r['animal_id']),r['explotacion'],r['crotal']),[]).append((float(r['latitud']),float(r['longitud'])))
    animals=db.execute('''SELECT a.id,a.crotal,f.name AS farm FROM animals a JOIN farms f ON f.id=a.farm_id
        WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM animal_locations l WHERE l.animal_id=a.id) ORDER BY a.id''').fetchall()
    start,end=date(2026,6,29),date(2026,9,29)
    plan=[]
    for a in animals:
        rng=random.Random(f'{BATCH}:{a["id"]}')
        bases=[(r[0],r[1]) for r in db.execute('SELECT latitude,longitude FROM animal_locations WHERE animal_id=? ORDER BY id',(a['id'],))]
        bases+=histories.get((a['id'],a['farm'],a['crotal']),[])
        for slot,img in enumerate(rng.sample(catalog,8),start=1):
            base_lat,base_lon=rng.choice(bases)
            lat,lon=destination(base_lat,base_lon,rng.uniform(0,360))
            assert abs(distance(base_lat,base_lon,lat,lon)-200)<0.001
            day=start+timedelta(days=rng.randint(0,(end-start).days))
            credit=f"Fuente: {img['author']}. {img['license']}. Imagen reducida."
            if img['id'].startswith('cdc_'):
                credit+=' Original gratuito en CDC/PHIL. Su uso no implica respaldo del CDC, ATSDR, HHS ni del Gobierno de EE. UU. a CowsIA.'
            plan.append(dict(simulation_key=f'{BATCH}:{a["id"]}:{slot}',animal_id=a['id'],explotacion=a['farm'],crotal=a['crotal'],
                text='[Suceso simulado] '+DESCRIPTIONS[img['id']],event_date=day.isoformat(),reporter=rng.choice(['Pedro','Lorenzo','Andres']),
                latitude=lat,longitude=lon,base_latitude=base_lat,base_longitude=base_lon,image_name=img['file'],
                image_path='backend/uploads/event_images/'+BATCH+'_'+img['id']+'.jpg',
                image_credit=credit,image_source=img['source']))
    return plan


def main():
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser();parser.add_argument('--apply',action='store_true');args=parser.parse_args()
    with sqlite3.connect(ROOT/'backend/cows.db',timeout=30) as db:
        db.row_factory=sqlite3.Row
        plan=build_plan(db)
