@app.post("/api/farm-events-with-image")
async def create_farm_event(
    request: Request,
    text: str = Form(...),
    category: str = Form("Otra incidencia"),
    occurred_at: datetime | None = Form(None),
    latitude: float | None = Form(None),
    longitude: float | None = Form(None),
    file: UploadFile | None = File(None),
    farm_id: int = Depends(current_farm_id),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
) -> dict:
    clean_text = text.strip()
    clean_category = category.strip() or "Otra incidencia"
    if not clean_text:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="La descripcion de la incidencia no puede estar vacia")
    if (latitude is None) != (longitude is None):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="La ubicacion debe incluir latitud y longitud")
    if latitude is not None and not -90 <= latitude <= 90:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="Latitud no valida")
    if longitude is not None and not -180 <= longitude <= 180:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="Longitud no valida")
    user = db.get(User, int(request.state.user_id))
    if not user or user.farm_id != farm_id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="Usuario no encontrado")

    image_path = None
    image_name = None
    image_content_type = None
    if file and file.filename:
        suffix = _image_suffix(file)
        content = await file.read()
        target = _store_upload("event_images", file, content, suffix)
        image_path = _portable_upload_path(target)
        image_name = file.filename or target.name
        image_content_type = file.content_type

    row = FarmEvent(
        farm_id=farm_id,
        category=clean_category,
        text=clean_text,
        occurred_at=occurred_at or datetime.utcnow(),
        reporter_user_id=user.id,
        reporter=user.username,
        latitude=latitude,
        longitude=longitude,
        image_path=image_path,
        image_name=image_name,
        image_content_type=image_content_type,
    )
    db.add(row)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(row)
    return _farm_event_out(row)


@app.get("/api/farm-events/{event_id}/image")
def get_farm_event_image(event_id: int, farm_id: int = Depends(current_farm_id), db: Session = Depends(get_db)) -> FileResponse:
    row = db.query(FarmEvent).filter(FarmEvent.id == event_id, FarmEvent.farm_id == farm_id).first()
    if not row or not row.image_path:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Imagen no encontrada")
    path = _resolve_upload_path(row.image_path, "event_images")
    if not path.exists():
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Imagen no encontrada en disco")
    return FileResponse(path, filename=row.image_name or path.name, media_type=row.image_content_type)


@app.delete("/api/farm-events/{event_id}")
def delete_farm_event(event_id: int, farm_id: int = Depends(current_farm_id), db: Session = Depends(get_db)) -> dict[str, bool]:
    row = db.query(FarmEvent).filter(FarmEvent.id == event_id, FarmEvent.farm_id == farm_id).first()
    if not row:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Incidencia no encontrada")
    if row.image_path:
        path = _resolve_upload_path(row.image_path, "event_images")
        shared_animal_file = db.query(AnimalEvent).filter(AnimalEvent.image_path == row.image_path).first()
        shared_farm_file = db.query(FarmEvent).filter(FarmEvent.id != row.id, FarmEvent.image_path == row.image_path).first()
        if path.exists() and not shared_animal_file and not shared_farm_file:
            path.unlink()
    db.delete(row)
    db.commit()
    return {"ok": True}


@app.get("/api/filter-options")
def filter_options(farm_id: int = Depends(current_farm_id), db: Session = Depends(get_db)) -> dict:
    def values(column) -> list[str]:
        return [
            row[0]
            for row in db.query(column)
            .filter(Animal.farm_id == farm_id)
            .distinct()
            .order_by(column.asc())
            .all()
function App({ username, farmName, canManageUsers, onLogout }) {
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState("dashboard");
  const [refreshKey, setRefreshKey] = useState(0);
  const visibleTabs = canManageUsers ? [...tabs, { id: "users", label: "Usuarios", icon: UserPlus }] : tabs;

  function refresh() {
    setRefreshKey((value) => value + 1);
  }

  return (
    <div className="app-shell">
      <aside className="sidebar">
        <div className="brand">
          <Gauge size={24} />
          <div>
            <strong>CowsIA</strong>
            <span>Registro ganadero</span>
          </div>
        </div>
        <nav>
          {visibleTabs.map((tab) => {
            const Icon = tab.icon;
            return (
              <button key={tab.id} className={activeTab === tab.id ? "active" : ""} onClick={() => setActiveTab(tab.id)}>
                <Icon size={18} />
                {tab.label}
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </nav>
        <div className="session-panel">
          <span title={username}>{username}</span>
          <small title={farmName}>{farmName}</small>
          <button type="button" onClick={onLogout}><LogOut size={16} />Salir</button>
        </div>
      </aside>
      <main>
        {activeTab === "dashboard" && <Dashboard refreshKey={refreshKey} />}
        {activeTab === "gallery" && <Gallery refreshKey={refreshKey} />}
        {activeTab === "map" && <CowsMap refreshKey={refreshKey} />}
        {activeTab === "animals" && <Animals refreshKey={refreshKey} />}
        {activeTab === "incidents" && <FarmIncidents />}
        {activeTab === "import" && <ImportXml onRefresh={refresh} />}
        {activeTab === "users" && canManageUsers && <Users />}
      </main>
    </div>
  );
}

from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
from sqlalchemy.pool import StaticPool

from app.database import Base
from app.main import _animal_by_crotal, _owned_child, animal_details, list_animals, list_farm_events
from app.schemas import AnimalDetailOut
from app.models import Animal, AnimalImage, Farm, FarmEvent, User


def database() -> Session:
    engine = create_engine(
        "sqlite://",
        connect_args={"check_same_thread": False},
        poolclass=StaticPool,
    )
    Base.metadata.create_all(engine)
    return Session(engine)


def test_animals_are_filtered_by_farm() -> None:
    db = database()
    first = Farm(name="primera")
    second = Farm(name="segunda")
    db.add_all([first, second])
    db.flush()
    db.add_all(
        [
            Animal(farm_id=first.id, crotal="ES001"),
            Animal(farm_id=second.id, crotal="ES001"),
        ]
    )
    db.commit()

    first_rows = list_animals(
        q=None,
        status=None,
        sexo=[],
        raza=None,
        causa_baja=None,
        explotacion=None,
        born_from=None,
        born_to=None,
        farm_id=first.id,
        db=db,
    )

    assert len(first_rows) == 1
    assert first_rows[0].farm_id == first.id
    assert _animal_by_crotal(db, "ES001", second.id).farm_id == second.id


def test_offspring_matches_mother_within_farm_including_inactive_animals() -> None:
    with database() as db:
        first, second = Farm(name="primera"), Farm(name="segunda")
        db.add_all([first, second])
        db.flush()
        db.add_all([
            Animal(farm_id=first.id, crotal="MADRE", sexo="Hembra", crotal_madre="MADRE"),
            Animal(farm_id=first.id, crotal="HIJA", sexo="Hembra", crotal_madre=" madre ", fecha_nacimiento=date(2025, 1, 2)),
            Animal(farm_id=first.id, crotal="HIJO", sexo="Macho", crotal_madre="MADRE", fecha_nacimiento=date(2024, 3, 4), fecha_baja=date(2025, 1, 1)),
            Animal(farm_id=first.id, crotal="SIN-FECHA", crotal_madre="MADRE"),
            Animal(farm_id=second.id, crotal="OTRA-FINCA", crotal_madre="madre"),
            Animal(farm_id=first.id, crotal="OTRA-MADRE", sexo="Hembra"),
            Animal(farm_id=first.id, crotal="NO-COINCIDE", crotal_madre="MAD"),
            Animal(farm_id=first.id, crotal="MADRE-MACHO", crotal_madre="HIJO"),
        ])
        db.flush()
        daughter = _animal_by_crotal(db, "HIJA", first.id)
        secondary = AnimalImage(animal_id=daughter.id, file_path="secondary.jpg", is_primary=False)
        primary = AnimalImage(animal_id=daughter.id, file_path="primary.jpg", is_primary=True)
        db.add_all([secondary, primary])
        db.commit()
        detail = AnimalDetailOut.model_validate(animal_details("MADRE", first.id, db))
        assert detail.offspring[0].image_url == f"/api/animal-images/{primary.id}/file"
        assert detail.offspring[1].image_url is None
        assert [(row.crotal, row.fecha_nacimiento, row.sexo) for row in detail.offspring] == [
            ("HIJA", date(2025, 1, 2), "Hembra"),
            ("HIJO", date(2024, 3, 4), "Macho"),
            ("SIN-FECHA", None, None),
        ]
        assert animal_details("OTRA-MADRE", first.id, db)["offspring"] == []
        assert animal_details("HIJO", first.id, db)["offspring"] == []


def test_child_ids_cannot_cross_farms() -> None:
    db = database()
    first = Farm(name="primera")
    second = Farm(name="segunda")
    db.add_all([first, second])
    db.flush()
    animal = Animal(farm_id=first.id, crotal="ES001")
    db.add(animal)
    db.flush()
    image = AnimalImage(animal_id=animal.id, file_path="backend/uploads/animal_images/test.jpg")
    db.add(image)
    db.commit()

    assert _owned_child(db, AnimalImage, image.id, first.id).id == image.id
    try:
        _owned_child(db, AnimalImage, image.id, second.id)
    except Exception as exc:
        assert getattr(exc, "status_code", None) == 404
    else:
        raise AssertionError("Una explotacion accedio a la imagen de otra")

services:
  backend:
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: backend/Dockerfile
    container_name: cowsia-backend
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      COWSIA_USERNAME: ${COWSIA_USERNAME:?Define COWSIA_USERNAME en el archivo .env}
      COWSIA_PASSWORD: ${COWSIA_PASSWORD:?Define COWSIA_PASSWORD en el archivo .env}
      COWSIA_FARM_NAME: ${COWSIA_FARM_NAME:?Define COWSIA_FARM_NAME en el archivo .env}
      COWSIA_DEMO_USERNAME: ${COWSIA_DEMO_USERNAME:?Define COWSIA_DEMO_USERNAME en el archivo .env}
      COWSIA_DEMO_PASSWORD: ${COWSIA_DEMO_PASSWORD:?Define COWSIA_DEMO_PASSWORD en el archivo .env}
      COWSIA_DEMO_FARM_NAME: ${COWSIA_DEMO_FARM_NAME:?Define COWSIA_DEMO_FARM_NAME en el archivo .env}
      COWSIA_SESSION_SECRET: ${COWSIA_SESSION_SECRET:?Define COWSIA_SESSION_SECRET en el archivo .env}
      COWSIA_SESSION_HOURS: ${COWSIA_SESSION_HOURS:-12}
      COWSIA_COOKIE_SECURE: ${COWSIA_COOKIE_SECURE:-false}
    volumes:
      - ./backend/cows.db:/workspace/backend/cows.db
      - ./backend/uploads:/workspace/backend/uploads
      - ./historico_ubicaciones_animales.csv:/workspace/historico_ubicaciones_animales.csv:ro
      - ./LibroRegistroAnimaleGanaderoAFechas_10-07-2023_10-07-2026.xml:/workspace/LibroRegistroAnimaleGanaderoAFechas_10-07-2023_10-07-2026.xml:ro
    expose:
      - "8000"

  frontend:
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: frontend/Dockerfile
    container_name: cowsia-frontend
    restart: unless-stopped
    depends_on:
      - backend
    ports:
      - "8081:80"
import {chromium} from 'playwright';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import {readFile,mkdir,writeFile} from 'node:fs/promises';
const reference=JSON.parse(await readFile('/tmp/cowsia-activity-expected.json','utf8'));
const output='../docs/filtros-y-dashboard';await mkdir(output,{recursive:true});
const browser=await chromium.launch({headless:true});const context=await browser.newContext({viewport:{width:1440,height:1100}});const page=await context.newPage();const errors=[];page.on('pageerror',e=>errors.push(e.message));const checks=[];
const empty={date_from:'',date_to:'',reporter:'',category:'',crotal:'',sexo:'',origin:'all'};const states={animals:{...empty},farm:{...empty}};
const section=(kind)=>page.locator(`[data-activity-kind="${kind}"]`);
function selected(kind,f){return reference[kind].filter(r=>{const day=(r.event_date||r.occurred_at).slice(0,10);return (!f.date_from||day>=f.date_from)&&(!f.date_to||day<=f.date_to)&&(!f.reporter||r.reporter===f.reporter)&&(!f.category||r.category===f.category)&&(!f.crotal||r.crotal.toLowerCase().includes(f.crotal.trim().toLowerCase()))&&(!f.sexo||r.sexo?.toLowerCase()===f.sexo.toLowerCase())&&(f.origin==='all'||(f.origin==='simulated'?Boolean(r.simulation_key):!r.simulation_key));});}
async function settled(kind,total){await page.waitForFunction(({kind,total})=>{const s=document.querySelector(`[data-activity-kind="${kind}"]`);return s?.querySelector('[aria-busy]')?.getAttribute('aria-busy')==='false'&&Number(s.querySelector('.metric strong')?.textContent)===total;},{kind,total});}
function responseFor(kind){return page.waitForResponse(r=>{const u=new URL(r.url());return u.pathname===`/api/dashboard/activity/${kind}`&&Object.entries(states[kind]).every(([key,value])=>u.searchParams.get(key)===(value||null));});}
async function apply(kind,changes,clear=false){
 states[kind]=clear?{...empty}:{...states[kind],...changes};const response=responseFor(kind);response.catch(()=>{});const scope=section(kind);
 if(clear)await scope.getByRole('button',{name:'Limpiar filtros'}).click();else for(const [key,value] of Object.entries(changes)){
  const labels={date_from:'Desde',date_to:'Hasta',reporter:'Informante',category:'Tipo de incidencia',crotal:'Crotal',sexo:'Sexo',origin:'Registros'};

@app.get("/api/animals", response_model=list[AnimalOut])
def list_animals(
    q: str | None = None,
    status: str | None = None,
    sexo: list[str] = Query(default_factory=list),
    raza: str | None = None,
    causa_baja: str | None = None,
    explotacion: str | None = None,
    born_from: date | None = None,
    born_to: date | None = None,
    farm_id: int = Depends(current_farm_id),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
) -> list[Animal]:
    query = db.query(Animal).filter(Animal.farm_id == farm_id)
    if q:
        pattern = f"%{q}%"
        query = query.filter(or_(Animal.crotal.ilike(pattern), Animal.crotal_madre.ilike(pattern), Animal.procedencia.ilike(pattern), Animal.destino.ilike(pattern)))
    if status == "Activo":
        query = query.filter(Animal.fecha_baja.is_(None), or_(Animal.causa_baja.is_(None), Animal.causa_baja == ""))
    if status == "Baja":
        query = query.filter(or_(Animal.fecha_baja.is_not(None), Animal.causa_baja.is_not(None) & (Animal.causa_baja != "")))
    if sexo:
        query = query.filter(Animal.sexo.in_(sexo))
    if raza:
        query = query.filter(Animal.raza == raza)
    if causa_baja:
        query = query.filter(Animal.causa_baja == causa_baja)
    if explotacion:
        query = query.filter(or_(Animal.explotacion_pertenencia == explotacion, Animal.explotacion_ubicacion == explotacion, Animal.explotacion_nacimiento == explotacion))
    if born_from:
        query = query.filter(Animal.fecha_nacimiento >= born_from)
    if born_to:
        query = query.filter(Animal.fecha_nacimiento <= born_to)
    return query.order_by(Animal.fecha_nacimiento.desc().nullslast(), Animal.crotal.asc()).all()


def _animal_by_crotal(db: Session, crotal: str, farm_id: int) -> Animal:
    animal = db.query(Animal).filter(Animal.farm_id == farm_id, Animal.crotal == crotal).first()
    if not animal:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Animal no encontrado")
    return animal

    """Farm-scoped tasks; their author always comes from the authenticated session."""
    from datetime import date, datetime
    from pathlib import Path
    from typing import Literal
    from uuid import uuid4
    
    from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, File, Form, HTTPException, Request, UploadFile
    from fastapi.responses import FileResponse
    from pydantic import BaseModel
    from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
    
    from app.database import get_db
    from app.models import Animal, AnimalEvent, FarmEvent, Task, User
    
    router = APIRouter(prefix="/api/tasks", tags=["tasks"])
    ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
    IMAGE_TYPES = {"image/jpeg": ".jpg", "image/png": ".png", "image/webp": ".webp", "image/gif": ".gif"}
    TaskStatus = Literal["pending", "in_progress", "completed"]
    
    
    def farm_scope(request: Request) -> int:
        return int(request.state.farm_id)
    
    
    def owned_task(db: Session, task_id: int, farm_id: int) -> Task:
        row = db.query(Task).filter(Task.id == task_id, Task.farm_id == farm_id).first()
        if not row:
            raise HTTPException(404, "Tarea no encontrada")
        return row
    
    
    def task_out(row: Task) -> dict:
        return {key: getattr(row, key) for key in (
            "id", "creator", "due_date", "description", "status", "animal_id", "animal_event_id",
            "farm_event_id", "association_label", "created_at", "completed_at"
        )} | {"image_url": f"/api/tasks/{row.id}/image" if row.image_path else None}
    
    
    @router.get("")
    def list_tasks(status: TaskStatus | None = None, date_from: date | None = None,
                   date_to: date | None = None, animal_id: int | None = None,
                   farm_id: int = Depends(farm_scope), db: Session = Depends(get_db)) -> list[dict]:
        if date_from and date_to and date_from > date_to:
            raise HTTPException(422, "La fecha inicial no puede ser posterior a la final")
        query = db.query(Task).filter(Task.farm_id == farm_id)
        if status:
            query = query.filter(Task.status == status)
        if date_from:
            query = query.filter(Task.due_date >= date_from)
        if date_to:
            query = query.filter(Task.due_date <= date_to)
        if animal_id is not None:
            query = query.filter(Task.animal_id == animal_id)
        return [task_out(row) for row in query.order_by(Task.due_date, Task.id.desc()).all()]
    
    
    @router.post("", status_code=201)
    async def create_task(request: Request, due_date: date = Form(...), description: str = Form(...),
                          animal_id: int | None = Form(None), animal_event_id: int | None = Form(None),
                          farm_event_id: int | None = Form(None), file: UploadFile | None = File(None),
                          farm_id: int = Depends(farm_scope), db: Session = Depends(get_db)) -> dict:
        description = description.strip()
        if not description or len(description) > 10000:
            raise HTTPException(422, "La descripción debe tener entre 1 y 10000 caracteres")
        user = db.get(User, int(request.state.user_id))
        if not user or not user.active or user.farm_id != farm_id:
            raise HTTPException(401, "Usuario no encontrado")
        if farm_event_id is not None and (animal_id is not None or animal_event_id is not None):
            raise HTTPException(422, "Selecciona una incidencia de explotación o un animal/suceso")
        label = None
        if animal_event_id is not None:
            event = db.query(AnimalEvent).join(Animal).filter(AnimalEvent.id == animal_event_id, Animal.farm_id == farm_id).first()
            if not event:
                raise HTTPException(404, "Suceso no encontrado")
            if animal_id is not None and event.animal_id != animal_id:
                raise HTTPException(422, "El suceso no pertenece al animal seleccionado")
            animal_id = event.animal_id
            label = f"Suceso #{event.id} · {event.event_date or 'Sin fecha'} · {event.text}"
        if animal_id is not None:
            animal = db.query(Animal).filter(Animal.id == animal_id, Animal.farm_id == farm_id).first()
            if not animal:
                raise HTTPException(404, "Animal no encontrado")
            label = f"Animal {animal.crotal}" + (f" · {label}" if label else "")
        if farm_event_id is not None:
            event = db.query(FarmEvent).filter(FarmEvent.id == farm_event_id, FarmEvent.farm_id == farm_id).first()
            if not event:
                raise HTTPException(404, "Incidencia no encontrada")
            label = f"Incidencia #{event.id} · {event.category} · {event.occurred_at:%d/%m/%Y} · {event.text}"
        target = None
        if file and file.filename:
            suffix = IMAGE_TYPES.get(file.content_type)
            if not suffix:
                raise HTTPException(422, "Solo se admiten imágenes JPG, PNG, WEBP o GIF")
            content = await file.read(10 * 1024 * 1024 + 1)
            if not content or len(content) > 10 * 1024 * 1024:
                raise HTTPException(422, "La foto debe contener datos y ocupar como máximo 10 MB")
            target = ROOT / "backend" / "uploads" / "task_images" / f"{uuid4().hex}{suffix}"
            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            target.write_bytes(content)
        row = Task(farm_id=farm_id, creator_user_id=user.id, creator=user.username,
                   due_date=due_date, description=description, animal_id=animal_id,
                   animal_event_id=animal_event_id, farm_event_id=farm_event_id,
                   association_label=label, image_path=target.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix() if target else None,
                   image_content_type=file.content_type if target else None)
        try:
            db.add(row)
            db.commit()
            db.refresh(row)
        except Exception:
            db.rollback()
            if target:
                target.unlink(missing_ok=True)
            raise
        return task_out(row)
    
    
    class StatusUpdate(BaseModel):
        status: TaskStatus
    
    
    @router.post("/{task_id}/status")
    def update_status(task_id: int, payload: StatusUpdate, farm_id: int = Depends(farm_scope), db: Session = Depends(get_db)) -> dict:
        row = owned_task(db, task_id, farm_id)
        if row.status != payload.status:
            row.status = payload.status
            row.completed_at = datetime.utcnow() if payload.status == "completed" else None
            db.commit()
            db.refresh(row)
        return task_out(row)
    
    
    @router.get("/{task_id}/image")
    def task_image(task_id: int, farm_id: int = Depends(farm_scope), db: Session = Depends(get_db)) -> FileResponse:
        row = owned_task(db, task_id, farm_id)
        if not row.image_path or not (ROOT / row.image_path).is_file():
            raise HTTPException(404, "Imagen no encontrada")
        return FileResponse(ROOT / row.image_path, media_type=row.image_content_type)

    import React, { createContext, useContext, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
    import { api } from './api/client';
    
    export const TaskContext = createContext(null);

    }
    const statusLabels = { pending: 'Pendiente', in_progress: 'En curso', completed: 'Completada' };

    const dateLabel = value => value ? new Date(`${value.slice(0,10)}T12:00:00`).toLocaleDateString('es-ES') : 'Sin fecha';

        let alive = true;
        setEvents([]);
        const animal = animals.find(a => String(a.id) === animalId);
        if (kind !== 'event' || !animal) { setEventsLoading(false); return; }
        setEventsLoading(true);
        api.get(`/api/animals/${encodeURIComponent(animal.crotal)}/details`)
          .then(d => { if(alive) setEvents(d.events); })
          .catch(e => { if(alive) setError(e.message); })
          .finally(() => { if(alive) setEventsLoading(false); });
        return () => { alive = false; };
      }, [kind, animalId, animals]);
      useEffect(() => {
        const url = file ? URL.createObjectURL(file) : '';
        setPreview(url);
        return () => { if(url) URL.revokeObjectURL(url); };
      }, [file]);
      async function save(e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        if(saving.current) return;
        if(!description.trim()) { setError('Escribe la tarea a realizar.'); return; }
        if(file && file.size > 10*1024*1024) { setError('La foto no puede superar 10 MB.'); return; }
        saving.current = true; setBusy(true); setError('');
        const form = new FormData();
        form.append('due_date', dueDate); form.append('description', description.trim());
        if(kind === 'animal' || kind === 'event') form.append('animal_id', animalId);
        if(kind === 'event') form.append('animal_event_id', eventId);
        if(kind === 'farm') form.append('farm_event_id', farmId);
        if(file) form.append('file', file);
        try { const row = await api.uploadForm('/api/tasks', form); onSaved(row); }
        catch(e) { setError(e.message); }
        finally { saving.current = false; setBusy(false); }
      }
      return <dialog ref={dialog} className="task-dialog" aria-labelledby="task-form-title" onCancel={e => { e.preventDefault(); if(!busy) onClose(); }}>
        <form onSubmit={save} className="task-form">
          <header><h2 id="task-form-title">Nueva tarea</h2><button type="button" disabled={busy} onClick={onClose} aria-label="Cerrar nueva tarea">Cerrar</button></header>
          <label>Quién pone la tarea<input value={username} readOnly /></label>
          <label>Fecha prevista<input type="date" required value={dueDate} onChange={e => setDueDate(e.target.value)} /></label>
          <label>Asociar a<select aria-label="Asociar a" value={kind} onChange={e => { setKind(e.target.value); setError(''); }}>
            <option value="none">Sin asociación</option><option value="animal">Animal</option><option value="event">Suceso de un animal</option><option value="farm">Incidencia de explotación</option>
          </select></label>
          {loading && <p role="status">Cargando registros…</p>}
          {(kind === 'animal' || kind === 'event') && <label>Animal<select aria-label="Animal" required value={animalId} onChange={e => { setAnimalId(e.target.value); setEventId(''); }}>
            <option value="">Selecciona un animal</option>{animals.map(a => <option key={a.id} value={a.id}>{a.crotal}</option>)}
          </select></label>}
          {kind === 'event' && <label>Suceso<select aria-label="Suceso" required disabled={eventsLoading} value={eventId} onChange={e => setEventId(e.target.value)}>
            <option value="">{eventsLoading ? 'Cargando sucesos…' : 'Selecciona un suceso'}</option>{events.map(e => <option key={e.id} value={e.id}>#{e.id} · {dateLabel(e.event_date)} · {e.text.slice(0,150)}</option>)}
          </select>{animalId && !eventsLoading && !events.length && <small>Este animal no tiene sucesos.</small>}</label>}
          {kind === 'farm' && <label>Incidencia<select aria-label="Incidencia" required value={farmId} onChange={e => setFarmId(e.target.value)}>
            <option value="">Selecciona una incidencia</option>{incidents.map(r => <option key={r.id} value={r.id}>#{r.id} · {dateLabel(r.occurred_at)} · {r.category} · {r.text.slice(0,100)}</option>)}
          </select></label>}
          <label>Descripción de la tarea<textarea required maxLength={10000} rows={4} value={description} onChange={e => setDescription(e.target.value)} placeholder="Describe lo que hay que hacer" /></label>
          <label>Foto opcional (máximo 10 MB)<input type="file" accept="image/jpeg,image/png,image/webp,image/gif" onChange={e => setFile(e.target.files?.[0] || null)} /></label>
          {preview && <img className="task-photo" src={preview} alt="Vista previa de la foto de la tarea" />}
          {error && <p className="error" role="alert">{error}</p>}
          <button className="primary" disabled={busy || loading || eventsLoading} type="submit">{busy ? 'Guardando…' : 'Guardar tarea'}</button>
        </form>
      </dialog>;
    }
    
    export function Tasks({ refreshKey }) {
      const [rows, setRows] = useState([]);
      const [filters, setFilters] = useState({ status:'', date_from:'', date_to:'' });
      const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
      const [error, setError] = useState('');
      const [refresh, setRefresh] = useState(0);
      const [busyId, setBusyId] = useState(null);
      const [limit, setLimit] = useState(30);
      const invalid = filters.date_from && filters.date_to && filters.date_from > filters.date_to;
      useEffect(() => {
        let alive = true;
        setError(''); setLimit(30);
        if(invalid) { setRows([]); setLoading(false); return; }
        setLoading(true);
        const params = new URLSearchParams(Object.entries(filters).filter(([,v]) => v));
        api.get(`/api/tasks?${params}`).then(data => { if(alive) setRows(data); })
          .catch(e => { if(alive) { setError(e.message); setRows([]); } })
          .finally(() => { if(alive) setLoading(false); });
        return () => { alive = false; };
      }, [filters, refreshKey, refresh, invalid]);
      async function changeStatus(row, status) {
        setBusyId(row.id); setError('');
        try { await api.post(`/api/tasks/${row.id}/status`, {status}); setRefresh(v => v+1); }
        catch(e) { setError(e.message); }
        finally { setBusyId(null); }
      }
      return <section className="tasks-page">
        <div className="task-page-title"><h1>Gestor de tareas</h1><TaskButton>Nueva tarea</TaskButton></div>
        <p className="muted">Tareas de tu explotación, ordenadas por fecha prevista. Todos los usuarios de la explotación pueden crear tareas y actualizar su estado.</p>
        <section className="panel activity-filters" aria-label="Filtros de tareas"><h2>Filtros de tareas</h2><div className="compact-form">
          <label>Estado<select aria-label="Estado" value={filters.status} onChange={e => setFilters({...filters,status:e.target.value})}><option value="">Todos</option>{Object.entries(statusLabels).map(([v,l]) => <option key={v} value={v}>{l}</option>)}</select></label>
          <label>Desde<input type="date" value={filters.date_from} onChange={e => setFilters({...filters,date_from:e.target.value})} /></label>
          <label>Hasta<input type="date" value={filters.date_to} onChange={e => setFilters({...filters,date_to:e.target.value})} /></label>
          <button type="button" onClick={() => setFilters({status:'',date_from:'',date_to:''})}>Limpiar filtros</button>
        </div>{invalid && <p role="alert" className="error">La fecha inicial no puede ser posterior a la final.</p>}</section>
        {error && <p role="alert" className="error">{error}</p>}
        {loading ? <p role="status">Cargando tareas…</p> : <><p aria-live="polite">{rows.length} tareas</p>
          {!rows.length && !invalid && !error && <p className="panel">No hay tareas que coincidan con los filtros. Puedes crear una con «Nueva tarea».</p>}
          <div className="task-list">{rows.slice(0,limit).map(row => <article className="panel task-card" key={row.id}>
            <header><strong>Tarea #{row.id} · {dateLabel(row.due_date)}</strong><span className="pill">{statusLabels[row.status]}</span></header>
            {row.status !== 'completed' && row.due_date < today() && <p className="error">Fecha prevista vencida</p>}
            <p className="task-description">{row.description}</p>
            <p className="muted">Creada por {row.creator} · {dateLabel(row.created_at)}</p>
            {row.association_label ? <details><summary>Animal o registro asociado</summary><p className="task-description">{row.association_label}</p>{!row.farm_event_id && !row.animal_event_id && row.association_label.includes(' · ') && <small>El registro de origen se eliminó; se conserva esta referencia histórica.</small>}</details> : <p className="muted">Sin asociación</p>}
            {row.image_url && <a href={api.url(row.image_url)} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" aria-label={`Abrir foto de tarea ${row.id}`}><img loading="lazy" className="task-photo" src={api.url(row.image_url)} alt={`Foto de la tarea ${row.id}`} /></a>}
            <label>Estado de la tarea<select aria-label={`Estado de tarea ${row.id}`} value={row.status} disabled={busyId !== null} onChange={e => changeStatus(row,e.target.value)}>{Object.entries(statusLabels).map(([v,l]) => <option key={v} value={v}>{l}</option>)}</select></label>
            {row.completed_at && <small>Completada el {dateLabel(row.completed_at)}</small>}
          </article>)}</div>
          {rows.length > limit && <button type="button" onClick={() => setLimit(n=>n+30)}>Mostrar más tareas</button>}
        </>}
      </section>;
    }

from datetime import date, datetime
import pytest
from fastapi import HTTPException
from app.analytics import event_activity
from app.main import dashboard_activity
from app.models import Animal, AnimalEvent, Farm, FarmEvent, User
from test_multitenancy import database


def seed(db):
    farm=Farm(name='activity');other=Farm(name='private-activity');db.add_all([farm,other]);db.flush()
    user=User(farm_id=farm.id,username='pepe-activity',password_hash='unused');other_user=User(farm_id=other.id,username='private-reporter',password_hash='unused');db.add_all([user,other_user]);db.flush()
    female=Animal(farm_id=farm.id,crotal='ES-001',sexo='Hembra');male=Animal(farm_id=farm.id,crotal='ES-002',sexo='Macho');foreign=Animal(farm_id=other.id,crotal='ES-001',sexo='Hembra');db.add_all([female,male,foreign]);db.flush()
    db.add_all([
        AnimalEvent(animal_id=female.id,text='Real',event_date=date(2026,1,31),reporter='Pedro'),
        AnimalEvent(animal_id=female.id,text='Simulado',event_date=date(2026,3,1),reporter='Pedro',latitude=39,longitude=-6,simulation_key='animal:1'),
        AnimalEvent(animal_id=male.id,text='Otro',event_date=date(2026,3,1),reporter='Andres'),
        AnimalEvent(animal_id=foreign.id,text='Privado',event_date=date(2026,3,1),reporter='private-reporter'),
        FarmEvent(farm_id=farm.id,category='Puerta abierta o danada',text='Real',occurred_at=datetime(2026,1,31,23,59,59,999999),reporter_user_id=user.id,reporter='Pedro'),
        FarmEvent(farm_id=farm.id,category='Residuos o vertidos',text='Simulado',occurred_at=datetime(2026,2,1),reporter_user_id=user.id,reporter='Andres',latitude=39,longitude=-6,simulation_key='farm:1'),
        FarmEvent(farm_id=other.id,category='Categoria privada',text='Privado',occurred_at=datetime(2026,1,31),reporter_user_id=other_user.id,reporter='private-reporter'),
    ]);db.commit();return farm.id,other.id


def test_activity_counts_zero_months_and_farm_isolation():
    with database() as db:
        farm,other=seed(db)
        result=event_activity(db,farm,'animals')
        assert (result['total'],result['animals_affected'],result['with_location'],result['simulated'])==(3,2,1,1)
        assert result['timeline']==[{'name':'2026-01','value':1},{'name':'2026-02','value':0},{'name':'2026-03','value':2}]
        assert result['options']['reporters']==['Andres','Pedro']
        assert event_activity(db,other,'animals')['total']==1
        farm_events=event_activity(db,farm,'farm')
        assert farm_events['total']==2
        assert 'Categoria privada' not in farm_events['options']['categories']
        assert sum(x['value'] for x in farm_events['distribution'])==2


def test_animal_combined_filters_and_literal_crotal_search():
    with database() as db:
        farm,_=seed(db)
        result=event_activity(db,farm,'animals',date_from=date(2026,3,1),date_to=date(2026,3,1),reporter='Pedro',crotal=' es-001 ',sexo='hembra',origin='simulated')
        assert result['total']==result['animals_affected']==1
        assert event_activity(db,farm,'animals',origin='real')['total']==2
        assert event_activity(db,farm,'animals',sexo='Macho')['total']==1
        assert event_activity(db,farm,'animals',crotal='%')['total']==0


def test_farm_filters_include_the_entire_end_day_and_keep_filter_options():
    with database() as db:
        farm,_=seed(db)
        result=event_activity(db,farm,'farm',date_from=date(2026,1,31),date_to=date(2026,1,31),category='Puerta abierta o danada',reporter='Pedro',origin='real')
        assert result['total']==1
        assert result['options']['reporters']==['Andres','Pedro']
        assert event_activity(db,farm,'farm',origin='simulated')['total']==1
        empty=event_activity(db,farm,'farm',date_from=date(2027,1,1))
        assert empty['total']==0 and empty['timeline']==[] and empty['distribution']==[]
        with pytest.raises(HTTPException) as exc:
            dashboard_activity('farm',date_from=date(2026,3,1),date_to=date(2026,2,1),farm_id=farm,db=db)
        assert exc.value.status_code==422
from app.auth import create_session_token, get_auth_settings, hash_password, password_is_valid, session_user_id


def configure_auth(monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("COWSIA_SESSION_SECRET", "secreto-de-prueba-con-mas-de-32-caracteres")


def test_passwords_are_hashed_and_verified() -> None:
    encoded = hash_password("contrasena-prueba", salt=b"0123456789abcdef")

    assert "contrasena-prueba" not in encoded
    assert password_is_valid("contrasena-prueba", encoded)
    assert not password_is_valid("incorrecta", encoded)
    assert not password_is_valid("contrasena-prueba", "hash-invalido")


def test_expired_and_modified_tokens_are_rejected(monkeypatch):
    configure_auth(monkeypatch)
    settings = get_auth_settings()
    token = create_session_token(42, settings, now=100)

    assert session_user_id(token, settings, now=101) == 42
    assert session_user_id(token, settings, now=100 + settings.session_seconds) is None
    assert session_user_id(f"{token}modificado", settings, now=101) is None

    def test_non_admin_can_create_all_associations_and_author_is_session(setup):
        client,db,users,animals,events,incidents=setup
        for association in ({},{'animal_id':animals[0].id},{'animal_event_id':events[0].id},{'farm_event_id':incidents[0].id}):
            response=create(client,creator='forged',**association)
            assert response.status_code==201,response.text
            row=response.json()
            assert row['creator']==users[0].username
            assert row['description']=='Hacer revisión'
            assert row['status']=='pending'
            if 'animal_event_id' in association:
                assert row['animal_id']==animals[0].id
                assert 'ES0' in row['association_label'] and 'Revisar ojo' in row['association_label']
        assert len(client.get('/api/tasks').json())==4
    
    
    def test_cross_farm_references_and_incompatible_associations_are_rejected(setup):
        client,db,users,animals,events,incidents=setup
        for association in ({'animal_id':animals[1].id},{'animal_event_id':events[1].id},{'farm_event_id':incidents[1].id}):
            assert create(client,**association).status_code==404
        assert create(client,animal_id=animals[0].id,farm_event_id=incidents[0].id).status_code==422
        assert create(client,animal_id=animals[1].id,animal_event_id=events[0].id).status_code==422
        assert db.query(Task).count()==0
    
    
    def test_dates_status_reopen_and_isolation(setup):
        client,*_=setup
        row=create(client).json(); url=f"/api/tasks/{row['id']}/status"
        assert client.post(url,json={'status':'in_progress'}).json()['status']=='in_progress'
        done=client.post(url,json={'status':'completed'}).json()
        assert done['completed_at']
        assert client.post(url,json={'status':'completed'}).json()['completed_at']==done['completed_at']
        assert client.get('/api/tasks?status=pending').json()==[]
        assert len(client.get('/api/tasks?status=completed&date_from=2026-09-30&date_to=2026-09-30').json())==1
        assert client.get('/api/tasks?date_to=2026-09-29').json()==[]
        assert client.post(url,json={'status':'pending'}).json()['completed_at'] is None
        assert client.post(url,json={'status':'invalid'}).status_code==422
        assert client.get('/api/tasks?date_from=2026-10-01&date_to=2026-09-01').status_code==422
        assert client.get('/api/tasks',headers={'x-test-user':'1'}).json()==[]
        assert client.post(url,json={'status':'completed'},headers={'x-test-user':'1'}).status_code==404
    
    
    def test_photo_persists_and_is_protected(setup):
        client,*_=setup
        photo=b'GIF89a'+b'example'
        response=client.post('/api/tasks',data={'due_date':'2026-09-30','description':'Con foto'},files={'file':('foto.gif',BytesIO(photo),'image/gif')})
        assert response.status_code==201,response.text
        url=response.json()['image_url']
        assert client.get(url).content==photo
        assert client.get(url,headers={'x-test-user':'1'}).status_code==404
        assert client.get(f"/api/tasks/{create(client).json()['id']}/image").status_code==404
    
    
    def test_invalid_content_creates_no_rows(setup):
        client,db,*_=setup
        assert create(client,description='   ').status_code==422
        assert create(client,due_date='not-date').status_code==422
        assert create(client,description='x'*10001).status_code==422
        for content,mime in ((b'bad','text/html'),(b'','image/jpeg'),(b'x'*(10*1024*1024+1),'image/jpeg')):
            response=client.post('/api/tasks',data={'due_date':'2026-09-30','description':'Foto'},files={'file':('file',content,mime)})
            assert response.status_code==422
        assert db.query(Task).count()==0
    
    
    def test_deleting_source_preserves_task_history_without_dangling_foreign_keys(setup):
        client,db,users,animals,events,incidents=setup
        animal_task=create(client,animal_event_id=events[0].id).json()
        farm_task=create(client,farm_event_id=incidents[0].id).json()
        delete_animal_event(events[0].id,users[0].farm_id,db)
        delete_farm_event(incidents[0].id,users[0].farm_id,db)
        rows={r['id']:r for r in client.get('/api/tasks').json()}
        assert rows[animal_task['id']]['animal_event_id'] is None
        assert rows[animal_task['id']]['association_label']==animal_task['association_label']
        assert rows[farm_task['id']]['farm_event_id'] is None
        assert rows[farm_task['id']]['association_label']==farm_task['association_label']
    PY

    # Gestor de tareas de CowsIA
    
    Disponible en el menú **Tareas** para todos los usuarios autenticados de la explotación.
    
    ## Crear una tarea
    
    - Desde **Tareas → Nueva tarea**, seleccionar una asociación opcional: animal, suceso de un animal o incidencia de explotación.
    - Desde una ficha de animal, un suceso o una tarjeta de incidencia, pulsar **Crear tarea**: se selecciona automáticamente el registro de origen.
    - Indicar la **fecha prevista** y la **descripción de la tarea**. Se puede adjuntar una foto JPG, PNG, WEBP o GIF de hasta 10 MB, con vista previa.
    - **Quién pone la tarea** se registra automáticamente con la cuenta autenticada. La fecha de creación se guarda aparte de la fecha prevista.
    
    ## Consultar y gestionar
    
    Las tareas se ordenan por fecha prevista y se pueden filtrar por estado y por fechas inclusivas. Los estados son **Pendiente**, **En curso** y **Completada**. Se registra la fecha de finalización y se permite reabrir la tarea. Las tareas pendientes o en curso cuya fecha prevista haya pasado se señalan como vencidas.
    
    Cada tarjeta muestra su autor, descripción, foto opcional y referencia al animal o registro asociado. Desplegar **Animal o registro asociado** para consultar el crotal y el texto del registro de origen. Si se elimina el suceso o incidencia original, la tarea conserva la referencia histórica.
    
    Los usuarios de una misma explotación comparten las tareas. Los datos y las fotos no se pueden consultar ni modificar desde otra explotación.
    
    ## Verificación
    
    - 14 pruebas del servidor superadas: tareas, asociaciones válidas, usuarios sin permisos de administración, separación entre explotaciones, fotos, fechas, estados, reapertura y conservación del historial al eliminar el origen; también regresiones de incidencias y analítica.
    - Prueba de navegador: creación desde los cuatro puntos de entrada, foto, estados, filtros, recarga, aislamiento y visualización en móvil de 390 px.
    - Las tareas y fotos temporales de verificación se retiran tras las pruebas.
    
    ### Capturas de la prueba
    
    Estas capturas contienen registros temporales de comprobación, no tareas reales:
    
    - [Gestor en escritorio](tareas-escritorio.png)
    - [Formulario en móvil](nueva-tarea-movil.png)
    - [Gestor en móvil](tareas-movil.png)
    - [Resultado de la comprobación](resultado.json)
    
    ## Archivos principales
    
    - `backend/app/tasks.py`: API y validación de asociaciones.
    - `backend/app/models.py`: tabla `tasks`, creada automáticamente al iniciar.
    - `frontend/src/Tasks.jsx`: gestor y formulario.
    - `backend/tests/test_tasks.py`: pruebas aisladas, con integridad referencial activada.
    - `frontend/scripts/check-tasks.mjs`: prueba de navegador; genera un manifiesto de registros temporales en `/tmp/cowsia-test-tasks.json` para su retirada al terminar.
    
    Copia de seguridad previa: `backend/cows_pre_tasks_20260929_114054.bak`.

"""Farm-scoped tasks; their author always comes from the authenticated session."""
from datetime import date, datetime
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Literal
from uuid import uuid4

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, File, Form, HTTPException, Request, UploadFile
from fastapi.responses import FileResponse
from pydantic import BaseModel
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.database import get_db
from app.models import Animal, AnimalEvent, FarmEvent, Task, User

router = APIRouter(prefix="/api/tasks", tags=["tasks"])
ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
IMAGE_TYPES = {"image/jpeg": ".jpg", "image/png": ".png", "image/webp": ".webp", "image/gif": ".gif"}
TaskStatus = Literal["pending", "in_progress", "completed"]


def farm_scope(request: Request) -> int:
    return int(request.state.farm_id)


def owned_task(db: Session, task_id: int, farm_id: int) -> Task:
    row = db.query(Task).filter(Task.id == task_id, Task.farm_id == farm_id).first()
    if not row:
        raise HTTPException(404, "Tarea no encontrada")
    return row


def task_out(row: Task) -> dict:
    return {key: getattr(row, key) for key in (
        "id", "creator", "due_date", "description", "status", "animal_id", "animal_event_id",
        "farm_event_id", "association_label", "created_at", "completed_at"
    )} | {"image_url": f"/api/tasks/{row.id}/image" if row.image_path else None}


@router.get("")
def list_tasks(status: TaskStatus | None = None, date_from: date | None = None,
               date_to: date | None = None, animal_id: int | None = None,
               farm_id: int = Depends(farm_scope), db: Session = Depends(get_db)) -> list[dict]:
    if date_from and date_to and date_from > date_to:
        raise HTTPException(422, "La fecha inicial no puede ser posterior a la final")
    query = db.query(Task).filter(Task.farm_id == farm_id)
    if status:
        query = query.filter(Task.status == status)
    if date_from:
        query = query.filter(Task.due_date >= date_from)
    if date_to:
        query = query.filter(Task.due_date <= date_to)
    if animal_id is not None:
        query = query.filter(Task.animal_id == animal_id)
    return [task_out(row) for row in query.order_by(Task.due_date, Task.id.desc()).all()]


@router.post("", status_code=201)
async def create_task(request: Request, due_date: date = Form(...), description: str = Form(...),
                      animal_id: int | None = Form(None), animal_event_id: int | None = Form(None),
                      farm_event_id: int | None = Form(None), file: UploadFile | None = File(None),
                      farm_id: int = Depends(farm_scope), db: Session = Depends(get_db)) -> dict:
    description = description.strip()
    if not description or len(description) > 10000:
        raise HTTPException(422, "La descripción debe tener entre 1 y 10000 caracteres")
    user = db.get(User, int(request.state.user_id))
    if not user or not user.active or user.farm_id != farm_id:
        raise HTTPException(401, "Usuario no encontrado")
    if farm_event_id is not None and (animal_id is not None or animal_event_id is not None):
        raise HTTPException(422, "Selecciona una incidencia de explotación o un animal/suceso")
    label = None
    if animal_event_id is not None:
        event = db.query(AnimalEvent).join(Animal).filter(AnimalEvent.id == animal_event_id, Animal.farm_id == farm_id).first()
        if not event:
            raise HTTPException(404, "Suceso no encontrado")
        if animal_id is not None and event.animal_id != animal_id:
            raise HTTPException(422, "El suceso no pertenece al animal seleccionado")
        animal_id = event.animal_id
        label = f"Suceso #{event.id} · {event.event_date or 'Sin fecha'} · {event.text}"
    if animal_id is not None:
        animal = db.query(Animal).filter(Animal.id == animal_id, Animal.farm_id == farm_id).first()
        if not animal:
            raise HTTPException(404, "Animal no encontrado")
        label = f"Animal {animal.crotal}" + (f" · {label}" if label else "")
    if farm_event_id is not None:
        event = db.query(FarmEvent).filter(FarmEvent.id == farm_event_id, FarmEvent.farm_id == farm_id).first()
        if not event:
            raise HTTPException(404, "Incidencia no encontrada")
        label = f"Incidencia #{event.id} · {event.category} · {event.occurred_at:%d/%m/%Y} · {event.text}"
    target = None
    if file and file.filename:
        suffix = IMAGE_TYPES.get(file.content_type)
        if not suffix:
            raise HTTPException(422, "Solo se admiten imágenes JPG, PNG, WEBP o GIF")
        content = await file.read(10 * 1024 * 1024 + 1)
        if not content or len(content) > 10 * 1024 * 1024:
            raise HTTPException(422, "La foto debe contener datos y ocupar como máximo 10 MB")
        target = ROOT / "backend" / "uploads" / "task_images" / f"{uuid4().hex}{suffix}"
        target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        target.write_bytes(content)
    row = Task(farm_id=farm_id, creator_user_id=user.id, creator=user.username,
               due_date=due_date, description=description, animal_id=animal_id,
               animal_event_id=animal_event_id, farm_event_id=farm_event_id,
               association_label=label, image_path=target.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix() if target else None,
               image_content_type=file.content_type if target else None)
    try:
        db.add(row)
        db.commit()
        db.refresh(row)
    except Exception:
        db.rollback()
        if target:
            target.unlink(missing_ok=True)
        raise
    return task_out(row)


class StatusUpdate(BaseModel):
    status: TaskStatus


@router.post("/{task_id}/status")
def update_status(task_id: int, payload: StatusUpdate, farm_id: int = Depends(farm_scope), db: Session = Depends(get_db)) -> dict:
    row = owned_task(db, task_id, farm_id)
    if row.status != payload.status:
        row.status = payload.status
        row.completed_at = datetime.utcnow() if payload.status == "completed" else None
        db.commit()
        db.refresh(row)
    return task_out(row)


@router.get("/{task_id}/image")
def task_image(task_id: int, farm_id: int = Depends(farm_scope), db: Session = Depends(get_db)) -> FileResponse:
    row = owned_task(db, task_id, farm_id)
    if not row.image_path or not (ROOT / row.image_path).is_file():
        raise HTTPException(404, "Imagen no encontrada")
    return FileResponse(ROOT / row.image_path, media_type=row.image_content_type)
    completed_at: Mapped[datetime | None] = mapped_column(DateTime, nullable=True)


class FarmEvent(Base):
    __tablename__ = "farm_events"

    id: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    farm_id: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(ForeignKey("farms.id"), index=True)
    category: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(120), index=True)
    text: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(Text)
    occurred_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow, index=True)
    reporter_user_id: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(ForeignKey("users.id"), index=True)
    reporter: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(160), index=True)
    latitude: Mapped[float | None] = mapped_column(Float, nullable=True)
    longitude: Mapped[float | None] = mapped_column(Float, nullable=True)
    image_credit: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(Text, nullable=True)
    image_source: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(Text, nullable=True)
    image_license_url: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(Text, nullable=True)
    simulation_key: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(String(100), nullable=True)
    image_path: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(String(300), nullable=True)
    image_name: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(String(260), nullable=True)
    image_content_type: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(String(120), nullable=True)
    created_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow, index=True)
import React, { createContext, useContext, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { api } from './api/client';

export const TaskContext = createContext(null);
export function TaskButton({ source = {}, children = 'Crear tarea' }) {
  const open = useContext(TaskContext);
  return <button type="button" onClick={() => open(source)}>{children}</button>;
}
const statusLabels = { pending: 'Pendiente', in_progress: 'En curso', completed: 'Completada' };
const today = () => { const d = new Date(); return `${d.getFullYear()}-${String(d.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0')}-${String(d.getDate()).padStart(2,'0')}`; };
const dateLabel = value => value ? new Date(`${value.slice(0,10)}T12:00:00`).toLocaleDateString('es-ES') : 'Sin fecha';

export function TaskForm({ source, username, onClose, onSaved }) {
  const [kind, setKind] = useState(source.farm_event_id ? 'farm' : source.animal_event_id ? 'event' : source.animal_id ? 'animal' : 'none');
  const [animalId, setAnimalId] = useState(String(source.animal_id || ''));
  const [eventId, setEventId] = useState(String(source.animal_event_id || ''));
  const [farmId, setFarmId] = useState(String(source.farm_event_id || ''));
  const [animals, setAnimals] = useState([]);
  const [incidents, setIncidents] = useState([]);
  const [events, setEvents] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [eventsLoading, setEventsLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [dueDate, setDueDate] = useState(today());
  const [description, setDescription] = useState('');
  const [file, setFile] = useState(null);
  const [preview, setPreview] = useState('');
  const dialog = useRef(null);
  const saving = useRef(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    const previous = document.activeElement;
    dialog.current.showModal();
    return () => { if (previous?.isConnected) previous.focus(); };
  }, []);
  useEffect(() => {
    let alive = true;
    Promise.all([api.get('/api/animals'), api.get('/api/farm-events')])
      .then(([a, f]) => { if(alive) { setAnimals(a); setIncidents(f); } })
      .catch(e => { if(alive) setError(e.message); })
      .finally(() => { if(alive) setLoading(false); });
    return () => { alive = false; };
  }, []);
  useEffect(() => {
    let alive = true;
    setEvents([]);
    const animal = animals.find(a => String(a.id) === animalId);
    if (kind !== 'event' || !animal) { setEventsLoading(false); return; }
    setEventsLoading(true);
    api.get(`/api/animals/${encodeURIComponent(animal.crotal)}/details`)
      .then(d => { if(alive) setEvents(d.events); })
      .catch(e => { if(alive) setError(e.message); })
      .finally(() => { if(alive) setEventsLoading(false); });
    return () => { alive = false; };
  }, [kind, animalId, animals]);
  useEffect(() => {
    const url = file ? URL.createObjectURL(file) : '';
    setPreview(url);
    return () => { if(url) URL.revokeObjectURL(url); };
  }, [file]);
  async function save(e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    if(saving.current) return;
    if(!description.trim()) { setError('Escribe la tarea a realizar.'); return; }
    if(file && file.size > 10*1024*1024) { setError('La foto no puede superar 10 MB.'); return; }
    saving.current = true; setBusy(true); setError('');
    const form = new FormData();
    form.append('due_date', dueDate); form.append('description', description.trim());
    if(kind === 'animal' || kind === 'event') form.append('animal_id', animalId);
    if(kind === 'event') form.append('animal_event_id', eventId);
    if(kind === 'farm') form.append('farm_event_id', farmId);
    if(file) form.append('file', file);
    try { const row = await api.uploadForm('/api/tasks', form); onSaved(row); }
    catch(e) { setError(e.message); }
    finally { saving.current = false; setBusy(false); }
  }
  return <dialog ref={dialog} className="task-dialog" aria-labelledby="task-form-title" onCancel={e => { e.preventDefault(); if(!busy) onClose(); }}>
    <form onSubmit={save} className="task-form">
      <header><h2 id="task-form-title">Nueva tarea</h2><button type="button" disabled={busy} onClick={onClose} aria-label="Cerrar nueva tarea">Cerrar</button></header>
      <label>Quién pone la tarea<input value={username} readOnly /></label>
      <label>Fecha prevista<input type="date" required value={dueDate} onChange={e => setDueDate(e.target.value)} /></label>
      <label>Asociar a<select aria-label="Asociar a" value={kind} onChange={e => { setKind(e.target.value); setError(''); }}>
        <option value="none">Sin asociación</option><option value="animal">Animal</option><option value="event">Suceso de un animal</option><option value="farm">Incidencia de explotación</option>
      </select></label>
      {loading && <p role="status">Cargando registros…</p>}
      {(kind === 'animal' || kind === 'event') && <label>Animal<select aria-label="Animal" required value={animalId} onChange={e => { setAnimalId(e.target.value); setEventId(''); }}>
        <option value="">Selecciona un animal</option>{animals.map(a => <option key={a.id} value={a.id}>{a.crotal}</option>)}
      </select></label>}
      {kind === 'event' && <label>Suceso<select aria-label="Suceso" required disabled={eventsLoading} value={eventId} onChange={e => setEventId(e.target.value)}>
        <option value="">{eventsLoading ? 'Cargando sucesos…' : 'Selecciona un suceso'}</option>{events.map(e => <option key={e.id} value={e.id}>#{e.id} · {dateLabel(e.event_date)} · {e.text.slice(0,150)}</option>)}
      </select>{animalId && !eventsLoading && !events.length && <small>Este animal no tiene sucesos.</small>}</label>}
      {kind === 'farm' && <label>Incidencia<select aria-label="Incidencia" required value={farmId} onChange={e => setFarmId(e.target.value)}>
        <option value="">Selecciona una incidencia</option>{incidents.map(r => <option key={r.id} value={r.id}>#{r.id} · {dateLabel(r.occurred_at)} · {r.category} · {r.text.slice(0,100)}</option>)}
      </select></label>}
      <label>Descripción de la tarea<textarea required maxLength={10000} rows={4} value={description} onChange={e => setDescription(e.target.value)} placeholder="Describe lo que hay que hacer" /></label>
      <label>Foto opcional (máximo 10 MB)<input type="file" accept="image/jpeg,image/png,image/webp,image/gif" onChange={e => setFile(e.target.files?.[0] || null)} /></label>
      {preview && <img className="task-photo" src={preview} alt="Vista previa de la foto de la tarea" />}
      {error && <p className="error" role="alert">{error}</p>}
      <button className="primary" disabled={busy || loading || eventsLoading} type="submit">{busy ? 'Guardando…' : 'Guardar tarea'}</button>
    </form>
  </dialog>;
}

export function Tasks({ refreshKey }) {
  const [rows, setRows] = useState([]);
  const [filters, setFilters] = useState({ status:'', date_from:'', date_to:'' });
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [refresh, setRefresh] = useState(0);
  const [busyId, setBusyId] = useState(null);
  const [limit, setLimit] = useState(30);
  const invalid = filters.date_from && filters.date_to && filters.date_from > filters.date_to;
  useEffect(() => {
    let alive = true;
    setError(''); setLimit(30);
    if(invalid) { setRows([]); setLoading(false); return; }
    setLoading(true);
    const params = new URLSearchParams(Object.entries(filters).filter(([,v]) => v));
    api.get(`/api/tasks?${params}`).then(data => { if(alive) setRows(data); })
      .catch(e => { if(alive) { setError(e.message); setRows([]); } })
      .finally(() => { if(alive) setLoading(false); });
    return () => { alive = false; };
  }, [filters, refreshKey, refresh, invalid]);
  async function changeStatus(row, status) {
    setBusyId(row.id); setError('');
    try { await api.post(`/api/tasks/${row.id}/status`, {status}); setRefresh(v => v+1); }
    catch(e) { setError(e.message); }
    finally { setBusyId(null); }
  }
  return <section className="tasks-page">
    <div className="task-page-title"><h1>Gestor de tareas</h1><TaskButton>Nueva tarea</TaskButton></div>
    <p className="muted">Tareas de tu explotación, ordenadas por fecha prevista. Todos los usuarios de la explotación pueden crear tareas y actualizar su estado.</p>
    <section className="panel activity-filters" aria-label="Filtros de tareas"><h2>Filtros de tareas</h2><div className="compact-form">
      <label>Estado<select aria-label="Estado" value={filters.status} onChange={e => setFilters({...filters,status:e.target.value})}><option value="">Todos</option>{Object.entries(statusLabels).map(([v,l]) => <option key={v} value={v}>{l}</option>)}</select></label>
      <label>Desde<input type="date" value={filters.date_from} onChange={e => setFilters({...filters,date_from:e.target.value})} /></label>
      <label>Hasta<input type="date" value={filters.date_to} onChange={e => setFilters({...filters,date_to:e.target.value})} /></label>
      <button type="button" onClick={() => setFilters({status:'',date_from:'',date_to:''})}>Limpiar filtros</button>
    </div>{invalid && <p role="alert" className="error">La fecha inicial no puede ser posterior a la final.</p>}</section>
    {error && <p role="alert" className="error">{error}</p>}
    {loading ? <p role="status">Cargando tareas…</p> : <><p aria-live="polite">{rows.length} tareas</p>
      {!rows.length && !invalid && !error && <p className="panel">No hay tareas que coincidan con los filtros. Puedes crear una con «Nueva tarea».</p>}
      <div className="task-list">{rows.slice(0,limit).map(row => <article className="panel task-card" key={row.id}>
        <header><strong>Tarea #{row.id} · {dateLabel(row.due_date)}</strong><span className="pill">{statusLabels[row.status]}</span></header>
        {row.status !== 'completed' && row.due_date < today() && <p className="error">Fecha prevista vencida</p>}
        <p className="task-description">{row.description}</p>
        <p className="muted">Creada por {row.creator} · {dateLabel(row.created_at)}</p>
        {row.association_label ? <details><summary>Animal o registro asociado</summary><p className="task-description">{row.association_label}</p>{!row.farm_event_id && !row.animal_event_id && row.association_label.includes(' · ') && <small>El registro de origen se eliminó; se conserva esta referencia histórica.</small>}</details> : <p className="muted">Sin asociación</p>}
        {row.image_url && <a href={api.url(row.image_url)} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" aria-label={`Abrir foto de tarea ${row.id}`}><img loading="lazy" className="task-photo" src={api.url(row.image_url)} alt={`Foto de la tarea ${row.id}`} /></a>}
        <label>Estado de la tarea<select aria-label={`Estado de tarea ${row.id}`} value={row.status} disabled={busyId !== null} onChange={e => changeStatus(row,e.target.value)}>{Object.entries(statusLabels).map(([v,l]) => <option key={v} value={v}>{l}</option>)}</select></label>
        {row.completed_at && <small>Completada el {dateLabel(row.completed_at)}</small>}
      </article>)}</div>
      {rows.length > limit && <button type="button" onClick={() => setLimit(n=>n+30)}>Mostrar más tareas</button>}
    </>}
  </section>;
}

from collections.abc import Generator
import os

from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy import inspect, text
from sqlalchemy.orm import DeclarativeBase, Session, sessionmaker

DATABASE_URL = "sqlite:///./cows.db"

engine = create_engine(DATABASE_URL, connect_args={"check_same_thread": False})
SessionLocal = sessionmaker(bind=engine, autoflush=False, autocommit=False)


class Base(DeclarativeBase):
    pass


def get_db() -> Generator[Session, None, None]:
    db = SessionLocal()
    try:
        yield db
    finally:
        db.close()


def init_db() -> None:
    from app import models  # noqa: F401

    Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)
    ensure_bootstrap_users()
    ensure_sqlite_columns()
    ensure_primary_animal_images()


def ensure_bootstrap_users() -> None:
    from app.auth import hash_password
    from app.models import Farm, User

    with SessionLocal() as db:
        if db.query(User).count():
            return
        username = os.getenv("COWSIA_USERNAME", "").strip()
        password = os.getenv("COWSIA_PASSWORD", "")
        farm_name = os.getenv("COWSIA_FARM_NAME", "explotacion_pepe").strip()
        if not username or not password or not farm_name:
            return
        farm = Farm(name=farm_name)
        db.add(farm)
        db.flush()
        db.add(
            User(
                username=username,
                password_hash=hash_password(password),
                farm_id=farm.id,
                can_manage_users=True,
                active=True,
            )
        )
        db.commit()


def ensure_sqlite_columns() -> None:
    inspector = inspect(engine)
    tables = inspector.get_table_names()
    with engine.begin() as connection:
        if "farm_events" in tables:
            columns = {column["name"] for column in inspector.get_columns("farm_events")}
            for name, sql_type in {"image_credit": "TEXT", "image_source": "TEXT", "image_license_url": "TEXT", "simulation_key": "VARCHAR(100)"}.items():
                if name not in columns:
                    connection.execute(text(f"ALTER TABLE farm_events ADD COLUMN {name} {sql_type}"))
            connection.execute(text("CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS uq_farm_event_simulation ON farm_events(simulation_key)"))
        if "animal_events" in tables:
            columns = {column["name"] for column in inspector.get_columns("animal_events")}
            for name, sql_type in {"latitude": "FLOAT", "longitude": "FLOAT", "image_credit": "TEXT", "image_source": "TEXT", "simulation_key": "VARCHAR(100)"}.items():
                if name not in columns:
                    connection.execute(text(f"ALTER TABLE animal_events ADD COLUMN {name} {sql_type}"))
            connection.execute(text("CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS uq_animal_event_simulation ON animal_events(simulation_key)"))
        if "animal_images" in tables:
            columns = {column["name"] for column in inspector.get_columns("animal_images")}
            if "is_primary" not in columns:
                connection.execute(text("ALTER TABLE animal_images ADD COLUMN is_primary BOOLEAN DEFAULT 0"))


def ensure_primary_animal_images() -> None:
    with engine.begin() as connection:
        tables = inspect(engine).get_table_names()
        if "animal_images" not in tables:
            return
        animal_ids = [
            row[0]
            for row in connection.execute(text("SELECT DISTINCT animal_id FROM animal_images")).fetchall()
        ]
        for animal_id in animal_ids:
            primary_count = connection.execute(
                text("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM animal_images WHERE animal_id = :animal_id AND is_primary = 1"),
                {"animal_id": animal_id},
            ).scalar_one()
            if primary_count:
                continue
            first_image_id = connection.execute(
                text("SELECT id FROM animal_images WHERE animal_id = :animal_id ORDER BY created_at ASC, id ASC LIMIT 1"),
                {"animal_id": animal_id},
            ).scalar_one_or_none()
            if first_image_id is not None:
                connection.execute(
                    text("UPDATE animal_images SET is_primary = 1 WHERE id = :image_id"),
                    {"image_id": first_image_id},
                )

from datetime import datetime,timedelta
from pathlib import Path
from generar_historico_ubicaciones import destination,distance
ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
IMAGES=ROOT/'imagenes_incidencias_descargadas'
BATCH='incidencias_explotacion_20260929'
TYPES={
'alambrada':'Alambrada o cerramiento roto','pared':'Danos en instalaciones','arbol':'Arbol caido o camino bloqueado','camino':'Arbol caido o camino bloqueado',
'puerta_abierta':'Puerta abierta o danada','puerta_rota':'Puerta abierta o danada','bebedero':'Averia en bebedero o tuberia','comedero':'Danos en instalaciones',
'inundacion':'Inundacion o erosion','fuego':'Humo o riesgo de incendio','huellas':'Huellas o fauna silvestre','vertidos':'Residuos o vertidos'}
DESCRIPTIONS={
'alambrada':'Cerramiento con tramos rotos o vencidos.',
'pared':'Muro deteriorado con una parte caída.',
'arbol':'Árbol caído sobre el terreno.',
'camino':'Paso obstruido por materiales o vegetación.',
'puerta_abierta':'Puerta de acceso a una parcela abierta.',
'puerta_rota':'Puerta de cerramiento deteriorada.',
'bebedero':'Bebedero con una parte rota.',
'comedero':'Comedero abandonado y deteriorado.',
'inundacion':'Agua acumulada sobre un camino.',
'fuego':'Fuego o humo sobre la vegetación.',
'huellas':'Huellas de fauna sobre el terreno.',
'vertidos':'Residuos depositados sobre el terreno.'}
def build_plan(db,farm_ids):
 catalog=json.loads((IMAGES/'seleccion_final.json').read_text());plan=[]
 assert len({x['sha256'] for x in catalog})==len(catalog)
 for farm_id in farm_ids:
  user=db.execute('SELECT id,username FROM users WHERE farm_id=? ORDER BY id LIMIT 1',(farm_id,)).fetchone()
  assert user, 'La explotación debe tener un usuario'
  animals=db.execute('''SELECT a.id,a.crotal,l.id AS location_id,l.latitude,l.longitude FROM animals a JOIN animal_locations l ON l.id=(SELECT id FROM animal_locations WHERE animal_id=a.id ORDER BY recorded_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT 1) WHERE a.farm_id=? ORDER BY a.id''',(farm_id,)).fetchall()
  assert animals,'No hay animales con ubicación'
  for img in catalog:
   assert hashlib.sha256((IMAGES/img['file']).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==img['sha256']
   rng=random.Random(f'{BATCH}:{farm_id}:{img["id"]}');animal=rng.choice(animals);lat,lon=destination(animal['latitude'],animal['longitude'],rng.uniform(0,360),250)
   assert abs(distance(animal['latitude'],animal['longitude'],lat,lon)-250)<0.001
   moment=datetime(2026,6,29)+timedelta(seconds=rng.randrange(93*86400))
   plan.append(dict(simulation_key=f'{BATCH}:{farm_id}:{img["id"]}',farm_id=farm_id,category=TYPES[img['group']],text='[Incidencia simulada] '+img.get('description_es',DESCRIPTIONS[img['group']]),occurred_at=moment.isoformat(),reporter_user_id=user['id'],reporter=user['username'],latitude=lat,longitude=lon,image_name=img['file'],image_path='backend/uploads/event_images/'+BATCH+'_'+img['id']+'.jpg',image_content_type='image/jpeg',image_credit=f"{img['title']}. Autor: {img['author']}. {img['license']}. {img['changes']}",image_source=img['source'],image_license_url=img['license_url'],animal_id=animal['id'],crotal=animal['crotal'],base_location_id=animal['location_id'],base_latitude=animal['latitude'],base_longitude=animal['longitude']))
 return plan

def main():
 p=argparse.ArgumentParser();p.add_argument('--apply',action='store_true');p.add_argument('--farm-id',type=int,action='append',default=None);args=p.parse_args()
 out=ROOT/'docs'/BATCH;out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
 with sqlite3.connect(ROOT/'backend/cows.db',timeout=30) as db:
  db.row_factory=sqlite3.Row;plan=build_plan(db,args.farm_id or [1])
  (out/'plan.json').write_text(json.dumps(plan,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
  with (out/'plan.csv').open('w',encoding='utf-8-sig',newline='') as f:
   w=csv.DictWriter(f,fieldnames=list(plan[0]));w.writeheader();w.writerows(plan)
  existing={r[0] for r in db.execute('SELECT simulation_key FROM farm_events WHERE simulation_key IS NOT NULL')};pending=[r for r in plan if r['simulation_key'] not in existing]
  if args.apply:
   stamp=datetime.now().strftime('%Y%m%d_%H%M%S')
   with sqlite3.connect(ROOT/'backend'/f'cows_pre_farm_seed_{stamp}.bak') as backup:db.backup(backup)
   fields=[k for k in plan[0] if k not in ['animal_id','crotal','base_location_id','base_latitude','base_longitude']]
   for row in pending:
    target=ROOT/row['image_path'];target.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);shutil.copyfile(IMAGES/row['image_name'],target)
   with db:
    for row in pending:db.execute(f"INSERT INTO farm_events ({','.join(fields)},created_at) VALUES ({','.join('?' for _ in fields)},?)",[row[k] for k in fields]+[datetime.utcnow().isoformat()])
  summary=dict(planned=len(plan),new=len(pending),applied=args.apply,farm_ids=args.farm_id or [1]);(out/'resultado.json').write_text(json.dumps(summary,indent=2));print(summary)
if __name__=='__main__':main()

function FarmIncidentsMap({ rows }) {
  const located = rows.filter((row) => Number.isFinite(row.latitude) && Number.isFinite(row.longitude) && Math.abs(row.latitude) <= 90 && Math.abs(row.longitude) <= 180);
  if (!located.length) return <p className="muted">No hay incidencias con ubicación.</p>;
  return <>
    <p className="muted">{located.length} incidencias con ubicación. Pulsa un punto para ver la fotografía y los datos.</p>
    <MapContainer key={located.map((row) => `${row.id}:${row.latitude}:${row.longitude}`).join('|')} className="farm-incidents-map" bounds={located.map((row) => [row.latitude, row.longitude])} boundsOptions={{ padding: [30, 30], maxZoom: 16 }} scrollWheelZoom={false}>
      <TileLayer attribution='&copy; <a href="https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright">OpenStreetMap</a>' url="https://{s}.tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png" />
      <FarmIncidentMarkers rows={located} />
    </MapContainer>
    {rows.length > located.length && <p className="muted">{rows.length - located.length} incidencias sin ubicación no aparecen en el mapa.</p>}
  </>;
}

function FarmIncidentMarkers({ rows }) {
  const map = useMap();
  const [width, setWidth] = useState(() => map.getSize().x);
  useEffect(() => {
    const resize = () => setWidth(map.getSize().x);
    map.on("resize", resize);
    return () => map.off("resize", resize);
  }, [map]);
  return rows.map((row) => <Marker key={row.id} position={[row.latitude, row.longitude]} title={`${row.category} · ${formatDateTime(row.occurred_at)}`} icon={L.divIcon({ className: 'farm-incident-marker', html: '<span></span>', iconSize: [18, 18], iconAnchor: [9, 9] })}>
    <FarmIncidentPopup key={width} row={row} width={Math.max(140, Math.min(300, width - 90))} />
  </Marker>);
}

function FarmIncidentPopup({ row, width }) {
  const popup = useRef(null);
  const update = () => popup.current?.update();
  return <Popup ref={popup} maxWidth={width} minWidth={width} maxHeight={290} keepInView autoPanPadding={[15, 15]}>
    <div className="event-map-popup farm-incident-popup" data-incident-id={row.id}>
      {row.image_url && <img src={api.url(row.image_url)} alt={row.text} onLoad={update} />}
      <strong>{formatDateTime(row.occurred_at)}</strong>
      <span>{row.category}</span><p>{row.text}</p>
      <FarmImageCredit row={row} onToggle={update} />
    </div>
  </Popup>;
}
